FC Completion Report -- restructure the Summary sheet and add native Excel charts.

The Summary sheet is the department meeting document. The status breakdown is the
single most important output. Restructure so it leads, and add charts.

GLOBAL RULES
- Every change goes into BOTH the relevant *.bas file AND FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt.
  Keep that file clean ASCII.
- VBA has NO short-circuit evaluation. Verify every Sub ends with End Sub and every
  Function with End Function -- both bug classes have already appeared here.
- No 3D charts, no gradients, no shadows. Flat fills only.

================================================================
PART 1 -- REORDER THE SUMMARY SHEET
================================================================
New top-to-bottom order:

  1. Title: "FC Completion Report -- <Month> <Year>"
  2. HEADLINE BLOCK (new). Three rows, EM / EL / Combined, each showing:
     denominator, completed count, completed %. Bold, font size 14 for the
     percentage. This is the number people came for -- it must be visible without
     scrolling.
  3. CHART 1 -- status mix (see Part 2).
  4. Status breakdown tables: EM, then EL, then Combined -- the existing six bands
     plus Missed FC and the "Not completed (total)" subtotal. Unchanged content.
  5. CHART 2 -- band counts, EM vs EL (see Part 2).
  6. Warnings block: unrecognised FC statuses, encounters excluded as
     Shopper-only, blank Latest CCF Creation User fallback count, etc.
  7. RECONCILIATION WATERFALL, moved here from the top, under a heading
     "Reconciliation -- for checking, not for the meeting". Keep the balance-check
     row. Content unchanged, position only.

Update docs/FC_Completion_Report_User_Guide.md section 5.1 and section 6 to match
the new order (section 6 tells the reader to check the balance row -- say it is now
at the bottom of the Summary).

================================================================
PART 2 -- CHART INFRASTRUCTURE
================================================================
2.1  Add a hidden worksheet, SHEET_CHARTDATA = "ChartData", created last and set to
     xlSheetVeryHidden. Every chart's source is a CONTIGUOUS block written here,
     laid out exactly as the chart needs it. Do NOT point charts at cells inside the
     Summary or Analytics tables -- non-contiguous SetSourceData ranges are the main
     source of VBA charting failures.

2.2  Write ONE reusable helper, e.g.

       AddChartFromBlock(targetWs, anchorCell As Range, srcRange As Range, _
                         chartType As XlChartType, titleText As String, _
                         widthPts As Single, heightPts As Single, _
                         seriesColours As Variant) As ChartObject

     It must:
       - create via targetWs.ChartObjects.Add positioned at anchorCell.Left /
         anchorCell.Top (do NOT hardcode pixel positions -- anchor to cells so
         charts never sit on top of data)
       - SetSourceData from srcRange, PlotBy:=xlColumns
       - set HasTitle and ChartTitle.Text
       - apply seriesColours (an array of RGB longs) to each series via
         .SeriesCollection(i).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB, skipping any Empty entry
       - Legend at xlLegendPositionBottom, or no legend for single-series charts
       - remove the chart border: .ChartArea.Format.Line.Visible = msoFalse
       - name the ChartObject (e.g. "chtStatusMix") so it can be found later
     Guard the whole thing with On Error so a charting failure NEVER aborts report
     generation -- if a chart cannot be created, skip it, note it on the sheet, and
     carry on. The tables are the deliverable; charts are presentation.

2.3  Band colours must be the SAME RGB values used in the Summary table fills.
     Extract them into module-level constants used by both, so a table cell and its
     chart segment can never disagree:
       Green        RGB(146, 208,  80)
       Pink         RGB(255, 199, 206)
       Light Green  RGB(198, 239, 206)
       Orange       RGB(255, 192,   0)
       Draft only   RGB(242, 242, 242)
       Voided only  RGB(217, 217, 217)
       Missed FC    RGB(166, 166, 166)

================================================================
PART 3 -- THE CHARTS
================================================================
Build them in this order and confirm each renders before starting the next.

CHART 1 -- Status mix (Summary). THE headline visual.
  xlColumnStacked100. Three columns: EM, EL, Combined. Seven stacked segments in
  band order Green, Pink, Light Green, Orange, Draft only, Voided only, Missed FC.
  Data labels showing percentage on the Green segment only (the others clutter it).
  Roughly 420 x 260 points.

CHART 2 -- Band counts, EM vs EL (Summary).
  xlColumnClustered. Categories = the seven bands. Two series, EM and EL. Shows
  absolute volume, which the 100% chart hides. Single colour per series (EM dark
  blue RGB(31,73,125), EL mid grey RGB(128,128,128)) -- band colours do not apply
  here since bands are the category axis.

CHART 3 -- Where the gap is (Analytics, under the Point Of Care block).
  xlBarClustered, horizontal so ward names are readable. Top 10 wards by NOT-DONE
  count, largest at the top. Single series, orange. This is the most actionable
  visual in the workbook.

CHART 4 -- Completion rate by day of week (Analytics).
  xlColumnClustered, Monday to Sunday, completion % on the value axis, single
  series green. Add a horizontal line or a second flat series at the overall EM
  completion rate so the reader can see which days are below average.

CHART 5 -- EM turnaround distribution (Analytics).
  xlColumnClustered, four categories: <=24h, 24-48h, 48-72h, >72h, as % of
  encounters with a CCF. Note the excluded count (no CCF ever generated) in the
  chart title or a caption below it -- it must not silently vanish.

Do NOT build a trend chart. It needs the month-over-month history file, which is
still Phase 2.

================================================================
PART 4 -- VERIFY
================================================================
- Every chart's numbers must reconcile with the table directly above or below it.
  The ChartData block should be COPIED from the same variables that wrote the
  table, never recomputed -- recomputation is how a chart and its table drift apart.
- Confirm charts do not overlap tables or each other at default Excel zoom.
- Confirm report generation still completes if chart creation fails (test by
  temporarily forcing an error in the helper).
- Confirm .bas and FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt are in sync; Sub/Function
  terminators balance.
- Update docs/VBA_Code_Progress.md and the user guide.
- Output a summary of files and sections changed. Do not commit.

## claude-in-chrome
**IMPORTANT: If the Chrome browser tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load them with ToolSearch before calling them, and batch every tool you expect to need into ONE ToolSearch call (the select query accepts a comma-separated list). Do NOT load tools one at a time; each separate ToolSearch call wastes a full round-trip.**

Start a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:

ToolSearch with query "select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp"

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting. Only issue a second ToolSearch if the task later needs a tool you did not anticipate.

## claude.ai Supabase
Here are guidelines for using Supabase tools effectively:

- Before making schema changes, use `list_tables` to understand the existing structure
- When debugging issues, start with `get_logs` and `get_advisors` before making changes
- Use `get_project_url` and `get_publishable_api_key` when helping users configure client-side integrations

If you have access to a local development environment with a filesystem and shell:
- Install the Supabase agent skill for critical development and security guidance: `npx skills add supabase/agent-skills` (https://supabase.com/docs/guides/getting-started/ai-skills.md)
- Use the Supabase CLI (`supabase`) for local development workflows such as starting a local stack, managing migrations, and running edge functions locally (https://supabase.com/docs/guides/local-development.md)
- Prefer local development and testing before applying changes to a remote project

If you are running in a web-only or remote environment without filesystem or shell access:
- Rely on the MCP tools directly for all Supabase interactions
- Use `apply_migration` carefully, as changes go directly to the remote project

## plugin:context7:context7
Use this server to fetch current documentation whenever the user asks about a library, framework, SDK, API, CLI tool, or cloud service — even well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Express, Tailwind, Django, or Spring Boot. This includes API syntax, configuration, version migration, library-specific debugging, setup instructions, and CLI tool usage. Use even when you think you know the answer — your training data may not reflect recent changes. Prefer this over web search for library docs.

Do not use for: refactoring, writing scripts from scratch, debugging business logic, code review, or general programming concepts.

Base directory for this skill: C:\Users\lutfi\.claude\plugins\cache\claude-plugins-official\superpowers\6.2.0\skills\writing-plans

# Writing Plans

## Overview

Write comprehensive implementation plans assuming the engineer has zero context for our codebase and questionable taste. Document everything they need to know: which files to touch for each task, code, testing, docs they might need to check, how to test it. Give them the whole plan as bite-sized tasks. DRY. YAGNI. TDD. Frequent commits.

Assume they are a skilled developer, but know almost nothing about our toolset or problem domain. Assume they don't know good test design very well.

**Announce at start:** "I'm using the writing-plans skill to create the implementation plan."

**Context:** If working in an isolated worktree, it should have been created via the `superpowers:using-git-worktrees` skill at execution time.

**Save plans to:** `docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<feature-name>.md`
- (User preferences for plan location override this default)

## Scope Check

If the spec covers multiple independent subsystems, it should have been broken into sub-project specs during brainstorming. If it wasn't, suggest breaking this into separate plans — one per subsystem. Each plan should produce working, testable software on its own.

## File Structure

Before defining tasks, map out which files will be created or modified and what each one is responsible for. This is where decomposition decisions get locked in.

- Design units with clear boundaries and well-defined interfaces. Each file should have one clear responsibility.
- You reason best about code you can hold in context at once, and your edits are more reliable when files are focused. Prefer smaller, focused files over large ones that do too much.
- Files that change together should live together. Split by responsibility, not by technical layer.
- In existing codebases, follow established patterns. If the codebase uses large files, don't unilaterally restructure - but if a file you're modifying has grown unwieldy, including a split in the plan is reasonable.

This structure informs the task decomposition. Each task should produce self-contained changes that make sense independently.

## Task Right-Sizing

A task is the smallest unit that carries its own test cycle and is worth a
fresh reviewer's gate. When drawing task boundaries: fold setup,
configuration, scaffolding, and documentation steps into the task whose
deliverable needs them; split only where a reviewer could meaningfully
reject one task while approving its neighbor. Each task ends with an
independently testable deliverable.

## Bite-Sized Task Granularity

**Each step is one action (2-5 minutes):**
- "Write the failing test" - step
- "Run it to make sure it fails" - step
- "Implement the minimal code to make the test pass" - step
- "Run the tests and make sure they pass" - step
- "Commit" - step

## Plan Document Header

**Every plan MUST start with this header:**

```markdown
# [Feature Name] Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** [One sentence describing what this builds]

**Architecture:** [2-3 sentences about approach]

**Tech Stack:** [Key technologies/libraries]

## Global Constraints

[The spec's project-wide requirements — version floors, dependency limits,
naming and copy rules, platform requirements — one line each, with exact
values copied verbatim from the spec. Every task's requirements implicitly
include this section.]

---
```

## Task Structure

````markdown
### Task N: [Component Name]

**Files:**
- Create: `exact/path/to/file.py`
- Modify: `exact/path/to/existing.py:123-145`
- Test: `tests/exact/path/to/test.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: [what this task uses from earlier tasks — exact signatures]
- Produces: [what later tasks rely on — exact function names, parameter
  and return types. A task's implementer sees only their own task; this
  block is how they learn the names and types neighboring tasks use.]

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```python
def test_specific_behavior():
    result = function(input)
    assert result == expected
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run test to verify it fails**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: FAIL with "function not defined"

- [ ] **Step 3: Write minimal implementation**

```python
def function(input):
    return expected
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run test to verify it passes**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: PASS

- [ ] **Step 5: Commit**

```bash
git add tests/path/test.py src/path/file.py
git commit -m "feat: add specific feature"
```
````

## No Placeholders

Every step must contain the actual content an engineer needs. These are **plan failures** — never write them:
- "TBD", "TODO", "implement later", "fill in details"
- "Add appropriate error handling" / "add validation" / "handle edge cases"
- "Write tests for the above" (without actual test code)
- "Similar to Task N" (repeat the code — the engineer may be reading tasks out of order)
- Steps that describe what to do without showing how (code blocks required for code steps)
- References to types, functions, or methods not defined in any task

## Self-Review

After writing the complete plan, look at the spec with fresh eyes and check the plan against it. This is a checklist you run yourself — not a subagent dispatch.

**1. Spec coverage:** Skim each section/requirement in the spec. Can you point to a task that implements it? List any gaps.

**2. Placeholder scan:** Search your plan for red flags — any of the patterns from the "No Placeholders" section above. Fix them.

**3. Type consistency:** Do the types, method signatures, and property names you used in later tasks match what you defined in earlier tasks? A function called `clearLayers()` in Task 3 but `clearFullLayers()` in Task 7 is a bug.

If you find issues, fix them inline. No need to re-review — just fix and move on. If you find a spec requirement with no task, add the task.

## Execution Handoff

After saving the plan, offer execution choice:

**"Plan complete and saved to `docs/superpowers/plans/<filename>.md`. Two execution options:**

**1. Subagent-Driven (recommended)** - I dispatch a fresh subagent per task, review between tasks, fast iteration

**2. Inline Execution** - Execute tasks in this session using executing-plans, batch execution with checkpoints

**Which approach?"**

**If Subagent-Driven chosen:**
- **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development
- Fresh subagent per task + two-stage review

**If Inline Execution chosen:**
- **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** Use superpowers:executing-plans
- Batch execution with checkpoints for review

Attribute VB_Name = "MainMacro"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' MainMacro.bas
'
' Entry point: GenerateFCCompletionReport (run via Alt+F8).
' Orchestrates the full pipeline:
'   1. FilePickerForm -- select File A (required) and File B (optional)
'   2. Load staff roster + NCID EL Point of Care list from Config sheet
'   3. Clean File A (FC Mode filter, cancel filter, dedup), snapshotting row/
'      encounter counts along the way for the Summary sheet reconciliation
'      waterfall (PART 3.3, 2026-07-30)
'   4. Roster coverage guard (PART 4.1, 2026-07-30) -- measures what fraction
'      of encounters map to a named team; warns or aborts before an empty/
'      unmatched roster silently reports 100% "Others"
'   5. Clean File B (FC Mode filter, Missed FC filter, cancel/planned, EDVW
'      flag) -- SKIPPED entirely if File B was not provided
'   6. Build output workbook (EM/EL split, Summary, Methodology, Roster Check)
'   7. Close input files, show success summary
'
' Step numbering is computed dynamically (stepNum/totalSteps) rather than
' hardcoded, so the progress bar adapts automatically to whether File B's
' four cleaning steps are present.
' ============================================================

Public Sub GenerateFCCompletionReport()

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    ' ---- Step 0: File picker ----
    Dim picker As FilePickerForm
    Set picker = New FilePickerForm
    If Not picker.ShowFilePicker Then Exit Sub

    Dim wbA As Workbook, wbB As Workbook
    Set wbA = picker.SelectedFileA
    Set wbB = picker.SelectedFileB

    Dim hasFileB As Boolean
    hasFileB = Not (wbB Is Nothing)

    Dim wsA As Worksheet, wsB As Worksheet
    Set wsA = wbA.Sheets(1)
    If hasFileB Then Set wsB = wbB.Sheets(1)

    ' ---- Show progress (9 steps always + 4 more if File B is present) ----
    Dim totalSteps As Long
    totalSteps = 9
    If hasFileB Then totalSteps = totalSteps + 4
    ProgressForm.ShowProgress totalSteps

    Dim stepNum As Long
    stepNum = 0

    ' ---- Load staff roster + NCID EL Point of Care list ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Loading staff roster and NCID Point of Care list"
    Dim roster As Object
    Set roster = LoadStaffRoster()
    Dim ncidPocList As Object
    Set ncidPocList = LoadNCIDPointOfCareList()

    ' ---- Clean File A ----
    ' Waterfall snapshot: rows as loaded + distinct encounters before the FC
    ' Mode filter (PART 2.4 / 3.3, 2026-07-30).
    Dim rowsLoadedA As Long
    rowsLoadedA = CountDataRows(wsA)
    Dim encSetBeforeMode As Object
    Set encSetBeforeMode = GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA)
    Dim blankEncBeforeMode As Long
    blankEncBeforeMode = CountBlankEncounterRows(wsA)

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- filtering FC Mode"
    If Not FilterFCMode(wsA) Then GoTo Cleanup

    Dim rowsAfterMode As Long
    rowsAfterMode = CountDataRows(wsA)
    ' Encounters lost entirely to the FC Mode filter (PART 2.4): distinct
    ' real (non-blank) encounter numbers gone, PLUS at most 1 more if any
    ' blank-encounter row (e.g. a Shopper-mode form, which some eFC exports
    ' submit with no Encounter Number at all) was dropped -- a blank
    ' encounter number can't be split into separate real encounters, so all
    ' such rows lost this way count as one indeterminate "encounter", not one
    ' each.
    Dim encountersLostToModeFilter As Long
    encountersLostToModeFilter = CountKeysNotIn(encSetBeforeMode, GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA))
    If CountBlankEncounterRows(wsA) < blankEncBeforeMode Then
        encountersLostToModeFilter = encountersLostToModeFilter + 1
    End If

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- removing cancelled admissions"
    If Not DeleteCancelledAdmissions(wsA) Then GoTo Cleanup

    Dim rowsAfterCancelled As Long
    rowsAfterCancelled = CountDataRows(wsA)
    Dim uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup As Long
    uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup = GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA).Count

    ' ---- Deduplicate File A ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- adding priority column"
    AddPriorityColumn wsA

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- highlighting duplicate encounters"
    MarkDuplicateEncounters wsA

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- resolving duplicates"
    Dim voidedOnlyCount As Long
    Dim dupGroupsResolved As Long
    Dim dupRowsRemoved As Long
    Dim inflightExceptionApplied As Long
    Dim inflightExceptionBlocked As Long
    Dim resolvedEncounters As Object
    If Not ResolveDuplicateEncounters(wsA, roster, voidedOnlyCount, _
            dupGroupsResolved, dupRowsRemoved, _
            inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, resolvedEncounters) Then GoTo Cleanup

    ' ---- Waterfall dictionary (PART 3.3) -- consumed by BuildOutput.bas's
    ' WriteReconciliationWaterfall on the Summary sheet.
    Dim waterfall As Object
    Set waterfall = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    waterfall("RowsLoaded") = rowsLoadedA
    waterfall("RowsAfterModeFilter") = rowsAfterMode
    waterfall("RowsAfterCancelledFilter") = rowsAfterCancelled
    waterfall("UniqueEncounters") = uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup
    waterfall("DuplicateGroupsResolved") = dupGroupsResolved
    waterfall("DuplicateRowsRemoved") = dupRowsRemoved
    waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter") = encountersLostToModeFilter

    ' ---- Roster coverage guard (PART 4.1, 2026-07-30) ----
    ' Run after File A cleaning/dedup, before BuildOutputWorkbook, so an
    ' empty/unmatched roster is caught here rather than silently producing a
    ' Summary claiming 100% of CCFs were closed by "Others".
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Checking staff roster coverage"
    Dim unmatchedNames As Object
    Dim rosterCoverage As Double
    rosterCoverage = ComputeRosterCoverage(wsA, roster, unmatchedNames)

    Dim suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean
    suppressTeamBlocks = False

    If rosterCoverage = 0 Then
        Dim resp As VbMsgBoxResult
        resp = MsgBox("The staff roster (Config sheet) is empty, or doesn't match any names in " & _
            "this export." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "'Who Closed the CCF' and all four numerator indicators (FC created by EDFC, CCF " & _
            "closed by EDFC/Inflight/NCID AO) will be UNAVAILABLE for this report." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "Continue and produce completion statistics only?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, _
            "Staff Roster Not Matched")
        If resp = vbNo Then GoTo Cleanup
        suppressTeamBlocks = True
    ElseIf rosterCoverage < 0.7 Then
        MsgBox "Staff roster coverage is low: only " & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%") & _
            " of encounters matched a named team." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "The report will still be produced, but unmatched staff names will be listed on the " & _
            "Summary sheet (largest first) so you can see which names to add to the Config roster.", _
            vbInformation, "Low Roster Coverage"
    End If

    ' ---- Clean File B (skipped entirely if not provided) ----
    If hasFileB Then
        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- filtering FC Mode"
        If Not FilterFCModeIfPresent(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- keeping Missed FC rows"
        If Not KeepOnlyMissedFC(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- removing cancelled/planned"
        If Not DeleteCancelledOrPlanned(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- flagging EDVW discharges"
        FlagEDVWDischarges wsB
    End If

    ' ---- Build output ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Building output workbook"
    Dim outputOK As Boolean
    outputOK = BuildOutputWorkbook(wsA, wsB, roster, ncidPocList, _
        picker.MissedFCManualCount, inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, _
        waterfall, rosterCoverage, unmatchedNames, suppressTeamBlocks, resolvedEncounters)

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Done"

    ' ---- Cleanup: close input files ----
    On Error Resume Next
    wbA.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If hasFileB Then wbB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    On Error GoTo 0

    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    Application.StatusBar = False

    If outputOK Then
        Dim msg As String
        msg = "FC Completion Report generated successfully." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
              "Duplicate encounters resolved: " & dupGroupsResolved & _
              " (" & dupRowsRemoved & " row(s) removed)" & vbNewLine & _
              "Voided/Deleted-only encounters (counted in denominator, REVERT B): " & voidedOnlyCount & vbNewLine & _
              "Encounters lost entirely to the FC Mode filter (e.g. Shopper-only): " & _
              encountersLostToModeFilter & vbNewLine & _
              "Inflight duplicate exception applied: " & inflightExceptionApplied & _
              " group(s); blocked by the priority<=2 guard: " & inflightExceptionBlocked & " group(s)"
        If suppressTeamBlocks Then
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "Staff roster coverage: 0% -- 'Who Closed the CCF' and numerator indicators were " & _
                  "suppressed this run."
        Else
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "Staff roster coverage: " & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%")
        End If
        If Not hasFileB Then
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "File B was not provided -- Missed FC count used manual entry: " & _
                  picker.MissedFCManualCount
        End If
        MsgBox msg, vbInformation, "Complete"
    Else
        MsgBox "Report generation encountered an error. Check the output workbook " & _
               "(if open) for partial results.", vbExclamation, "Warning"
    End If

    Exit Sub

Cleanup:
    On Error Resume Next
    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    wbA.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If hasFileB Then wbB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    Application.StatusBar = False
    On Error GoTo 0
    Exit Sub

ErrHandler:
    On Error Resume Next
    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    Application.StatusBar = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    On Error GoTo 0
    MsgBox "Unexpected error:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
End Sub

1	Attribute VB_Name = "BuildOutput"
2	Option Explicit
3	
4	' ============================================================
5	' BuildOutput.bas
6	'
7	' Builds the FC Completion Report output workbook:
8	'   - EM sheet (Emergency encounters from File A)
9	'   - EL sheet (Elective Inpatient encounters from File A -- every Elective
10	'     Inpatient encounter, no Point of Care gate -- see "Revert A" below)
11	'   - Missed FC sheet (File B data) -- SKIPPED when File B was not provided
12	'   - Summary sheet (reconciliation waterfall + six-band colour-coded
13	'     completion + team breakdown + NCID ward sub-block)
14	'   - Methodology sheet (plain-language rule explanation)
15	'   - Staff Roster Check sheet (roster coverage check, both directions)
16	'
17	' 2026-07-30 consolidated change set (validated against
18	' FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx, June 2026, against the team's manual
19	' report for the same month):
20	'
21	'   PART 1 -- data-value fixes: ADM_ELECTIVE now matches on a normalised
22	'     "ELECTIVE INPA" prefix (the export writes "Elective inpa", not
23	'     "Elective Inpatient"); date parsing fixed from D/M/Y to M/D/Y
24	'     (TryParseMDYDate, was TryParseDMYDate).
25	'
26	'   PART 2 -- REVERT A: the NCID Point of Care list is no longer a gate on
27	'     the EL sheet/stats -- EL is every Elective Inpatient encounter,
28	'     Admission Type alone (Q1's original answer was correct). REVERT B:
29	'     Voided/Deleted-only encounters (priority 99) are back IN the
30	'     denominator and IN "not completed" -- they get their own Summary row,
31	'     uncoloured, under the "Not completed (total)" subtotal. Priority 98/99
32	'     stay separately counted and reported (this split is unchanged). The FC
33	'     Mode filter still drops Shopper-only encounters entirely, but the count
34	'     of encounters lost that way is now surfaced on Summary/Methodology.
35	'
36	'   PART 3 -- output additions: NCID Point of Care becomes an informational
37	'     breakdown (not a gate) -- an "NCID Ward" Yes/No column on the EL sheet,
38	'     an "of which NCID wards" summary sub-block, and a warning for any
39	'     Point of Care value containing "NCID" that isn't in the configured
40	'     list. A small-denominator guard suppresses percentages under n=30. A
41	'     reconciliation waterfall on the Summary sheet lets the team verify the
42	'     macro's math against a manual run, with a visible balance-check row.
43	'
44	'   PART 4 -- staff roster: a roster coverage guard (MainMacro, before this
45	'     module runs) measures what fraction of encounters map to a named team;
46	'     BuildOutputWorkbook receives the result (rosterCoverage,
47	'     unmatchedNames, suppressTeamBlocks) purely for reporting/suppression.
48	' ============================================================
49	
50	Public Const SHEET_EM As String = "EM"
51	Public Const SHEET_EL As String = "EL"
52	Public Const SHEET_MISSED_FC As String = "Missed FC"
53	Public Const SHEET_SUMMARY As String = "Summary"
54	Public Const SHEET_METHODOLOGY As String = "Methodology"
55	Public Const SHEET_STAFF_ROSTER_CHECK As String = "Staff Roster Check"
56	
57	Private Const ADM_EMERGENCY As String = "Emergency"
58	' The real export writes "Elective inpa" (truncated), not "Elective
59	' Inpatient" -- matched as a normalised UPPERCASE prefix (PART 1.1,
60	' 2026-07-30) via IsElectiveAdmType so the full word still matches if eFC
61	' ever writes it out in full.
62	Private Const ADM_ELECTIVE As String = "Elective inpa"
63	
64	' Section codes used in secArr() (see BuildOutputWorkbook):
65	'   1 = EM (Emergency)
66	'   2 = EL (Elective Inpatient -- Admission Type alone, PART 2 Revert A)
67	'   0 = neither -- excluded from both sheets, reported separately
68	Private Const SEC_EM As Long = 1
69	Private Const SEC_EL As Long = 2
70	
71	' ---- Date parsing (eFC export format) ------------------------------------
72	
73	' PART 1.2 (2026-07-30): the export writes dates as M/D/Y ("6/15/2026"), not
74	' D/M/Y. The old TryParseDMYDate read parts(0) as day and parts(1) as month,
75	' so DateSerial(2026, 15, 6) silently rolled over to March 2027 and every
76	' GetReportPeriodLabel call was wrong. Renamed to TryParseMDYDate, parses
77	' M/D/Y, and rejects out-of-range month/day instead of letting DateSerial
78	' roll over silently.
79	Private Function TryParseMDYDate(dateText As String, ByRef result As Date) As Boolean
80	    Dim datePart As String
81	    Dim spacePos As Long
82	    spacePos = InStr(dateText, " ")
83	    If spacePos > 0 Then
84	        datePart = Trim(Left(dateText, spacePos - 1))
85	    Else
86	        datePart = Trim(dateText)
87	    End If
88	
89	    Dim parts() As String
90	    parts = Split(datePart, "/")
91	    If UBound(parts) <> 2 Then
92	        TryParseMDYDate = False
93	        Exit Function
94	    End If
95	    If Not IsNumeric(parts(0)) Or Not IsNumeric(parts(1)) Or Not IsNumeric(parts(2)) Then
96	        TryParseMDYDate = False
97	        Exit Function
98	    End If
99	
100	    Dim m As Long, d As Long, y As Long
101	    m = CLng(parts(0)): d = CLng(parts(1)): y = CLng(parts(2))
102	    If y < 100 Then y = y + 2000
103	
104	    If m < 1 Or m > 12 Or d < 1 Or d > 31 Then
105	        TryParseMDYDate = False
106	        Exit Function
107	    End If
108	
109	    On Error GoTo Fail
110	    result = DateSerial(y, m, d)
111	    TryParseMDYDate = True
112	    Exit Function
113	Fail:
114	    TryParseMDYDate = False
115	End Function
116	
117	Public Function GetReportPeriodLabel(fileAws As Worksheet) As String
118	    Dim admDateCol As Long
119	    admDateCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Admission Date")
120	    If admDateCol = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function
121	
122	    Dim encCol As Long
123	    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
124	    If encCol = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function
125	
126	    Dim lastRow As Long
127	    lastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
128	    If lastRow < 2 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function
129	
130	    Dim data As Variant
131	    data = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, admDateCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, admDateCol)).Value
132	
133	    Dim counts As Object
134	    Set counts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
135	
136	    Dim i As Long, txt As String, parsed As Date, key As String
137	    For i = 1 To (lastRow - 1)
138	        If lastRow = 2 Then txt = CStr(data) Else txt = CStr(data(i, 1))
139	        If TryParseMDYDate(txt, parsed) Then
140	            key = Year(parsed) & "-" & Month(parsed)
141	            If counts.Exists(key) Then counts(key) = counts(key) + 1 Else counts(key) = 1
142	        End If
143	    Next i
144	
145	    If counts.Count = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function
146	
147	    Dim bestKey As String, bestCount As Long
148	    Dim k As Variant
149	    For Each k In counts.Keys
150	        If counts(k) > bestCount Then bestCount = counts(k): bestKey = CStr(k)
151	    Next k
152	
153	    Dim pts() As String
154	    pts = Split(bestKey, "-")
155	    GetReportPeriodLabel = MonthName(CLng(pts(1)), False) & CStr(CLng(pts(0)))
156	End Function
157	
158	' Returns True if admTypeUpper (already UCase'd) is Elective Inpatient --
159	' matched as a prefix against "ELECTIVE INPA" so both the export's truncated
160	' "Elective inpa" and a full "Elective Inpatient" match (PART 1.1, 2026-07-30).
161	Private Function IsElectiveAdmType(admTypeUpper As String) As Boolean
162	    Dim prefix As String
163	    prefix = UCase(ADM_ELECTIVE)
164	    IsElectiveAdmType = (Left(admTypeUpper, Len(prefix)) = prefix)
165	End Function
166	
167	' ---- Small helpers -------------------------------------------------------
168	
169	Private Sub InitTeamCounts(d As Object)
170	    d.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
171	    d(TEAM_ED_EDFC) = 0
172	    d(TEAM_INFLIGHT) = 0
173	    d(TEAM_NCID_AO) = 0
174	    d(TEAM_ICH_PSO) = 0
175	    d(TEAM_ADMIN) = 0
176	    d(TEAM_OTHERS) = 0
177	End Sub
178	
179	Private Function AddSheet(wb As Workbook, sheetName As String) As Worksheet
180	    Dim ws As Worksheet
181	    Set ws = wb.Sheets.Add(After:=wb.Sheets(wb.Sheets.Count))
182	    ws.Name = sheetName
183	    Set AddSheet = ws
184	End Function
185	
186	Private Sub FormatHeaderRow(ws As Worksheet, lastCol As Long)
187	    With ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(1, lastCol))
188	        .Font.Bold = True
189	        .Interior.Color = RGB(31, 73, 125)
190	        .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
191	    End With
192	    On Error Resume Next
193	    ws.Rows(1).AutoFilter
194	    On Error GoTo 0
195	End Sub
196	
197	Private Function SafePct(num As Long, denom As Long) As Double
198	    If denom > 0 Then SafePct = num / denom Else SafePct = 0
199	End Function
200	
201	Private Function CellStr(v As Variant) As String
202	    CellStr = Trim(CStr(v))
203	End Function
204	
205	' Writes a percentage cell, UNLESS smallDenom is True (PART 3.2, 2026-07-30):
206	' below n=30, percentages are misleading at a department meeting, so the
207	' cell is left blank instead (the raw count column still shows the number).
208	Private Sub WritePctCell(ws As Worksheet, r As Long, c As Long, num As Long, denom As Long, smallDenom As Boolean)
209	    If smallDenom Then
210	        ws.Cells(r, c).Value = ""
211	    Else
212	        ws.Cells(r, c).Value = SafePct(num, denom)
213	        ws.Cells(r, c).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
214	    End If
215	End Sub
216	
217	' Buckets one row's FC Status priority into the six completion bands,
218	' incrementing the matching ByRef counter. Shared by the per-section
219	' (EM/EL) counters and the NCID-ward subset counters (PART 3.1) so the
220	' bucketing logic isn't duplicated.
221	Private Sub ClassifyIntoBand(pri As Long, ByRef greenC As Long, ByRef pinkC As Long, _
222	        ByRef ltGreenC As Long, ByRef orangeC As Long, ByRef draftC As Long, ByRef voidC As Long)
223	    If pri <= 2 Then
224	        greenC = greenC + 1
225	    ElseIf pri = 3 Then
226	        pinkC = pinkC + 1
227	    ElseIf pri <= 5 Then
228	        ltGreenC = ltGreenC + 1
229	    ElseIf pri = 6 Then
230	        orangeC = orangeC + 1
231	    ElseIf pri = 99 Then
232	        voidC = voidC + 1
233	    Else   ' 98 -- Draft variants, blanks, typos, new statuses
234	        draftC = draftC + 1
235	    End If
236	End Sub
237	
238	' ---- Write File A rows to a sheet, filtered by pre-computed section code -
239	
240	' secArr(i) holds the section code (SEC_EM / SEC_EL / 0) for fullData row i,
241	' computed once in BuildOutputWorkbook's main pass.
242	Private Function WriteFilteredFileASheet(ws As Worksheet, fullData As Variant, _
243	        totalRows As Long, outCols As Long, secArr() As Long, targetSec As Long) As Long
244	
245	    Dim matchCount As Long, i As Long, j As Long
246	    For i = 2 To totalRows
247	        If secArr(i) = targetSec Then matchCount = matchCount + 1
248	    Next i
249	
250	    For j = 1 To outCols
251	        ws.Cells(1, j).Value = fullData(1, j)
252	    Next j
253	
254	    If matchCount = 0 Then
255	        FormatHeaderRow ws, outCols
256	        ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
257	        WriteFilteredFileASheet = 0
258	        Exit Function
259	    End If
260	
261	    Dim outArr() As Variant
262	    ReDim outArr(1 To matchCount, 1 To outCols)
263	    Dim outRow As Long
264	    For i = 2 To totalRows
265	        If secArr(i) = targetSec Then
266	            outRow = outRow + 1
267	            For j = 1 To outCols
268	                outArr(outRow, j) = fullData(i, j)
269	            Next j
270	        End If
271	    Next i
272	
273	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + matchCount, outCols)).Value = outArr
274	    FormatHeaderRow ws, outCols
275	    ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
276	    WriteFilteredFileASheet = matchCount
277	End Function
278	
279	' ---- Highlight rows where Latest CCF Creation User was blank (Q7) --------
280	
281	Private Sub HighlightCCFFallbackRows(ws As Worksheet)
282	    Dim latestCol As Long, closerCol As Long, encCol As Long
283	    latestCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
284	    closerCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "CCF Closed By")
285	    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
286	    If latestCol = 0 Or closerCol = 0 Or encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub
287	
288	    Dim lastRow As Long
289	    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
290	    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub
291	
292	    Dim rng As Range
293	    Dim i As Long
294	    For i = 2 To lastRow
295	        If CellStr(ws.Cells(i, latestCol).Value) = "" And _
296	           CellStr(ws.Cells(i, closerCol).Value) <> "" Then
297	            If rng Is Nothing Then
298	                Set rng = ws.Cells(i, closerCol)
299	            Else
300	                Set rng = Union(rng, ws.Cells(i, closerCol))
301	            End If
302	        End If
303	    Next i
304	
305	    If Not rng Is Nothing Then rng.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 153)
306	End Sub
307	
308	' ---- Highlight rows whose encounter had duplicate FC IDs resolved --------
309	
310	' Red-fills the Encounter Number cell for every row whose "Duplicate(s)
311	' Resolved" column (written in BuildOutputWorkbook's main pass) is "Yes" --
312	' i.e. this is the surviving row of a group that had more than one FC ID
313	' before automatic resolution. This is CLAUDE.md Step 4 / process flow doc
314	' item 5's "visual aid" (originally applied to fileAws by
315	' DeduplicateEncounters.MarkDuplicateEncounters), re-applied here because
316	' fileAws never reaches the user (closed without saving) and this sheet is
317	' populated from a plain .Value array that carries no formatting from fileAws.
318	Private Sub HighlightResolvedDuplicateRows(ws As Worksheet)
319	    Dim encCol As Long, dupCol As Long
320	    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
321	    dupCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Duplicate(s) Resolved")
322	    If encCol = 0 Or dupCol = 0 Then Exit Sub
323	
324	    Dim lastRow As Long
325	    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
326	    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub
327	
328	    Dim rng As Range
329	    Dim i As Long
330	    For i = 2 To lastRow
331	        If CellStr(ws.Cells(i, dupCol).Value) = "Yes" Then
332	            If rng Is Nothing Then
333	                Set rng = ws.Cells(i, encCol)
334	            Else
335	                Set rng = Union(rng, ws.Cells(i, encCol))
336	            End If
337	        End If
338	    Next i
339	
340	    If Not rng Is Nothing Then
341	        rng.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
342	        rng.Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
343	    End If
344	End Sub
345	
346	' ---- Write Missed FC sheet (File B data as-is) ---------------------------
347	
348	Private Sub WriteMissedFCSheet(ws As Worksheet, fileBws As Worksheet)
349	    Dim encCol As Long
350	    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileBws)
351	    If encCol = 0 Then
352	        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "No encounter column found in File B."
353	        Exit Sub
354	    End If
355	
356	    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
357	    lastRow = fileBws.Cells(fileBws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
358	    lastCol = fileBws.Cells(1, fileBws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
359	    If lastRow < 1 Or lastCol < 1 Then Exit Sub
360	
361	    Dim data As Variant
362	    data = fileBws.Range(fileBws.Cells(1, 1), fileBws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value
363	
364	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value = data
365	    FormatHeaderRow ws, lastCol
366	    ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
367	End Sub
368	
369	' ---- Reconciliation waterfall (PART 3.3, 2026-07-30) ----------------------
370	
371	' waterfall: Dictionary from MainMacro with keys "RowsLoaded",
372	' "RowsAfterModeFilter", "RowsAfterCancelledFilter", "UniqueEncounters",
373	' "DuplicateGroupsResolved", "DuplicateRowsRemoved",
374	' "EncountersLostToModeFilter" -- snapshots taken between File A cleaning
375	' steps. "Unique encounter numbers" and "Encounters carried forward" are the
376	' same figure (dedup leaves exactly one row per encounter) -- the "of which"
377	' lines below it are informational subsets already included in that count,
378	' not further subtractions. The balance-check row verifies EM + EL + neither
379	' reproduces that same figure.
380	Private Sub WriteReconciliationWaterfall(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, waterfall As Object, _
381	        missedTotal As Long, voidedTotal As Long, unrecognisedTotal As Long, _
382	        emEnc As Long, elEnc As Long, otherEncCount As Long)
383	
384	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "RECONCILIATION WATERFALL"
385	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
386	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
387	    r = r + 1
388	
389	    Dim rowsLoaded As Long, rowsAfterMode As Long, rowsAfterCancelled As Long

536	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 192, 0)
537	    r = r + 1

539	    ' White/none (priority 98 -- Draft variants, blanks, unrecognised statuses)
540	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Draft only -- no FC outcome"
541	    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = draftCt

543	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
544	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
545	    r = r + 1

547	    ' Voided/Deleted only (priority 99) -- REVERT B, 2026-07-30: counted IN
548	    ' the denominator and IN "not completed" now, not excluded. Uncoloured.

553	    r = r + 1

571	    r = r + 1

Attribute VB_Name = "BuildOutput"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' BuildOutput.bas
'
' Builds the FC Completion Report output workbook:
'   - EM sheet (Emergency encounters from File A)
'   - EL sheet (Elective Inpatient encounters from File A -- every Elective
'     Inpatient encounter, no Point of Care gate -- see "Revert A" below)
'   - Missed FC sheet (File B data) -- SKIPPED when File B was not provided
'   - Summary sheet (reconciliation waterfall + six-band colour-coded
'     completion + team breakdown + NCID ward sub-block)
'   - Methodology sheet (plain-language rule explanation)
'   - Staff Roster Check sheet (roster coverage check, both directions)
'
' 2026-07-30 consolidated change set (validated against
' FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx, June 2026, against the team's manual
' report for the same month):
'
'   PART 1 -- data-value fixes: ADM_ELECTIVE now matches on a normalised
'     "ELECTIVE INPA" prefix (the export writes "Elective inpa", not
'     "Elective Inpatient"); date parsing fixed from D/M/Y to M/D/Y
'     (TryParseMDYDate, was TryParseDMYDate).
'
'   PART 2 -- REVERT A: the NCID Point of Care list is no longer a gate on
'     the EL sheet/stats -- EL is every Elective Inpatient encounter,
'     Admission Type alone (Q1's original answer was correct). REVERT B:
'     Voided/Deleted-only encounters (priority 99) are back IN the
'     denominator and IN "not completed" -- they get their own Summary row,
'     uncoloured, under the "Not completed (total)" subtotal. Priority 98/99
'     stay separately counted and reported (this split is unchanged). The FC
'     Mode filter still drops Shopper-only encounters entirely, but the count
'     of encounters lost that way is now surfaced on Summary/Methodology.
'
'   PART 3 -- output additions: NCID Point of Care becomes an informational
'     breakdown (not a gate) -- an "NCID Ward" Yes/No column on the EL sheet,
'     an "of which NCID wards" summary sub-block, and a warning for any
'     Point of Care value containing "NCID" that isn't in the configured
'     list. A small-denominator guard suppresses percentages under n=30. A
'     reconciliation waterfall on the Summary sheet lets the team verify the
'     macro's math against a manual run, with a visible balance-check row.
'
'   PART 4 -- staff roster: a roster coverage guard (MainMacro, before this
'     module runs) measures what fraction of encounters map to a named team;
'     BuildOutputWorkbook receives the result (rosterCoverage,
'     unmatchedNames, suppressTeamBlocks) purely for reporting/suppression.
' ============================================================

Public Const SHEET_EM As String = "EM"
Public Const SHEET_EL As String = "EL"
Public Const SHEET_MISSED_FC As String = "Missed FC"
Public Const SHEET_SUMMARY As String = "Summary"
Public Const SHEET_METHODOLOGY As String = "Methodology"
Public Const SHEET_STAFF_ROSTER_CHECK As String = "Staff Roster Check"

Private Const ADM_EMERGENCY As String = "Emergency"
' The real export writes "Elective inpa" (truncated), not "Elective
' Inpatient" -- matched as a normalised UPPERCASE prefix (PART 1.1,
' 2026-07-30) via IsElectiveAdmType so the full word still matches if eFC
' ever writes it out in full.
Private Const ADM_ELECTIVE As String = "Elective inpa"

' Section codes used in secArr() (see BuildOutputWorkbook):
'   1 = EM (Emergency)
'   2 = EL (Elective Inpatient -- Admission Type alone, PART 2 Revert A)
'   0 = neither -- excluded from both sheets, reported separately
Private Const SEC_EM As Long = 1
Private Const SEC_EL As Long = 2

' ---- Date parsing (eFC export format) ------------------------------------

' PART 1.2 (2026-07-30): the export writes dates as M/D/Y ("6/15/2026"), not
' D/M/Y. The old TryParseDMYDate read parts(0) as day and parts(1) as month,
' so DateSerial(2026, 15, 6) silently rolled over to March 2027 and every
' GetReportPeriodLabel call was wrong. Renamed to TryParseMDYDate, parses
' M/D/Y, and rejects out-of-range month/day instead of letting DateSerial
' roll over silently.
Private Function TryParseMDYDate(dateText As String, ByRef result As Date) As Boolean
    Dim datePart As String
    Dim spacePos As Long
    spacePos = InStr(dateText, " ")
    If spacePos > 0 Then
        datePart = Trim(Left(dateText, spacePos - 1))
    Else
        datePart = Trim(dateText)
    End If

    Dim parts() As String
    parts = Split(datePart, "/")
    If UBound(parts) <> 2 Then
        TryParseMDYDate = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    If Not IsNumeric(parts(0)) Or Not IsNumeric(parts(1)) Or Not IsNumeric(parts(2)) Then
        TryParseMDYDate = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim m As Long, d As Long, y As Long
    m = CLng(parts(0)): d = CLng(parts(1)): y = CLng(parts(2))
    If y < 100 Then y = y + 2000

    If m < 1 Or m > 12 Or d < 1 Or d > 31 Then
        TryParseMDYDate = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    On Error GoTo Fail
    result = DateSerial(y, m, d)
    TryParseMDYDate = True
    Exit Function
Fail:
    TryParseMDYDate = False
End Function

Public Function GetReportPeriodLabel(fileAws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim admDateCol As Long
    admDateCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Admission Date")
    If admDateCol = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    If encCol = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function

    Dim data As Variant
    data = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, admDateCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, admDateCol)).Value

    Dim counts As Object
    Set counts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    Dim i As Long, txt As String, parsed As Date, key As String
    For i = 1 To (lastRow - 1)
        If lastRow = 2 Then txt = CStr(data) Else txt = CStr(data(i, 1))
        If TryParseMDYDate(txt, parsed) Then
            key = Year(parsed) & "-" & Month(parsed)
            If counts.Exists(key) Then counts(key) = counts(key) + 1 Else counts(key) = 1
        End If
    Next i

    If counts.Count = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function

    Dim bestKey As String, bestCount As Long
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In counts.Keys
        If counts(k) > bestCount Then bestCount = counts(k): bestKey = CStr(k)
    Next k

    Dim pts() As String
    pts = Split(bestKey, "-")
    GetReportPeriodLabel = MonthName(CLng(pts(1)), False) & CStr(CLng(pts(0)))
End Function

' Returns True if admTypeUpper (already UCase'd) is Elective Inpatient --
' matched as a prefix against "ELECTIVE INPA" so both the export's truncated
' "Elective inpa" and a full "Elective Inpatient" match (PART 1.1, 2026-07-30).
Private Function IsElectiveAdmType(admTypeUpper As String) As Boolean
    Dim prefix As String
    prefix = UCase(ADM_ELECTIVE)
    IsElectiveAdmType = (Left(admTypeUpper, Len(prefix)) = prefix)
End Function

' ---- Small helpers -------------------------------------------------------

Private Sub InitTeamCounts(d As Object)
    d.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    d(TEAM_ED_EDFC) = 0
    d(TEAM_INFLIGHT) = 0
    d(TEAM_NCID_AO) = 0
    d(TEAM_ICH_PSO) = 0
    d(TEAM_ADMIN) = 0
    d(TEAM_OTHERS) = 0
End Sub

Private Function AddSheet(wb As Workbook, sheetName As String) As Worksheet
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = wb.Sheets.Add(After:=wb.Sheets(wb.Sheets.Count))
    ws.Name = sheetName
    Set AddSheet = ws
End Function

Private Sub FormatHeaderRow(ws As Worksheet, lastCol As Long)
    With ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(1, lastCol))
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Interior.Color = RGB(31, 73, 125)
        .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End With
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.Rows(1).AutoFilter
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Private Function SafePct(num As Long, denom As Long) As Double
    If denom > 0 Then SafePct = num / denom Else SafePct = 0
End Function

Private Function CellStr(v As Variant) As String
    CellStr = Trim(CStr(v))
End Function

' Writes a percentage cell, UNLESS smallDenom is True (PART 3.2, 2026-07-30):
' below n=30, percentages are misleading at a department meeting, so the
' cell is left blank instead (the raw count column still shows the number).
Private Sub WritePctCell(ws As Worksheet, r As Long, c As Long, num As Long, denom As Long, smallDenom As Boolean)
    If smallDenom Then
        ws.Cells(r, c).Value = ""
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, c).Value = SafePct(num, denom)
        ws.Cells(r, c).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    End If
End Sub

' Buckets one row's FC Status priority into the six completion bands,
' incrementing the matching ByRef counter. Shared by the per-section
' (EM/EL) counters and the NCID-ward subset counters (PART 3.1) so the
' bucketing logic isn't duplicated.
Private Sub ClassifyIntoBand(pri As Long, ByRef greenC As Long, ByRef pinkC As Long, _
        ByRef ltGreenC As Long, ByRef orangeC As Long, ByRef draftC As Long, ByRef voidC As Long)
    If pri <= 2 Then
        greenC = greenC + 1
    ElseIf pri = 3 Then
        pinkC = pinkC + 1
    ElseIf pri <= 5 Then
        ltGreenC = ltGreenC + 1
    ElseIf pri = 6 Then
        orangeC = orangeC + 1
    ElseIf pri = 99 Then
        voidC = voidC + 1
    Else   ' 98 -- Draft variants, blanks, typos, new statuses
        draftC = draftC + 1
    End If
End Sub

' ---- Write File A rows to a sheet, filtered by pre-computed section code -

' secArr(i) holds the section code (SEC_EM / SEC_EL / 0) for fullData row i,
' computed once in BuildOutputWorkbook's main pass.
Private Function WriteFilteredFileASheet(ws As Worksheet, fullData As Variant, _
        totalRows As Long, outCols As Long, secArr() As Long, targetSec As Long) As Long

    Dim matchCount As Long, i As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To totalRows
        If secArr(i) = targetSec Then matchCount = matchCount + 1
    Next i

    For j = 1 To outCols
        ws.Cells(1, j).Value = fullData(1, j)
    Next j

    If matchCount = 0 Then
        FormatHeaderRow ws, outCols
        ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
        WriteFilteredFileASheet = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim outArr() As Variant
    ReDim outArr(1 To matchCount, 1 To outCols)
    Dim outRow As Long
    For i = 2 To totalRows
        If secArr(i) = targetSec Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To outCols
                outArr(outRow, j) = fullData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + matchCount, outCols)).Value = outArr
    FormatHeaderRow ws, outCols
    ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
    WriteFilteredFileASheet = matchCount
End Function

' ---- Highlight rows where Latest CCF Creation User was blank (Q7) --------

Private Sub HighlightCCFFallbackRows(ws As Worksheet)
    Dim latestCol As Long, closerCol As Long, encCol As Long
    latestCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    closerCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "CCF Closed By")
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If latestCol = 0 Or closerCol = 0 Or encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Dim rng As Range
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If CellStr(ws.Cells(i, latestCol).Value) = "" And _
           CellStr(ws.Cells(i, closerCol).Value) <> "" Then
            If rng Is Nothing Then
                Set rng = ws.Cells(i, closerCol)
            Else
                Set rng = Union(rng, ws.Cells(i, closerCol))
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    If Not rng Is Nothing Then rng.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 153)
End Sub

' ---- Highlight rows whose encounter had duplicate FC IDs resolved --------

' Red-fills the Encounter Number cell for every row whose "Duplicate(s)
' Resolved" column (written in BuildOutputWorkbook's main pass) is "Yes" --
' i.e. this is the surviving row of a group that had more than one FC ID
' before automatic resolution. This is CLAUDE.md Step 4 / process flow doc
' item 5's "visual aid" (originally applied to fileAws by
' DeduplicateEncounters.MarkDuplicateEncounters), re-applied here because
' fileAws never reaches the user (closed without saving) and this sheet is
' populated from a plain .Value array that carries no formatting from fileAws.
Private Sub HighlightResolvedDuplicateRows(ws As Worksheet)
    Dim encCol As Long, dupCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    dupCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Duplicate(s) Resolved")
    If encCol = 0 Or dupCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Dim rng As Range
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If CellStr(ws.Cells(i, dupCol).Value) = "Yes" Then
            If rng Is Nothing Then
                Set rng = ws.Cells(i, encCol)
            Else
                Set rng = Union(rng, ws.Cells(i, encCol))
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    If Not rng Is Nothing Then
        rng.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        rng.Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End If
End Sub

' ---- Write Missed FC sheet (File B data as-is) ---------------------------

Private Sub WriteMissedFCSheet(ws As Worksheet, fileBws As Worksheet)
    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileBws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "No encounter column found in File B."
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    lastRow = fileBws.Cells(fileBws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    lastCol = fileBws.Cells(1, fileBws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    If lastRow < 1 Or lastCol < 1 Then Exit Sub

    Dim data As Variant
    data = fileBws.Range(fileBws.Cells(1, 1), fileBws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value = data
    FormatHeaderRow ws, lastCol
    ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
End Sub

' ---- Reconciliation waterfall (PART 3.3, 2026-07-30) ----------------------

' waterfall: Dictionary from MainMacro with keys "RowsLoaded",
' "RowsAfterModeFilter", "RowsAfterCancelledFilter", "UniqueEncounters",
' "DuplicateGroupsResolved", "DuplicateRowsRemoved",
' "EncountersLostToModeFilter" -- snapshots taken between File A cleaning
' steps. "Unique encounter numbers" and "Encounters carried forward" are the
' same figure (dedup leaves exactly one row per encounter) -- the "of which"
' lines below it are informational subsets already included in that count,
' not further subtractions. The balance-check row verifies EM + EL + neither
' reproduces that same figure.
Private Sub WriteReconciliationWaterfall(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, waterfall As Object, _
        missedTotal As Long, voidedTotal As Long, unrecognisedTotal As Long, _
        emEnc As Long, elEnc As Long, otherEncCount As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "RECONCILIATION WATERFALL"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    Dim rowsLoaded As Long, rowsAfterMode As Long, rowsAfterCancelled As Long
    Dim uniqueEnc As Long, dupGroups As Long, dupRowsRemoved As Long, lostToMode As Long
    rowsLoaded = CLng(waterfall("RowsLoaded"))
    rowsAfterMode = CLng(waterfall("RowsAfterModeFilter"))
    rowsAfterCancelled = CLng(waterfall("RowsAfterCancelledFilter"))
    uniqueEnc = CLng(waterfall("UniqueEncounters"))
    dupGroups = CLng(waterfall("DuplicateGroupsResolved"))
    dupRowsRemoved = CLng(waterfall("DuplicateRowsRemoved"))
    lostToMode = CLng(waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter"))

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Rows in File A as loaded"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = rowsLoaded
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  less rows dropped by FC Mode filter"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = -(rowsLoaded - rowsAfterMode)
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  less rows dropped by Cancelled filter"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = -(rowsAfterMode - rowsAfterCancelled)
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Unique encounter numbers"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = uniqueEnc
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  less duplicate rows removed by dedup (" & dupGroups & " encounter(s) had duplicates)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = -dupRowsRemoved
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Encounters carried forward"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = uniqueEnc
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  of which Voided/Deleted only (informational, still counted)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = voidedTotal
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  of which unrecognised status (informational, still counted)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unrecognisedTotal
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  encounters lost entirely to the FC Mode filter (informational -- e.g. Shopper-only)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = lostToMode
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "plus missed FC (File B or manual entry)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = missedTotal
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "= DENOMINATOR"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = uniqueEnc + missedTotal
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim splitSum As Long
    splitSum = emEnc + elEnc + otherEncCount
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Check: EM (" & emEnc & ") + EL (" & elEnc & ") + neither (" & _
        otherEncCount & ") = " & splitSum & " vs. encounters carried forward (" & uniqueEnc & ")"
    If splitSum <> uniqueEnc Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "MISMATCH -- there is a bug in the counting logic, report this."
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Bold = True
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(0, 128, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "OK -- balances."
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Color = RGB(0, 128, 0)
    End If
    r = r + 2
End Sub

' ---- Summary sheet -------------------------------------------------------

' Six colour bands: Green / Pink / Light Green / Orange / White-none (Draft,
' priority 98) / Voided-Deleted (priority 99, REVERT B -- back IN the
' denominator and "not completed", 2026-07-30) / Grey (Missed FC). A "Not
' completed (total)" subtotal (Orange + Draft + Voided + Missed) keeps the
' single headline figure available.
Private Sub WriteSummaryBlock(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, _
        title As String, encCount As Long, missedCount As Long, missedSourceLabel As String, _
        greenCt As Long, pinkCt As Long, ltGreenCt As Long, orangeCt As Long, draftCt As Long, voidedCt As Long, _
        teamD As Object, blankCCFCt As Long, _
        edInit As Long, edFull As Long, inflFull As Long, ncidFull As Long, _
        suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean)

    Dim denom As Long
    denom = encCount + missedCount
    Dim smallDenom As Boolean
    smallDenom = (denom < 30)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = title
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Denominator: " & denom & " encounters"
    If missedCount > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = ws.Cells(r, 1).Value & _
            " (" & encCount & " from FC Summary + " & missedCount & " missed FC, source: " & _
            missedSourceLabel & ")"
    End If
    r = r + 1
    If smallDenom Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "n too small for percentages (n < 30) -- counts only below."
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 1
    End If
    r = r + 1

    ' ---- Completion status table (six colour bands) ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Completion Status"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ' Green (priority 1-2)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Completed with written acknowledgement"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = greenCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, greenCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(146, 208, 80)
    r = r + 1

    ' Pink (priority 3)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF explained but not signed"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = pinkCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, pinkCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 192, 203)
    r = r + 1

    ' Light Green (priority 4-5)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Attempted, no further follow-up"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = ltGreenCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, ltGreenCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(198, 239, 206)
    r = r + 1

    ' Orange (priority 6)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC not completed"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = orangeCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, orangeCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 192, 0)
    r = r + 1

    ' White/none (priority 98 -- Draft variants, blanks, unrecognised statuses)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Draft only -- no FC outcome"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = draftCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, draftCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
    r = r + 1

    ' Voided/Deleted only (priority 99) -- REVERT B, 2026-07-30: counted IN
    ' the denominator and IN "not completed" now, not excluded. Uncoloured.
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Voided/Deleted only"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = voidedCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, voidedCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
    r = r + 1

    ' Grey (File B / manual entry -- missed FC, no FC ID ever created)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Missed FC -- no FC ID created"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = missedCount
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, missedCount, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(217, 217, 217)
    r = r + 1

    ' Not completed (total) -- Orange + Draft + Voided + Missed.
    Dim notCompletedTotal As Long
    notCompletedTotal = orangeCt + draftCt + voidedCt + missedCount
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Not completed (total)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = notCompletedTotal
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Italic = True
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, notCompletedTotal, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Font.Italic = True
    r = r + 1

    ' Total row -- visible sanity check that the bands sum to the denominator.
    Dim bandSum As Long
    bandSum = greenCt + pinkCt + ltGreenCt + orangeCt + draftCt + voidedCt + missedCount
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Total"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = bandSum
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, bandSum, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    If bandSum <> denom Then
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "MISMATCH: bands sum to " & bandSum & " but denominator is " & _
            denom & " -- report this, there is a bug in the counting logic."
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Bold = True
    End If
    r = r + 2

    If suppressTeamBlocks Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Who Closed the CCF / FC Activity Detail -- NOT AVAILABLE"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 0, 0)
        r = r + 1
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "The Config staff roster is empty or matched no names in this export -- " & _
            "team attribution is unavailable this run. See the Methodology sheet for details."
        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' ---- Who closed the CCF ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Who Closed the CCF"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim teams As Variant
    teams = Array(TEAM_ED_EDFC, TEAM_INFLIGHT, TEAM_NCID_AO, _
                  TEAM_ICH_PSO, TEAM_ADMIN, TEAM_OTHERS)
    Dim t As Long
    For t = LBound(teams) To UBound(teams)
        Dim tName As String
        tName = CStr(teams(t))
        Dim tCount As Long
        tCount = 0
        If teamD.Exists(tName) Then tCount = teamD(tName)
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = tName
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = tCount
        WritePctCell ws, r, 3, tCount, denom, smallDenom
        r = r + 1
    Next t

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF not generated (Missed FC)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = missedCount
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, missedCount, denom, smallDenom
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Total"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = denom
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = 1
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True

    If blankCCFCt > 0 Then
        r = r + 1
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  (" & blankCCFCt & _
            " encounter(s) had blank 'Latest CCF Creation User' -- fell back to 'FC Created By')"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- FC Activity Detail ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Activity Detail"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC created by EDFC (initial -- FC Created By)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = edInit
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF closed by EDFC (Latest CCF Creation User)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = edFull
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF closed by Inflight"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = inflFull
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF closed by NCID AO"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = ncidFull
    r = r + 3
End Sub

Private Sub WriteSummarySheet(ws As Worksheet, reportLabel As String, waterfall As Object, _
        emEnc As Long, elEnc As Long, missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, missedFCSourceLabel As String, _
        emGreen As Long, emPink As Long, emLtGreen As Long, emOrange As Long, emDraft As Long, emVoided As Long, _
        elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long, elOrange As Long, elDraft As Long, elVoided As Long, _
        emTeams As Object, elTeams As Object, _
        emBlankCCF As Long, elBlankCCF As Long, _
        emEdInit As Long, emEdFull As Long, emInflFull As Long, emNcidFull As Long, _
        elEdInit As Long, elEdFull As Long, elInflFull As Long, elNcidFull As Long, _
        ncidEnc As Long, ncidGreen As Long, ncidPink As Long, ncidLtGreen As Long, ncidOrange As Long, _
        ncidDraft As Long, ncidVoided As Long, ncidTeams As Object, ncidBlankCCF As Long, _
        ncidEdInit As Long, ncidEdFull As Long, ncidInflFull As Long, ncidNcidFull As Long, _
        voidedTotal As Long, otherEncCount As Long, missedOther As Long, _
        unrecognisedStatuses As Object, unmatchedNCIDWards As Object, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long, _
        modeFilterExcludedEncounters As Long, _
        suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean, rosterCoverage As Double, unmatchedNames As Object)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Completion Report -- " & reportLabel
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- Reconciliation waterfall (PART 3.3) ----
    WriteReconciliationWaterfall ws, r, waterfall, missedEM + missedEL + missedOther, _
        voidedTotal, unrecognisedStatuses.Count, emEnc, elEnc, otherEncCount

    If suppressTeamBlocks Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "STAFF ROSTER NOT MATCHED -- team attribution and all four " & _
            "numerator indicators are unavailable this run (the Config roster is empty or matched " & _
            "no names in this export). Completion statistics below are still valid."
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 0, 0)
        r = r + 2
    End If

    ' ---- EM block (always computed) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "EMERGENCY (EM) ADMISSIONS", _
        emEnc, missedEM, missedFCSourceLabel, emGreen, emPink, emLtGreen, emOrange, emDraft, emVoided, _
        emTeams, emBlankCCF, emEdInit, emEdFull, emInflFull, emNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- EL block (Revert A, 2026-07-30: always computed -- Admission Type alone) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "ELECTIVE INPATIENT (EL) ADMISSIONS", _
        elEnc, missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, elGreen, elPink, elLtGreen, elOrange, elDraft, elVoided, _
        elTeams, elBlankCCF, elEdInit, elEdFull, elInflFull, elNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- of which NCID wards (PART 3.1 sub-block under EL) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "  of which NCID wards (subset of EL)", _
        ncidEnc, 0, missedFCSourceLabel, ncidGreen, ncidPink, ncidLtGreen, ncidOrange, ncidDraft, ncidVoided, _
        ncidTeams, ncidBlankCCF, ncidEdInit, ncidEdFull, ncidInflFull, ncidNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- Combined block ----
    Dim combTeams As Object
    Set combTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts combTeams
    Dim tk As Variant
    For Each tk In emTeams.Keys
        combTeams(CStr(tk)) = emTeams(CStr(tk)) + elTeams(CStr(tk))
    Next tk

    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "COMBINED (EM + EL)", _
        emEnc + elEnc, missedEM + missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        emGreen + elGreen, emPink + elPink, emLtGreen + elLtGreen, emOrange + elOrange, _
        emDraft + elDraft, emVoided + elVoided, _
        combTeams, emBlankCCF + elBlankCCF, _
        emEdInit + elEdInit, emEdFull + elEdFull, _
        emInflFull + elInflFull, emNcidFull + elNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- FOOTNOTES ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FOOTNOTES"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Voided/Deleted-only encounters (counted IN the denominator and IN " & _
        "'not completed', REVERT B 2026-07-30): " & voidedTotal
    r = r + 1

    If otherEncCount > 0 Or missedOther > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Encounters with unrecognised Admission Type (not EM or EL): " & _
            otherEncCount & " from File A, " & missedOther & " from File B"
        r = r + 1
    End If

    If modeFilterExcludedEncounters > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = modeFilterExcludedEncounters & " encounter(s) excluded -- only form " & _
            "was a Shopper enquiry or other non-FC mode."
        r = r + 1
    End If

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Missed FC source: " & missedFCSourceLabel
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Inflight duplicate exception applied (ED/EDFC candidate present, winner " & _
        "priority <= 2): " & inflightExceptionApplied & " encounter(s); blocked by the priority " & _
        "guard and fell back to the plain lowest-priority rule: " & inflightExceptionBlocked & " encounter(s)"
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- Unrecognised FC Status warning block ----
    If Not unrecognisedStatuses Is Nothing Then
        If unrecognisedStatuses.Count > 0 Then
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "UNRECOGNISED FC STATUS VALUES (counted as 'Draft only -- no FC " & _
                "outcome', priority 98 -- still IN the denominator, but check for typos or new eFC statuses)"
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
            r = r + 1

            Dim uk As Variant
            For Each uk In unrecognisedStatuses.Keys
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(uk)
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unrecognisedStatuses(uk)
                r = r + 1
            Next uk
            r = r + 1
        End If
    End If

    ' ---- Unmatched "NCID" Point of Care values warning (PART 3.1) ----
    If Not unmatchedNCIDWards Is Nothing Then
        If unmatchedNCIDWards.Count > 0 Then
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "POINT OF CARE VALUES CONTAINING 'NCID' NOT IN THE CONFIGURED LIST " & _
                "(still counted normally -- check whether a new NCID ward needs adding to the Config " & _
                "sheet's 'NCID EL Point of Care' list)"
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
            r = r + 1

            Dim nk As Variant
            For Each nk In unmatchedNCIDWards.Keys
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(nk)
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unmatchedNCIDWards(nk)
                r = r + 1
            Next nk
            r = r + 1
        End If
    End If

    ' ---- Low roster coverage: unmatched staff names (PART 4.1) ----
    If Not suppressTeamBlocks And rosterCoverage < 0.7 And rosterCoverage > 0 Then
        If Not unmatchedNames Is Nothing Then
            If unmatchedNames.Count > 0 Then
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "LOW ROSTER COVERAGE (" & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%") & _
                    ") -- UNMATCHED STAFF NAMES (add these to the Config roster for the biggest gain)"
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
                r = r + 1

                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Staff Name (as it appears in this export)"
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Encounter Count"
                ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Bold = True
                r = r + 1

                Dim sortedNames As Variant
                sortedNames = SortDictKeysDescending(unmatchedNames)
                Dim si As Long
                For si = LBound(sortedNames) To UBound(sortedNames)
                    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(sortedNames(si))
                    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unmatchedNames(CStr(sortedNames(si)))
                    r = r + 1
                Next si
                r = r + 1
            End If
        End If
    End If

    ws.Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 70
    ws.Columns("B:B").ColumnWidth = 12
    ws.Columns("C:C").ColumnWidth = 10
    ws.Columns("D:D").ColumnWidth = 50
End Sub

' ---- Methodology sheet ---------------------------------------------------

Private Sub WriteMethodologySheet(ws As Worksheet, reportLabel As String, _
        voidedTotal As Long, missedFCSourceLabel As String, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long, _
        unrecognisedStatusCount As Long, modeFilterExcludedEncounters As Long, _
        suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean, rosterCoverage As Double)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "File B: Inflight Missed FC Report (eFC export, Missed FC indicator ticked) -- OPTIONAL."

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "This month's Missed FC source: " & missedFCSourceLabel & "."

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "If File B is not provided, the Missed FC count is entered manually (dashboard " & _

    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "a) Keep only FC Mode = 'Financial Counselling - AH' or 'Financial Counselling - Downtime'" & _
