        " whose ONLY form was a different mode (e.g. Shopper) are lost entirely at this step -- this month: " & _
        modeFilterExcludedEncounters & " encounter(s)."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "b) Remove Admission Status = 'Cancelled'."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "c) Rank each FC ID by status priority: 1 = Completed, 2 = Acknowledgement by other means," & _
        " 3 = Virtual FC pending signature, 4-5 = Attempted/declined, 6 = Attempted, unable to complete,"
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "   98 = anything else not explicitly listed (Draft variants, blanks, typos, new eFC" & _
        " statuses -- still counted in the denominator as not completed), 99 = Voided/Deleted (matched by" & _
        " substring, e.g. 'Voided', 'Deleted by Admin')."
    r = r + 1
    If unrecognisedStatusCount > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "   This month: " & unrecognisedStatusCount & " distinct unrecognised (priority 98)" & _
            " status value(s) were seen -- see the warning block on the Summary sheet for the list and counts."
        r = r + 1
    End If
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "d) For encounters with multiple FC IDs: the plain rule is 'lowest priority wins, tie-" & _
        "break by larger (newer) FC ID'. The narrow Inflight exception only overrides this when (a) a non-" & _
        "Inflight candidate in the group was created by ED/EDFC staff, AND (b) the resulting winner (picked" & _
        " from the non-Inflight candidates) has priority <= 2 -- otherwise the plain rule stands."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "   This month: Inflight exception applied to " & inflightExceptionApplied & _
        " encounter(s); blocked by the priority<=2 guard (fell back to the plain rule) for " & _
        inflightExceptionBlocked & " encounter(s)."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "e) REVERT B (2026-07-30): encounters where the only surviving FC ID is Voided/" & _
        "Deleted (priority 99) are counted IN the denominator and IN 'not completed' -- they get their own" & _
        " 'Voided/Deleted only' Summary row. This matches actual practice (the manual report includes them);" & _
        " an earlier version of this macro excluded them, which disagreed with practice. This month: " & _
        voidedTotal & " encounter(s)."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "3. FILE B CLEANING (skipped entirely when File B is not provided)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "a) Keep only Missed FC = 'Yes'."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "b) Remove Admission Status = 'Cancelled' or 'Planned'."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "c) EDVW discharges (Point Of Care = 'TTSH Virtual Ward', Accommodation Code = 'EDVW'" & _
        " -- also matched against the export's 'Accomodation Code' misspelling) are flagged but still counted."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "4. EM/EL SPLIT"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "REVERT A (2026-07-30): EM/EL is Admission Type ALONE -- Emergency rows are EM," & _

        " 'Elective inpa') are EL. There is no Point of Care gate; a brief 2026-07-29 version gated EL on the" & _
        " Config NCID Point of Care list, which was incorrect and has been reverted."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "The Config sheet's 'NCID EL Point of Care' list is now purely informational: it" & _
        " drives an 'NCID Ward' Yes/No column on the EL sheet and an 'of which NCID wards' summary sub-block," & _
        " and any Point of Care value containing 'NCID' that isn't in the list is warned about on the Summary."

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "A 'Looks Wrong' flag marks EM rows closed by NCID AO or EL rows closed by ED/EDFC or Inflight."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "5. DENOMINATOR"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Denominator = unique encounters from File A (INCLUDING Voided/Deleted-only, REVERT B)" & _
        " + Missed FC count (from File B or manual entry -- see Section 1). See the Summary sheet's" & _
        " reconciliation waterfall for the full derivation, row by row."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "6. COMPLETION STATUS BANDS"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Green (priority 1-2): FC Completed with written acknowledgement."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Pink (priority 3): CCF explained but not signed."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Light Green (priority 4-5): Attempted, no further follow-up."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Orange (priority 6): FC not completed."

    r = r + 1

    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "8. CONSERVATIVE PRINCIPLE"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "When a case is ambiguous or borderline, it is counted as NOT completed / missed."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Unrecognised FC Status values are priority 98 (not completed, but still in the" & _
        " denominator); Voided/Deleted is priority 99 (also not completed, also in the denominator, REVERT B)."

    ws.Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 100
End Sub

' ---- Staff Roster Check sheet --------------------------------------------

' unmatchedNames: Dictionary from Helpers.ComputeRosterCoverage (resolved CCF
' closer name -> encounter count) for names that did NOT map to a named
' team. Listed here regardless of coverage tier (PART 4.1, third bullet).
Private Sub BuildStaffRosterCheckSheet(ws As Worksheet, fileAws As Worksheet, _
        roster As Object, unmatchedNames As Object)

    If roster.Count = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "Config roster is empty -- run CreateConfigSheet " & _
            "(Alt+F8) and add staff names/teams before this check is meaningful. " & _
            "SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare (Alt+F8) can bootstrap a starting roster from an export."
        ws.Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 80
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "Cannot build roster check: Encounter column not found."
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row

    Dim createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")

    Dim nameSet As Object
    Set nameSet = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    nameSet.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    If lastRow >= 2 Then
        Dim i As Long, nm As String
        If createdByCol > 0 Then
            Dim cbData As Variant
            cbData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, createdByCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, createdByCol)).Value
            For i = 1 To lastRow - 1
                If lastRow = 2 Then nm = CellStr(cbData) Else nm = CellStr(cbData(i, 1))
                If nm <> "" Then nameSet(nm) = True
            Next i
        End If
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then
            Dim lcData As Variant
            lcData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, latestCCFCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, latestCCFCol)).Value
            For i = 1 To lastRow - 1
                If lastRow = 2 Then nm = CellStr(lcData) Else nm = CellStr(lcData(i, 1))
                If nm <> "" Then nameSet(nm) = True
            Next i
        End If
    End If

    Dim teamOrder As Variant
    teamOrder = Array(TEAM_ED_EDFC, TEAM_INFLIGHT, TEAM_NCID_AO, TEAM_ICH_PSO, TEAM_ADMIN)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1
    Dim t As Long
    For t = LBound(teamOrder) To UBound(teamOrder)
        Dim teamName As String
        teamName = CStr(teamOrder(t))

        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = teamName
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 11
        r = r + 1

        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Staff Name"
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Matched"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Bold = True
        r = r + 1

        Dim k As Variant
        For Each k In roster.Keys
            If CStr(roster(k)) = teamName Then
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = CStr(k)

222	  addendum), suggested via SaveAs dialog.
223	
224	### MainMacro.bas (2026-06-18 -- new module)
225	- `GenerateFCCompletionReport` -- entry point (Alt+F8). Full pipeline:
226	  FilePickerForm -> load roster -> clean File A (filter + dedup) ->
227	  clean File B (filter) -> BuildOutputWorkbook -> close inputs -> success dialog.

232	## 2026-07-30 consolidated change set
233	
234	Validated against a real export (`FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx`, June
235	2026, 7,434 rows) and the team's manually produced report for the same
236	month. Every number below was independently re-derived from the export file
237	and matches the validation target exactly: rows loaded 7,434 -> after FC
238	Mode filter 7,432 (2 Shopper rows dropped) -> after Cancelled filter 7,432
239	(no Cancelled rows) -> unique encounters 6,659 -> 613 duplicate groups (773
240	rows removed) -> of which Voided/Deleted only 56 (8 EM, 48 EL) -> of which
241	unrecognised status 0 -> 1 encounter lost entirely to the FC Mode filter
242	(Shopper-only, blank Encounter No) -> DENOMINATOR 6,659 -> EM 6,033, EL 626

245	### PART 1 -- data-value fixes
246	- `BuildOutput.bas`: `ADM_ELECTIVE` constant changed from `"Elective
247	  Inpatient"` to `"Elective inpa"` (the real export truncates it) and
248	  matching switched from an exact-equality check to a normalised
249	  `"ELECTIVE INPA"` prefix match (new `IsElectiveAdmType` helper), so both
250	  the truncated and a hypothetical full-word value match. Applied both to
251	  the File A section split and the File B missed-FC Admission Type split.
252	- `BuildOutput.bas`: `TryParseDMYDate` renamed to `TryParseMDYDate` and
253	  fixed -- the real export writes dates as M/D/Y (`6/15/2026`), but the old
254	  function read the first part as day, so `DateSerial` silently rolled dates
255	  into the wrong month/year. Now parses M/D/Y and rejects out-of-range
256	  month/day instead of letting `DateSerial` roll over. `GetReportPeriodLabel`

272	  branch. The EL sheet is now always produced. The Config NCID Point of Care
273	  list and its loader (`LoadNCIDPointOfCareList`) are kept -- reused for
274	  PART 3's informational NCID Ward breakdown.
275	- **Revert B** (`BuildOutput.bas`, `DeduplicateEncounters.bas` doc comment
276	  only): Voided/Deleted-only encounters (priority 99) are back IN the
277	  denominator and IN "not completed" -- matches the manual report (56 this
278	  month: 8 EM + 48 EL) but disagrees with the original Q4 answer, which
279	  excluded them. They get their own uncoloured "Voided/Deleted only" Summary
280	  row under the "Not completed (total)" subtotal. `WriteSummaryBlock` gained
281	  a `voidedCt` parameter; the "Not completed (total)" and "Total" bandSum
282	  calculations both include it now.
283	- Priority 98 vs. 99 split itself is unchanged (per PART 2.3 -- verified, no
284	  code change): 99 still matches "VOID"/"DELET" substrings, 98 is everything
285	  else unrecognised. Both are now in the denominator, but still separately
286	  counted (`voidCt` / `draftCt`) and separately reported.
287	- **Shopper-only encounter counter** (`Helpers.bas`, `MainMacro.bas`): new
288	  `CountBlankEncounterRows` helper plus the existing
289	  `GetDistinctEncounterSet`/`CountKeysNotIn` -- `MainMacro` snapshots
290	  encounter sets/blank-encounter-row counts before and after `FilterFCMode`
291	  runs. The real export's 2 Shopper rows both have a BLANK Encounter No (no
292	  Encounter Number at all for that FC Mode), so a plain distinct-encounter
293	  diff would report 0 lost, not 1 -- a blank encounter number can't be
294	  disambiguated into separate real encounters, so all rows lost to blank
295	  encounters count as at most one indeterminate "encounter". Reported on the
296	  Summary/Methodology sheets: "N encounter(s) excluded -- only form was a

299	### PART 3 -- output additions (`BuildOutput.bas`)
300	- NCID Point of Care is now an informational breakdown, not a gate: a 4th
301	  extra column "NCID Ward" (Yes/No) on the EM/EL sheets, an "of which NCID
302	  wards" summary sub-block under EL (own green/pink/lt-green/orange/draft/

309	  sub-block (n=12 this month) is the case this was written for.

311	  a `waterfall` Dictionary MainMacro builds from row/encounter-count
312	  snapshots (`RowsLoaded`, `RowsAfterModeFilter`, `RowsAfterCancelledFilter`,
313	  `UniqueEncounters`, `DuplicateGroupsResolved`, `DuplicateRowsRemoved`,
314	  `EncountersLostToModeFilter`). Printed at the top of the Summary sheet,

317	- The "unrecognised FC Status" warning dictionary now excludes any status
318	  text containing "DRAFT" -- "Draft", "Draft (CCF Generated)", "Draft (ETBS
319	  Generated)" are all common, expected priority-98 outcomes in the real
320	  export, not anomalies; flagging them every month would cry wolf. Only
321	  genuinely unexpected priority-98 text (blank, typo, brand-new status)
322	  surfaces in the warning now.

324	### PART 4 -- staff roster
325	- `Helpers.bas`: `ComputeRosterCoverage` -- measures the fraction of File A
326	  encounters whose resolved CCF closer maps to a named team. Called from

329	  suppressing "Who Closed the CCF"/"FC Activity Detail" via a new

333	  sheet (`BuildStaffRosterCheckSheet` gained an "Unmatched names in this
334	  export" section, always shown).
335	- `Helpers.bas`: `LoadStaffRoster` and `GetStaffTeam` both now run names
336	  through `NormalizeDashesAndSpaces` (not just `Trim`) before comparing --
337	  real eFC display names carry stray doubled/trailing whitespace that a bare
338	  `Trim` doesn't catch, silently dumping otherwise-known staff into "Others".
339	- `Helpers.bas`: `SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare` (Alt+F8) -- new bootstrap sub.
340	  Prompts for an FC Summary Report export, tallies Point Of Care per staff

343	  Point Of Care, % Dominant, Suggested Team, Confidence) and fills the
344	  roster's Team column ONLY where currently blank -- never overwrites an
345	  existing team. Confidence is "LOW -- please confirm" when the dominant
346	  Point of Care is under 50% of that person's rows.
347	- `Helpers.bas`: `ExportStaffRoster` / `ImportStaffRoster` (Alt+F8) -- CSV
348	  round trip for the Config roster, with proper quoted-field handling
349	  (`ParseCSVLine`/`CSVQuote`) so a name like "LIM YONG CHIEW, DESMOND"
350	  survives.
351	- New `SortDictKeysDescending` helper (manual insertion sort -- VBA has no
352	  built-in) used by all three "biggest first" listings above.
353	
354	Docs updated to match: `CLAUDE.md` (File A column reference confirmed from
355	the real export, priority table, EM/EL split step, denominator, colour
356	table, outstanding blanks #1 and #6 closed, #3-#5 partially unblocked) and
357	`docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md` (2026-07-30
358	reconciliation note, Section 2 steps 8 and 9, Section 4 roster tooling,

361	
362	---
363	
364	## 2026-07-30 bug fix: duplicate-highlight visual aid never reached the user
365	
366	Code review found that `DeduplicateEncounters.MarkDuplicateEncounters` (CLAUDE.md
367	Step 4 / process flow doc item 5 -- "highlight duplicate encounter numbers in
368	red... a visual aid so staff can see at a glance which encounters had more
369	than one FC ID") had no effect the user could ever see:
370	
371	- It colours cells on `wsA` (the File A workbook opened via the file picker),
372	  but `MainMacro.GenerateFCCompletionReport` closes that workbook with
373	  `SaveChanges:=False` at the end of the run.
374	- `BuildOutputWorkbook` builds the EM/EL sheets by reading `fileAws` into a
375	  plain `Variant` array (`.Value`) and writing that array into new sheets --
376	  this copies values only, never cell formatting, so even if `wsA` had been
377	  left open, the red fill would not have propagated to the deliverable.
378	
379	Net effect: the highlighting was computed and then thrown away every run --
380	staff had no way to see, in the actual output workbook, which surviving rows
381	had duplicate FC IDs resolved out from under them.
382	
383	**Fix** -- moved the visual aid to the sheets staff actually receive:
384	- `DeduplicateEncounters.ResolveDuplicateEncounters` gained a new `ByRef
385	  resolvedEncounters As Object` out-parameter: a Dictionary keyed by Encounter
386	  Number for every encounter that had more than one row before resolution
387	  (populated at the same point `duplicateGroupsResolved` is incremented).
388	- `MainMacro.GenerateFCCompletionReport` threads this dictionary from
389	  `ResolveDuplicateEncounters` straight through to `BuildOutputWorkbook`.
390	- `BuildOutput.BuildOutputWorkbook` gained a matching `resolvedEncounters As
391	  Object` parameter, a new "Duplicate(s) Resolved" column (Yes/blank, same
392	  pattern as "CCF Closed By"/"Looks Wrong"/"NCID Ward"), and a new
393	  `HighlightResolvedDuplicateRows` sub (modelled on the existing
394	  `HighlightCCFFallbackRows`) that red-fills the Encounter Number cell on the
395	  EM/EL sheets for every row flagged "Yes" -- called right after
396	  `WriteFilteredFileASheet` for both `wsEM` and `wsEL`.
397	
398	Applied to both `DeduplicateEncounters.bas`/`MainMacro.bas`/`BuildOutput.bas`
399	and their mirror in `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` (verified byte-identical
400	after the edit). **Needs user re-compile** (Alt+F11 -> Debug -> Compile
401	VBAProject) -- not yet tested against a real export.

# FC Completion Report -- VBA Code Progress

This tracks what's been implemented so far vs. what's still waiting on
answers from colleagues (see `docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md`
and the "Outstanding blanks" list in `CLAUDE.md`).

Module files live in the project root (`*.bas`) and are mirrored into
`FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` (the staff-facing paste-into-VBA-editor
deliverable, regenerated by concatenating the `.bas` files with a
`MODULE: <name>.bas` separator header, in this module order: Helpers,
FilterFileA, FilterFileB, DeduplicateEncounters, BuildOutput, MainMacro,
FilePickerForm, ProgressForm).

**Compile status:** `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` (Helpers, FilterFileA,
FilterFileB, DeduplicateEncounters, BuildOutput, MainMacro, FilePickerForm,
ProgressForm) -- **needs user re-compile** after the 2026-07-30 duplicate-highlight
bug fix (see "2026-07-30 bug fix: duplicate-highlight visual aid never reached
the user" section below -- DeduplicateEncounters, MainMacro, and BuildOutput
all changed a shared function signature). Previously **needs user re-compile**
after the 2026-07-30 consolidated
change set (see "2026-07-30 consolidated change set" section below --
Helpers, FilterFileB, DeduplicateEncounters (doc comment only), BuildOutput,
and MainMacro all changed). Previously **needs user re-compile** after the
2026-07-29 conflict resolution (see "2026-07-29 conflict resolution" section
below -- every module except ProgressForm.bas changed). Previous modules compiled cleanly
as of 2026-06-10; not re-verified since.

---

## Done

### Helpers.bas
- `FindColByHeader`, `NormHeader` -- header-based column lookup, copied
  verbatim from the MFC macro.
- `FindEncounterCol` -- tries "Encounter Number" (File A) then "Encounter No"
  (File B), since the two eFC exports label this column differently.
- `ValidateFileHeaders` -- FilePickerForm validation for `FC_SUMMARY` (File A)
  and `INFLIGHT_MISSED` (File B).
- `IsMissedFCColumnBlank` -- detects the File B "Missed FC column entirely
  blank" workaround case from CLAUDE.md.
- `CreateConfigSheet` / `LoadStaffRoster` / `GetStaffTeam` -- builds and reads
  a "Staff Name -> Team" roster table on a `Config` sheet. Teams: ED/EDFC,
  Inflight, NCID AO, ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others (default for anyone not
  listed).

### ProgressForm.bas
Reused as-is from the MFC macro, caption updated to "FC Completion Report --
Generating".

### FilePickerForm.bas
2-slot dashboard (File A: FC Summary Report, File B: Inflight Missed FC
Report) -- Browse/status per slot, duplicate-file check, Missed-FC-blank
warning, Generate enabled only when both slots are valid.

**Note:** status indicators use plain ASCII ("Valid" / "Invalid" / "O" / "X
Same file") instead of the `(check)/(cross)/(circle)/(warning)` symbols used
in the MFC form. CLAUDE.md requires `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` to stay in
clean ASCII (the MFC project has had repeated Unicode-corruption issues
needing `fix_qmarks.ps1`-style cleanup) -- using ASCII from the start avoids
that for this project. Flag if you'd prefer the Unicode symbols anyway.

### FilterFileA.bas (Steps 1-2)
- `FilterFCMode` -- keep only "Financial Counselling - AH" /
  "Financial Counselling - Downtime".
- `DeleteCancelledAdmissions` -- drop Admission Status = "Cancelled".

### FilterFileB.bas (Steps 1-4 of the process flow doc)
- `FilterFCModeIfPresent` -- no-op if File B has no "FC Mode" column
  (CLAUDE.md blank #2).
- `KeepOnlyMissedFC` -- keep only Missed FC = "Yes".
- `DeleteCancelledOrPlanned` -- drop Admission Status = "Cancelled"/"Planned".
- `FlagEDVWDischarges` -- adds an informational "EDVW Discharge" column
  (Point Of Care = "TTSH Virtual Ward" + Accommodation Code = "EDVW"). Rows
  are NOT removed -- this is a label only, per the process flow doc's current
  proposal for Q5.

### DeduplicateEncounters.bas (Steps 3, 5-8)
- `GetFCStatusPriority` -- the 10-level priority table from the process flow
  doc (Q2).
- `AddPriorityColumn` -- writes a "PRIORITISE" column.
- `MarkDuplicateEncounters` -- highlights duplicate Encounter Numbers in red
  (visual aid).
- `ResolveDuplicateEncounters` -- automatically picks one row per Encounter
  Number (lowest priority wins, tie-break by larger FC ID), applies the
  Inflight-creator exception (Q3) via the Config roster, deletes the rest, and
  counts Voided/Deleted-only encounters (Q4) for the final report.

**Note (2026-06-18):** Q2-Q4 (and all other process flow questions) are now
confirmed -- see "Process flow confirmation" section below. The Inflight
exception is driven entirely by the `Config` roster; with an empty roster
`GetStaffTeam` returns "Others" for everyone, so the exception is inert until
real staff names are filled in.

---

## Process flow confirmation (2026-06-18)

All 8 questions from `docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md`
have been confirmed by the user. The process flow doc is now the authoritative
spec -- its rules should be implemented as written.

| Q# | Decision |
|---|---|
| Q1 | EM/EL split by Admission Type only -- no Point of Care condition |
| Q2 | FC Status priority order is correct as written |
| Q3 | Inflight-created FC set aside in favour of non-Inflight (confirmed) |
| Q4 | Voided/Deleted-only encounters fully excluded from denominator |
| Q5 | EDVW discharges count as missed FC (flagged, not excluded) |
| Q6 | Team set confirmed: ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO, ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others |
| Q7 | Fall back to FC Created By when Latest CCF Creation User is blank, but **highlight** those rows |
| Q8 | Conservative principle confirmed -- ambiguous cases default to not completed |

---

## 2026-07-29 conflict resolution

Resolved five spec conflicts between "Guide to monthly processing of report
3.docx" (the authoritative process guide) and
`docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md`, which had silently
diverged from the guide by the time Q1-Q8 were confirmed 2026-06-18. Also
made File B optional and fixed a latent en-dash comparison bug. Every module
except `ProgressForm.bas` changed; the merged deliverable was regenerated
from the edited `.bas` files.

**Decision 1 -- EM/EL split now requires Point of Care (Q1 revised).**
- `Helpers.bas`: `CreateConfigSheet` adds a "NCID EL Point of Care" list
  (column D, ships empty with a header comment) alongside the staff roster.
  New `LoadNCIDPointOfCareList` returns a `vbTextCompare` Dictionary.
- `BuildOutput.bas`: `BuildOutputWorkbook` now computes a per-row `secArr()`
  section classification (SEC_EM / SEC_EL / 0) in its main pass -- an
  Elective Inpatient row only gets SEC_EL if its Point of Care matches the
  Config list. `WriteFilteredFileASheet` was changed to filter by this
  pre-computed array instead of re-deriving from Admission Type text, so the
  EL sheet actually honours the gate. If the list is empty, `elComputed =
  False`: a MsgBox warns the user, the EL sheet/summary block/methodology
  text are skipped, and EM is still produced normally. PoC-mismatched
  Elective rows are counted in a new `elPocExcluded` footnote, not silently
  dropped.

**Decision 2 -- priority 99 means Voided/Deleted only.**
- `DeduplicateEncounters.bas`: `GetFCStatusPriority` now matches "VOID" /
  "DELET" substrings (case-insensitive) for 99; everything else not in the
  six explicit statuses is 98 (was: statuses 7/8/9 for Draft variants, else
  99 for anything unrecognised). 98 stays IN the denominator; only 99 is
  excluded.
- `BuildOutput.bas`: the main stats pass collects distinct FC Status text
  landing on priority 98 into an `unrecognisedStatuses` Dictionary, printed
  as a warning block on the Summary sheet.

**Decision 3 -- five colour bands, Drafts split out.**
- `BuildOutput.bas`: `WriteSummaryBlock` rewritten with Green (1-2) / Pink
  (3) / Light Green (4-5) / Orange (6) / White-none-Draft (98) / Grey
  (missed), plus a "Not completed (total)" subtotal (Orange + Draft +
  Missed) and a visible "Total" row with a red MISMATCH flag if the bands
  don't sum to the denominator. Counter variables renamed to match the new
  bands (`pinkCt`, `ltGreenCt`, `orangeCt`, `draftCt` replace the old
  `lgCt`/`orgCt`/`redCt`).

**Decision 4 -- narrowed Inflight duplicate exception.**
- `DeduplicateEncounters.bas`: `ResolveDuplicateEncounters` now computes a
  "plain" winner (lowest priority, tie-break larger FC ID) across ALL
  candidates first. The Inflight exception only overrides it when a non-
  Inflight ED/EDFC-created candidate is present AND the winner picked from
  non-Inflight candidates has priority <= 2; otherwise the plain winner
  stands. Two new `ByRef` out-params, `inflightExceptionApplied` and
  `inflightExceptionBlocked`, are threaded through `MainMacro.bas` into the
  final MsgBox and the Methodology sheet.

**Decision 5 -- File B is now optional.**
- `FilePickerForm.bas`: File B slot is optional (label updated); Generate
  enables once File A is valid (File B, if selected, must still be header-
  valid). Added a "Missed FC count (dashboard workaround)" text box
  (default 0), validated as a non-negative integer on Generate, exposed as
  `Public MissedFCManualCount`.
- `MainMacro.bas`: rewritten to use a running `stepNum`/`totalSteps` counter
  (8 base steps + 4 more if File B present) instead of a hardcoded constant;
  File B's four cleaning steps are skipped entirely when absent; `wbB.Close`
  is guarded by `hasFileB`.
- `BuildOutput.bas`: `BuildOutputWorkbook` accepts `missedFCManualCount`
  instead of assuming `fileBws` is always present. When File B is absent,
  the manual count is attributed entirely to EM (documented in the
  Methodology sheet -- the dashboard workaround doesn't distinguish
  Elective/NCID AO cases) and the "Missed FC" sheet is skipped.

**Also fixed -- en dash bug (not a conflict, a latent crash).**
- `Helpers.bas`: new `NormalizeDashesAndSpaces` normalises `Chr(150)` /
  `ChrW(8211)` (en dash) and `ChrW(8212)` (em dash) to a plain hyphen and
  collapses whitespace, built via `ChrW()` so the source stays ASCII.
  `FilterFileA.FilterFCMode`, `FilterFileB.FilterFCModeIfPresent`, and
  `DeduplicateEncounters.GetFCStatusPriority` now run both sides of their
  FC Mode / FC Status comparisons through it -- the guide's sample data uses
  an en dash ("Financial Counselling <U+2013> AH"), which would otherwise
  make `FilterFCMode` delete every row.

Docs updated to match: `CLAUDE.md` (priority table detail, colour table
Draft/White row, outstanding blanks #6, File B optionality) and
`docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md` (priority table,
Section 2 steps 6 and 9, Section 3/4 File B optionality and Config PoC list,
Section 5A five-band table, Section 7 Q1/Q3 revision notes).

---

### BuildOutput.bas (2026-06-18 -- major expansion)
- `BuildOutputWorkbook` -- main orchestrator: reads deduplicated File A,
  splits by Admission Type into EM/EL, computes all stats in one pass,
  creates output workbook with 6 sheets, saves via FileDialog.
- EM/EL split (process flow Step 9): purely by Admission Type (Q1 confirmed).
  Adds 3 extra columns: "CCF Closed By" (resolved name), "CCF Closer Team",
  "Looks Wrong" (flags EM closed by NCID AO, or EL closed by ED/EDFC/Inflight).
- `WriteSummarySheet` / `WriteSummaryBlock` -- colour-coded completion
  breakdown (Green/LightGreen/Orange/Red per process flow Section 5A),
  "Who Closed the CCF" by team (Section 5B), FC Activity Detail (Section 5C).
  All computed 3 times: EM, EL, Combined. Footnotes for voided/other.
- `WriteMethodologySheet` -- plain-language explanation of every rule with
  this month's actual numbers (process flow Section 6 item 5).
- `BuildStaffRosterCheckSheet` -- per-team roster coverage check (per
  2026-06-11 design spec). Matched / Not Matched flag against File A data.
- `HighlightCCFFallbackRows` -- highlights yellow any row where Latest CCF
  Creation User was blank and fell back to FC Created By (Q7).
- `WriteMissedFCSheet` -- copies cleaned File B data as-is.
- Output file naming: `FCReportSummary_<MonthName><Year>.xlsx` (per 2026-06-11
  addendum), suggested via SaveAs dialog.

### MainMacro.bas (2026-06-18 -- new module)
- `GenerateFCCompletionReport` -- entry point (Alt+F8). Full pipeline:
  FilePickerForm -> load roster -> clean File A (filter + dedup) ->
  clean File B (filter) -> BuildOutputWorkbook -> close inputs -> success dialog.
  12-step ProgressForm integration. Error handling with Cleanup label.

---

## 2026-07-30 consolidated change set

Validated against a real export (`FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx`, June
2026, 7,434 rows) and the team's manually produced report for the same
month. Every number below was independently re-derived from the export file
and matches the validation target exactly: rows loaded 7,434 -> after FC
Mode filter 7,432 (2 Shopper rows dropped) -> after Cancelled filter 7,432
(no Cancelled rows) -> unique encounters 6,659 -> 613 duplicate groups (773
rows removed) -> of which Voided/Deleted only 56 (8 EM, 48 EL) -> of which
unrecognised status 0 -> 1 encounter lost entirely to the FC Mode filter
(Shopper-only, blank Encounter No) -> DENOMINATOR 6,659 -> EM 6,033, EL 626
(of which NCID wards 12).

### PART 1 -- data-value fixes
- `BuildOutput.bas`: `ADM_ELECTIVE` constant changed from `"Elective
  Inpatient"` to `"Elective inpa"` (the real export truncates it) and
  matching switched from an exact-equality check to a normalised
  `"ELECTIVE INPA"` prefix match (new `IsElectiveAdmType` helper), so both
  the truncated and a hypothetical full-word value match. Applied both to
  the File A section split and the File B missed-FC Admission Type split.
- `BuildOutput.bas`: `TryParseDMYDate` renamed to `TryParseMDYDate` and
  fixed -- the real export writes dates as M/D/Y (`6/15/2026`), but the old
  function read the first part as day, so `DateSerial` silently rolled dates

## 2026-07-30 bug fix: duplicate-highlight visual aid never reached the user

Code review found that `DeduplicateEncounters.MarkDuplicateEncounters` (CLAUDE.md
Step 4 / process flow doc item 5 -- "highlight duplicate encounter numbers in
red... a visual aid so staff can see at a glance which encounters had more
than one FC ID") had no effect the user could ever see:

- It colours cells on `wsA` (the File A workbook opened via the file picker),
  but `MainMacro.GenerateFCCompletionReport` closes that workbook with
  `SaveChanges:=False` at the end of the run.
- `BuildOutputWorkbook` builds the EM/EL sheets by reading `fileAws` into a
  plain `Variant` array (`.Value`) and writing that array into new sheets --
  this copies values only, never cell formatting, so even if `wsA` had been
  left open, the red fill would not have propagated to the deliverable.

Net effect: the highlighting was computed and then thrown away every run --
staff had no way to see, in the actual output workbook, which surviving rows
had duplicate FC IDs resolved out from under them.

**Fix** -- moved the visual aid to the sheets staff actually receive:
- `DeduplicateEncounters.ResolveDuplicateEncounters` gained a new `ByRef
  resolvedEncounters As Object` out-parameter: a Dictionary keyed by Encounter
  Number for every encounter that had more than one row before resolution
  (populated at the same point `duplicateGroupsResolved` is incremented).
- `MainMacro.GenerateFCCompletionReport` threads this dictionary from
  `ResolveDuplicateEncounters` straight through to `BuildOutputWorkbook`.
- `BuildOutput.BuildOutputWorkbook` gained a matching `resolvedEncounters As
  Object` parameter, a new "Duplicate(s) Resolved" column (Yes/blank, same
  pattern as "CCF Closed By"/"Looks Wrong"/"NCID Ward"), and a new
  `HighlightResolvedDuplicateRows` sub (modelled on the existing
  `HighlightCCFFallbackRows`) that red-fills the Encounter Number cell on the
  EM/EL sheets for every row flagged "Yes" -- called right after
  `WriteFilteredFileASheet` for both `wsEM` and `wsEL`.

Applied to both `DeduplicateEncounters.bas`/`MainMacro.bas`/`BuildOutput.bas`
and their mirror in `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` (verified byte-identical
after the edit). **Needs user re-compile** (Alt+F11 -> Debug -> Compile
VBAProject) -- not yet tested against a real export.

    If unmatchedNames Is Nothing Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(roster coverage check was not run)"

        r = r + 1

        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Encounter Count"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True

        Next si

' ---- Main orchestrator ---------------------------------------------------

' fileBws may be Nothing (File B is optional). When Nothing, missedFCManualCount
' (from FilePickerForm's dashboard-workaround input) is used instead,
' attributed entirely to EM (see WriteMethodologySheet Section 1).
'
' ncidPocList: Dictionary from Helpers.LoadNCIDPointOfCareList -- purely
' informational (PART 3.1); does NOT gate the EL sheet (Revert A).
'
' waterfall: Dictionary from MainMacro with the row/encounter-count snapshots
' for the reconciliation waterfall (see WriteReconciliationWaterfall).
'
' rosterCoverage / unmatchedNames / suppressTeamBlocks: from Helpers.
' ComputeRosterCoverage, run in MainMacro before this function (PART 4.1).
Public Function BuildOutputWorkbook(fileAws As Worksheet, fileBws As Worksheet, _
        roster As Object, ncidPocList As Object, missedFCManualCount As Long, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long, _
        waterfall As Object, _
        rosterCoverage As Double, unmatchedNames As Object, suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean, _
        resolvedEncounters As Object) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    BuildOutputWorkbook = True

    Dim hasFileB As Boolean
    hasFileB = Not (fileBws Is Nothing)

    ' ---- Validate required File A columns ----
    Dim encCol As Long, admTypeCol As Long, fcStatusCol As Long
    Dim createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long, priCol As Long, pocCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    admTypeCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Admission Type")
    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Status")
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    priCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "PRIORITISE")
    pocCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Point of Care")

    If encCol = 0 Or admTypeCol = 0 Or fcStatusCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing a required column (Encounter Number, " & _
               "Admission Type, or FC Status).", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        BuildOutputWorkbook = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' ---- Read File A data ----
    Dim aLastRow As Long, aLastCol As Long
    aLastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    aLastCol = fileAws.Cells(1, fileAws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim aData As Variant
    aData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(1, 1), fileAws.Cells(aLastRow, aLastCol)).Value

    ' ---- Build expanded array with extra columns ----
    Dim outCols As Long
    outCols = aLastCol + 5
    Dim ccfCloserCol As Long, ccfTeamCol As Long, looksWrongCol As Long, ncidWardCol As Long
    Dim dupResolvedCol As Long
    ccfCloserCol = aLastCol + 1
    ccfTeamCol = aLastCol + 2
    looksWrongCol = aLastCol + 3
    ncidWardCol = aLastCol + 4
    dupResolvedCol = aLastCol + 5

    Dim fullData() As Variant
    ReDim fullData(1 To aLastRow, 1 To outCols)

    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    For i = 1 To aLastRow
        For j = 1 To aLastCol
            fullData(i, j) = aData(i, j)
        Next j
    Next i

    fullData(1, ccfCloserCol) = "CCF Closed By"
    fullData(1, ccfTeamCol) = "CCF Closer Team"
    fullData(1, looksWrongCol) = "Looks Wrong"
    fullData(1, ncidWardCol) = "NCID Ward"
    fullData(1, dupResolvedCol) = "Duplicate(s) Resolved"

    ' secArr(i) = section for fullData row i: SEC_EM, SEC_EL, or 0 (neither).
    Dim secArr() As Long
    ReDim secArr(1 To aLastRow)

    ' ---- Compute extra columns + stats in one pass ----
    Dim greenCt(1 To 2) As Long, pinkCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim ltGreenCt(1 To 2) As Long, orangeCt(1 To 2) As Long, draftCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim encCt(1 To 2) As Long, voidCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim blankCCF(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim edInit(1 To 2) As Long, edFull(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim inflFull(1 To 2) As Long, ncidFull(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim otherEncCount As Long

    ' NCID ward subset (of EL) -- PART 3.1
    Dim ncidEnc As Long, ncidGreen As Long, ncidPink As Long, ncidLtGreen As Long
    Dim ncidOrange As Long, ncidDraft As Long, ncidVoid As Long, ncidBlankCCF As Long
    Dim ncidEdInit As Long, ncidEdFull As Long, ncidInflFull As Long, ncidNcidFull As Long
    Dim ncidTeams As Object
    Set ncidTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts ncidTeams

    Dim emTeams As Object, elTeams As Object
    Set emTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set elTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts emTeams
    InitTeamCounts elTeams

    Dim unrecognisedStatuses As Object
    Set unrecognisedStatuses = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    unrecognisedStatuses.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim unmatchedNCIDWards As Object
    Set unmatchedNCIDWards = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    unmatchedNCIDWards.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        ' Resolve CCF closer
        Dim latestCCF As String
        latestCCF = ""
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then latestCCF = CellStr(fullData(i, latestCCFCol))

        Dim createdBy As String
        createdBy = ""
        If createdByCol > 0 Then createdBy = CellStr(fullData(i, createdByCol))

        Dim ccfCloser As String
        Dim usedFallback As Boolean
        usedFallback = False
        If latestCCF <> "" Then
            ccfCloser = latestCCF
        ElseIf createdBy <> "" Then
            ccfCloser = createdBy
            usedFallback = True
        Else
            ccfCloser = ""
            usedFallback = True
        End If

        Dim team As String
        team = GetStaffTeam(roster, ccfCloser)

        fullData(i, ccfCloserCol) = ccfCloser
        fullData(i, ccfTeamCol) = team

        ' NCID Ward informational column + unmatched-"NCID"-value warning (PART 3.1)
        Dim pocValRaw As String
        pocValRaw = ""
        If pocCol > 0 Then pocValRaw = CellStr(fullData(i, pocCol))

        Dim isNCIDWard As Boolean
        isNCIDWard = (pocValRaw <> "" And ncidPocList.Exists(pocValRaw))
        If isNCIDWard Then
            fullData(i, ncidWardCol) = "Yes"
        Else
            fullData(i, ncidWardCol) = "No"
        End If

        If pocValRaw <> "" And InStr(UCase(pocValRaw), "NCID") > 0 And Not ncidPocList.Exists(pocValRaw) Then
            If unmatchedNCIDWards.Exists(pocValRaw) Then
                unmatchedNCIDWards(pocValRaw) = unmatchedNCIDWards(pocValRaw) + 1
            Else
                unmatchedNCIDWards(pocValRaw) = 1
            End If
        End If

        ' Duplicate(s) Resolved -- surfaces the visual aid from
        ' DeduplicateEncounters.MarkDuplicateEncounters on the sheet the user
        ' actually sees. That highlighting is applied to fileAws, which is
        ' closed without saving at the end of MainMacro, and this sheet is
        ' populated from a plain .Value array (not a formatted Range.Copy), so
        ' without this column/highlight the "which encounters had more than
        ' one FC ID" visual aid never reaches staff at all.
        Dim encValForDup As String
        encValForDup = Trim(CellStr(fullData(i, encCol)))
        If encValForDup <> "" And resolvedEncounters.Exists(encValForDup) Then
            fullData(i, dupResolvedCol) = "Yes"
        Else
            fullData(i, dupResolvedCol) = ""
        End If

        ' Determine section: SEC_EM, SEC_EL (Admission Type alone -- Revert A), or 0 = neither.
        Dim admType As String
        admType = UCase(CellStr(fullData(i, admTypeCol)))

        Dim sec As Long
        If admType = UCase(ADM_EMERGENCY) Then
            sec = SEC_EM
        ElseIf IsElectiveAdmType(admType) Then
            sec = SEC_EL
        Else
            sec = 0
            otherEncCount = otherEncCount + 1
        End If
        secArr(i) = sec

        ' Looks Wrong flag
        If sec = SEC_EM And team = TEAM_NCID_AO Then
            fullData(i, looksWrongCol) = "Check"
        ElseIf sec = SEC_EL And (team = TEAM_ED_EDFC Or team = TEAM_INFLIGHT) Then
            fullData(i, looksWrongCol) = "Check"
        End If

        ' Stats (EM and EL only)
        If sec > 0 Then
            Dim pri As Long
            If priCol > 0 Then
                If IsNumeric(fullData(i, priCol)) Then
                    pri = CLng(fullData(i, priCol))
                Else
                    pri = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol)))
                End If
            Else
                pri = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol)))
            End If

            encCt(sec) = encCt(sec) + 1
            ClassifyIntoBand pri, greenCt(sec), pinkCt(sec), ltGreenCt(sec), orangeCt(sec), draftCt(sec), voidCt(sec)

            If pri = 98 Then
                ' Known "Draft" family variants (Draft, Draft (CCF Generated),
                ' Draft (ETBS Generated), ...) are an EXPECTED priority-98
                ' outcome, not an anomaly -- only genuinely unexpected text
                ' (blank, typo, brand-new eFC status) goes into the warning
                ' dictionary. Matches the real export: "Draft"/"Draft (CCF
                ' Generated)"/"Draft (ETBS Generated)" are common and normal;
                ' flagging them as "unrecognised" would cry wolf every month.
                Dim statusText As String
                statusText = CellStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol))
                If statusText = "" Then statusText = "(blank)"
                If InStr(UCase(statusText), "DRAFT") = 0 Then
                    If unrecognisedStatuses.Exists(statusText) Then
                        unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) = unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) + 1
                    Else
                        unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) = 1
                    End If
                End If
            End If

            Dim teamDict As Object
            If sec = SEC_EM Then Set teamDict = emTeams Else Set teamDict = elTeams
            teamDict(team) = teamDict(team) + 1

            If usedFallback Then blankCCF(sec) = blankCCF(sec) + 1

            ' Numerator detail
            Dim cbTeam As String, lcTeam As String
            cbTeam = GetStaffTeam(roster, createdBy)
            lcTeam = GetStaffTeam(roster, latestCCF)
            If cbTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then edInit(sec) = edInit(sec) + 1
            If lcTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then edFull(sec) = edFull(sec) + 1
            If lcTeam = TEAM_INFLIGHT Then inflFull(sec) = inflFull(sec) + 1
            If lcTeam = TEAM_NCID_AO Then ncidFull(sec) = ncidFull(sec) + 1

            ' NCID ward subset of EL (PART 3.1)
            If sec = SEC_EL And isNCIDWard Then
                ncidEnc = ncidEnc + 1
                ClassifyIntoBand pri, ncidGreen, ncidPink, ncidLtGreen, ncidOrange, ncidDraft, ncidVoid
                ncidTeams(team) = ncidTeams(team) + 1
                If usedFallback Then ncidBlankCCF = ncidBlankCCF + 1
                If cbTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then ncidEdInit = ncidEdInit + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then ncidEdFull = ncidEdFull + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_INFLIGHT Then ncidInflFull = ncidInflFull + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_NCID_AO Then ncidNcidFull = ncidNcidFull + 1
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    ' ---- Missed FC count: File B (split by Admission Type) or manual entry ----
    Dim missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, missedOther As Long
    Dim missedFCSourceLabel As String

    If hasFileB Then
        missedFCSourceLabel = "Inflight Missed FC Report"

        Dim bEncCol As Long
        bEncCol = FindEncounterCol(fileBws)
        If bEncCol > 0 Then
            Dim bLastRow As Long
            bLastRow = fileBws.Cells(fileBws.Rows.Count, bEncCol).End(xlUp).Row

            If bLastRow >= 2 Then
                Dim bAdmTypeCol As Long
                bAdmTypeCol = FindColByHeader(fileBws, "Admission Type")

                If bAdmTypeCol > 0 Then
                    Dim bAdmData As Variant
                    bAdmData = fileBws.Range(fileBws.Cells(2, bAdmTypeCol), _
                        fileBws.Cells(bLastRow, bAdmTypeCol)).Value

                    Dim bi As Long
                    For bi = 1 To bLastRow - 1
                        Dim bAdmVal As String
                        If bLastRow = 2 Then
                            bAdmVal = UCase(CellStr(bAdmData))
                        Else
                            bAdmVal = UCase(CellStr(bAdmData(bi, 1)))
                        End If

                        If bAdmVal = UCase(ADM_EMERGENCY) Then
                            missedEM = missedEM + 1
                        ElseIf IsElectiveAdmType(bAdmVal) Then
                            missedEL = missedEL + 1
                        Else
                            missedOther = missedOther + 1
                        End If
                    Next bi
                Else
                    missedEM = bLastRow - 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Else
        missedFCSourceLabel = "manual entry (dashboard workaround)"
        missedEM = missedFCManualCount
        missedEL = 0
        missedOther = 0
    End If

    ' ---- Get report period label ----
    Dim reportLabel As String
    reportLabel = GetReportPeriodLabel(fileAws)
    If reportLabel = "" Then reportLabel = "Unknown Period"

    Dim voidedTotal As Long
    voidedTotal = voidCt(1) + voidCt(2)

    ' ---- Create output workbook ----
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim outWb As Workbook
    Set outWb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)

    ' EM sheet -- always produced
    Dim wsEM As Worksheet
    Set wsEM = outWb.Sheets(1)
    wsEM.Name = SHEET_EM
    WriteFilteredFileASheet wsEM, fullData, aLastRow, outCols, secArr, SEC_EM
    HighlightCCFFallbackRows wsEM
    HighlightResolvedDuplicateRows wsEM

    ' EL sheet -- always produced (Revert A, 2026-07-30: no longer gated)
    Dim wsEL As Worksheet
    Set wsEL = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_EL)
    WriteFilteredFileASheet wsEL, fullData, aLastRow, outCols, secArr, SEC_EL
    HighlightCCFFallbackRows wsEL
    HighlightResolvedDuplicateRows wsEL

    ' Missed FC sheet -- only when File B was provided
    If hasFileB Then
        Dim wsMissed As Worksheet
        Set wsMissed = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_MISSED_FC)
        WriteMissedFCSheet wsMissed, fileBws
    End If

    ' Summary sheet
    Dim wsSummary As Worksheet
    Set wsSummary = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_SUMMARY)
    WriteSummarySheet wsSummary, reportLabel, waterfall, _
        encCt(1), encCt(2), missedEM, missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        greenCt(1), pinkCt(1), ltGreenCt(1), orangeCt(1), draftCt(1), voidCt(1), _
        greenCt(2), pinkCt(2), ltGreenCt(2), orangeCt(2), draftCt(2), voidCt(2), _
        emTeams, elTeams, blankCCF(1), blankCCF(2), _
        edInit(1), edFull(1), inflFull(1), ncidFull(1), _
        edInit(2), edFull(2), inflFull(2), ncidFull(2), _
        ncidEnc, ncidGreen, ncidPink, ncidLtGreen, ncidOrange, ncidDraft, ncidVoid, ncidTeams, ncidBlankCCF, _
        ncidEdInit, ncidEdFull, ncidInflFull, ncidNcidFull, _
        voidedTotal, otherEncCount, missedOther, unrecognisedStatuses, unmatchedNCIDWards, _
        inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, _
        CLng(waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter")), _
        suppressTeamBlocks, rosterCoverage, unmatchedNames

    ' Methodology sheet
    Dim wsMethod As Worksheet
    Set wsMethod = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_METHODOLOGY)
    WriteMethodologySheet wsMethod, reportLabel, voidedTotal, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, unrecognisedStatuses.Count, _
        CLng(waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter")), suppressTeamBlocks, rosterCoverage

    ' Staff Roster Check sheet
    Dim wsRoster As Worksheet
    Set wsRoster = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_STAFF_ROSTER_CHECK)
    BuildStaffRosterCheckSheet wsRoster, fileAws, roster, unmatchedNames

    ' Activate Summary sheet
    wsSummary.Activate

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    ' ---- Save via dialog ----
    Dim defaultName As String
    defaultName = "FCReportSummary_" & reportLabel & ".xlsx"

    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogSaveAs)
    fd.title = "Save FC Completion Report"
    fd.InitialFileName = defaultName

    If fd.Show = -1 Then
        Dim savePath As String
        savePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)
        Application.DisplayAlerts = False
        outWb.SaveAs savePath, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        Application.DisplayAlerts = True
        Application.StatusBar = "Report saved: " & savePath
    Else
        MsgBox "Report was NOT saved. The output workbook is still open -- " & _
               "use File > Save As to save it manually.", vbExclamation, "Not Saved"
    End If

    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    MsgBox "Unexpected error building output workbook:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    BuildOutputWorkbook = False
End Function

13	
14	1. [What this tool does](#1-what-this-tool-does)
15	2. [One-time setup](#2-one-time-setup-do-this-once)
16	3. [Pulling the eFC exports each month](#3-pulling-the-efc-exports-each-month)

25	
26	## 1. What this tool does
27	
28	The report answers one question for the monthly department meeting: **of all the
29	patients admitted last month, how many had their financial counselling
30	completed, and who did the work?**
31	
32	It replaces the manual Excel process (sorting, conditional formatting, SWITCH
33	and MINIFS formulas, then combing through several hundred duplicate rows by
34	hand). The rules are identical -- the tool just applies them consistently and
35	shows you its working.
36	
37	**Who runs it:** the team lead taking minutes for that month.
38	
39	**When:** 4 working days after the last day of the month. This gives Inflight
40	time to catch up on missed FC cases from the final days of the month.
41	
42	**The one idea worth understanding:** the eFC export has one row per *FC form*.
43	The report counts *admissions*. One admission can have several forms, so most of
44	what the tool does is deciding which single form represents what really happened
45	for each admission. It keeps the best outcome -- if anybody got that patient
46	properly counselled, the admission counts as counselled.
47	
48	---
49	
50	## 2. One-time setup (do this once)
51	
52	You only do this the first time, or if you are setting the macro up on a new
53	computer.
54	
55	### 2.1 Open the macro workbook and enable macros
56	
57	Open the macro workbook in Excel. If you see a yellow security warning bar,
58	click **Enable Content**.
59	
60	### 2.2 Check the code compiles
61	
62	1. Press `Alt` + `F11` to open the VBA editor.
63	2. Menu: **Debug** -> **Compile VBAProject**.
64	3. Nothing should happen. If a dialog appears with an error, stop and send the
65	   error text to whoever maintains the macro -- do not continue.
66	4. Press `Alt` + `Q` to close the editor.
67	
68	### 2.3 Create the Config sheet
69	
70	The Config sheet holds your settings: which staff member belongs to which team,
71	and which wards belong to NCID.
72	
73	1. Press `Alt` + `F8`.
74	2. Select **CreateConfigSheet** and click **Run**.
75	3. You will get a confirmation message. A new **Config** tab appears.
76	
77	If a message says *"Config sheet already exists"*, you already have one and
78	nothing was changed. See [7.6](#76-my-config-sheet-has-no-column-d) if it is
79	missing column D.
80	
81	### 2.4 Delete the placeholder rows
82	
83	The Config sheet is created with three fake rows -- **Staff A**, **Staff B**,
84	**Staff C**. Delete these three rows now. If you leave them, they sit in your
85	roster forever matching nobody.
86	
87	### 2.5 Bootstrap the staff roster
88	
89	The roster is the only way the tool can tell which team a staff member belongs
90	to -- the eFC export contains names but no department. Without it, the report
91	cannot say who did the work.
92	
93	Rather than typing in every name, let the tool suggest them:
94	
95	1. Press `Alt` + `F8`.
96	2. Select **SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare** and click **Run**.
97	3. Choose any FC Summary Report export when prompted.
98	4. It reads where each staff member usually works and suggests a team.
99	
100	You get a reference table in columns F to K of the Config sheet: staff name, how
101	many rows they appear in, where they mostly work, a suggested team, and a
102	confidence rating. It is **sorted with the busiest staff at the top**.
103	
104	It also writes into the roster itself, in columns A and B. For anyone already
105	listed it fills the Team cell only if you left it blank -- it will never
106	overwrite something you typed. For anyone new, it **adds a row with the
107	suggested team already filled in**. So after one run, every name in the export
108	is in your roster with a team against it.
109	
110	**Now do the important bit -- these are guesses, and they will look like
111	facts.** Once the roster is auto-populated, the tool's roster warning goes quiet
112	because every name now matches something. It checks whether names match, not
113	whether the teams are correct. Nothing will tell you a team is wrong.
114	
115	So work down the table from the top and confirm it with the team leads:
116	
117	- Anything marked **"LOW -- please confirm"** had under half their work in one
118	  place. Those guesses are close to worthless -- check every one.
119	- Anyone landing in **Others** who you know does Inflight ward work. The guess
120	  is based on where the *patient* was, not where the staff member works, and
121	  ordinary ward names all fall through to Others. Inflight staff doing ward
122	  follow-ups are systematically misclassified.
123	- ED/EDFC suggestions are the most reliable, since emergency admissions are
124	  unambiguous.
125	
126	You do **not** need all the names. In a typical month the busiest 30 staff cover
127	over 90% of all rows. Start with those and add the rest as they come up.
128	
129	### 2.6 Check the NCID ward list
130	
131	Column D of the Config sheet, headed **NCID EL Point of Care**, comes prefilled
132	with the ten confirmed NCID ward values. Have a look and add any that are
133	missing. This list does not affect who is counted -- it only drives an extra
134	"of which NCID wards" breakdown on the elective figures.
135	
136	---
137	
138	## 3. Pulling the eFC exports each month
139	
140	### File A -- FC Summary Report (required)
141	
142	In eFC, use the **FC Summary Report** function. Before exporting, filter:
143	
144	- **Admission date range:** the full month
145	- **Admission Type:** Emergency, plus Elective inpa
146	
147	Save the file somewhere you can find it. This is the main input -- one row per FC
148	form created that month.
149	
150	### File B -- Inflight Missed FC Report (optional)
151	
152	In eFC, use the **Inflight FC Report** with the **Missed FC** indicator ticked.
153	
154	This file lists admissions where nobody ever created an FC form. Those
155	admissions do not appear in File A at all -- they are invisible to it -- so
156	File B is the only way to include them in the total.
157	
158	**File B is optional.** If you cannot produce it, or the numbers look
159	implausible, skip it and use the dashboard workaround instead.
160	
161	### The dashboard workaround (if File B is unavailable)
162	
163	1. In the eFC dashboard search, filter by admission type, admission date range,
164	   and Admission Status = Actualised.
165	2. Export to Excel.
166	3. Count the CSNs with no FC ID.
167	4. Type that single number into the macro's file picker (see step 4.2 below).
168	
169	Note: the missed FC count should normally be a small number. If it comes out in
170	the hundreds, something is wrong with the export -- check it before using it.
171	
172	---
173	
174	## 4. Running the report
175	
176	### 4.1 Start the macro
177	
178	1. Press `Alt` + `F8`.
179	2. Select **GenerateFCCompletionReport** and click **Run**.
180	
181	### 4.2 Select your files
182	
183	A window opens titled *"FC Completion Report -- Select Input Files"*:
184	
185	| Slot | What to do |
186	|---|---|
187	| **File A -- FC Summary Report** | Click Browse and pick it. Required. |
188	| **File B -- Inflight Missed FC Report (optional)** | Pick it, or leave empty. |
189	| **Missed FC count (dashboard workaround)** | Only used if File B is empty. Type the number, or leave at 0. |
190	
191	Each slot shows a status next to it -- **Valid**, **Invalid**, or **O** for not
192	yet chosen. **Generate Report** becomes available once File A is valid.
193	
194	**Cancel** closes any files it opened and stops safely.
195	
196	### 4.3 Answer the roster question, if asked
197	
198	A progress bar runs through the steps. Partway through, one of two messages may
199	appear.
200	
201	**"Staff Roster Not Matched"** -- your Config roster is empty, or none of the
202	names in it appear in this export. It asks: *"Continue and produce completion
203	statistics only?"*
204	
205	- **Yes** -- you get the completion figures, but the "who closed the CCF"
206	  section and the four team indicators are left out entirely. Fine if you only
207	  need the completion rate today.
208	- **No** -- stops so you can fill in the roster first. Choose this if the
209	  meeting needs team figures.
210	
211	**"Low Roster Coverage"** -- some names matched but under 70%. The report is
212	produced anyway, and the unmatched names are listed on the Summary sheet with
213	the busiest first, so you can see exactly which ones to add.
214	
215	### 4.4 Save the output
216	
217	A Save As dialog appears with a suggested name like
218	`FCReportSummary_June2026.xlsx`. Pick where to save it. Your two input files are
219	closed without being changed.
220	
221	A summary message tells you how many duplicates were resolved.
222	
223	---
224	
225	## 5. Reading the output
226	
227	The workbook has six sheets.
228	
229	| Sheet | What it is |
230	|---|---|
231	| **EM** | Emergency admissions, one row per admission, after cleaning |
232	| **EL** | Elective inpatient admissions, same |
233	| **Missed FC** | The follow-up list from File B (absent if you did not supply File B) |
234	| **Summary** | All the figures for the meeting |
235	| **Methodology** | Plain-English explanation of every rule, with this month's numbers |
236	| **Staff Roster Check** | Which staff names matched the roster and which did not |
237	
238	### 5.1 The Summary sheet, top to bottom
239	
240	**The reconciliation waterfall** comes first. It walks from the raw file down to
241	the final total, one line per filter, so every figure can be traced. It ends in a
242	balance check. **This is where you look first** -- see section 6.
243	
244	**Completion status** is next, as counts and percentages:
245	
246	| Row | Colour | Meaning |
247	|---|---|---|
248	| FC completed with written acknowledgement | Green | Done properly, signed or acknowledged |
249	| CCF explained but not signed | Pink | Explained, e.g. by phone, no signature obtained |
250	| Attempted, no further follow-up | Light Green | Patient declined or was unable to sign |
251	| FC not completed | Orange | Staff did not reach the patient in time |
252	| Draft only | (none) | A form was started but nothing came of it |
253	| Voided/Deleted only | (none) | The only form for that admission was cancelled in eFC |
254	| Missed FC | Grey | No form was ever created (from File B or your manual count) |
255	| **Not completed (total)** | | The four rows above Missed FC, added together |
256	
257	That last subtotal is your single headline "not completed" figure.
258	
259	**Who closed the CCF** splits the work by team -- ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO,
260	ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others -- based on who last touched the CCF. If that
261	field was blank it falls back to whoever created the form, and those rows are
262	highlighted yellow so you can see it happened.
263	
264	**FC Activity Detail** gives the four workload indicators: FC created by EDFC,
265	and CCF closed by EDFC, Inflight, and NCID AO.
266	
267	Both of these sections are missing entirely if your roster did not match --
268	that is expected, not a fault.
269	
270	Everything is calculated three times: Emergency, Elective, and combined. Within
271	the elective figures there is an extra **"of which NCID wards"** block.
272	
273	### 5.2 Why some blocks show no percentages
274	
275	If a block covers fewer than 30 admissions, percentages are hidden and you see
276	counts plus a note. Percentages on a handful of cases are misleading -- "25%"
277	out of twelve cases will be read as a real rate when it is three admissions.
278	
279	---
280	
281	## 6. Checking that it worked
282	
283	Do this every month before circulating the report.
284	
285	**Step 1 -- the balance check.** At the bottom of the waterfall on the Summary
286	sheet there is a check row. If it flags a mismatch, do not circulate the report.
287	Send it to whoever maintains the macro.
288	
289	**Step 2 -- do the totals look plausible?** Compare against last month. A
290	completion rate that jumps by more than a few points, or a total admission count
291	that moves sharply, usually means an export problem rather than a real change.
292	
293	**Step 3 -- is the missed FC count sensible?** It should be small. Hundreds means
294	the export is wrong.
295	
296	**Step 4 -- read the warnings.** The Summary sheet flags unrecognised FC
297	statuses, NCID wards not in your list, and unmatched staff names. None of these
298	stop the report, but they tell you what to fix for next month.
299	
300	### Reference figures -- June 2026
301	
302	If you re-run the June 2026 export (`FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx`) with
303	an empty roster and no File B, you should get exactly:
304	
305	| Stage | Count |
306	|---|---|
307	| Rows loaded | 7,434 |
308	| After FC Mode filter | 7,432 |
309	| After Cancelled filter | 7,432 |
310	| Unique admissions | 6,659 |
311	| Admissions with duplicate forms | 613 (773 rows removed) |
312	| Of which Voided/Deleted only | 56 (8 EM, 48 EL) |
313	| Of which unrecognised status | 0 |
314	| Excluded -- Shopper enquiry only | 1 |
315	| **Denominator** | **6,659** |
316	| EM | 6,033 |
317	| EL | 626 |
318	| EL, of which NCID wards | 12 |
319	
320	The manually produced report for the same month gives EM 6,035 and EL 627. The
321	difference is fully explained and the tool is the more accurate of the two:
322	
323	- **+1 EL** -- the manual report counts one admission whose only form was a
324	  Shopper price enquiry. A price enquiry is not a counselling, so the tool
325	  excludes it and says so on the Summary.
326	- **+2 EM** -- the file contains only 6,033 Emergency admissions in total, so
327	  6,035 is not possible. The manual sheet has two duplicate rows that survived
328	  the combing step. With 751 rows to check by hand, two survivors is a good hit
329	  rate -- it is exactly the kind of slip this tool removes.
330	
331	Use this comparison when presenting the tool to the team. Showing that it
332	matches the accepted figures *and* explaining where it is more accurate is what
333	gets it adopted.
334	
335	---
336	
337	## 7. Troubleshooting
338	
339	### 7.1 "No Financial Counselling rows found after the FC Mode filter"
340	
341	The FC Mode column does not contain the expected text. Open File A and look at
342	the FC Mode column -- it should read `Financial Counselling - AH` or
343	`Financial Counselling - Downtime`. If eFC has changed the wording, the macro
344	needs updating.
345	
346	### 7.2 "Error: File A is missing the ... column"
347	
348	eFC has renamed or dropped a column in the export. Note which column the message
349	names and send it to whoever maintains the macro. Do not rename columns by hand
350	-- next month it will break again.
351	
352	### 7.3 The team sections are missing from the Summary
353	
354	Your roster did not match any names. Run **SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare** (section
355	2.5) and fill in the Config sheet, then re-run.
356	
357	### 7.4 The EL sheet is empty or nearly empty
358	
359	Check that File A was exported with **Elective inpa** included in the Admission
360	Type filter. If you only exported Emergency, there is nothing for EL to show.
361	
362	### 7.5 The file name says the wrong month
363	
364	The report period comes from the Admission Date column. If your export covers
365	more than one month, or the date range filter was wrong, the label follows the
366	majority. Re-export with the correct range.
367	
368	### 7.6 My Config sheet has no column D
369	
370	You created it before the NCID ward list existed. Either:
371	
372	- If your roster is empty anyway: delete the whole Config sheet and run
373	  **CreateConfigSheet** again, or
374	- Type `NCID EL Point of Care` into cell **D1** exactly as written, then paste
375	  the ward values below it. The header text must match exactly.
376	
377	### 7.7 A warning about unrecognised FC statuses
378	
379	eFC has added a status the tool does not know. The affected admissions are still
380	counted -- as not completed -- so the report is safe to use, but tell whoever
381	maintains the macro so the new status can be ranked properly.
382	
383	### 7.8 Something else went wrong
384	
385	The macro shows an error message rather than failing silently. Copy the whole
386	message, note which step the progress bar was on, and pass both on.
387	
388	---
389	
390	## 8. Keeping the staff roster up to date
391	
392	The Config sheet's roster is the only part of this you need to maintain.
393	
394	**When someone joins or leaves,** add or remove them on the Config sheet. Names
395	must match how they appear in eFC.
396	
397	**Watch out for drift between team leads.** The report rotates monthly. If each
398	lead keeps their own copy of the macro workbook, the rosters slowly diverge and
399	month-to-month figures stop being comparable for reasons nobody can see.
400	
401	Two ways to avoid that -- pick one and stick to it:
402	
403	- Keep **one** macro workbook on a shared drive that everyone uses, or
404	- Keep one roster file on a shared drive and sync it: **ExportStaffRoster**
405	  saves the roster to a CSV, **ImportStaffRoster** loads it back in. Both via
406	  `Alt` + `F8`.
407	
408	**Warning about importing.** `ImportStaffRoster` does not merge -- it **wipes the
409	existing roster and replaces it** with the contents of the CSV. It asks you to
410	confirm first, but once you say yes the old roster is gone. Always run
411	`ExportStaffRoster` first as a backup, even if you think you do not need it.
412	
413	**Check the Staff Roster Check sheet** each month. It lists names in the export
414	that are not in your roster, busiest first. Adding the top few each month keeps
415	coverage climbing with very little effort.
416	
417	---
418	
419	## 9. Open questions for the team
420	
421	Two rules are genuinely unsettled. The tool currently follows existing practice
422	and flags the conflict rather than deciding for you. Both are worth a decision at
423	a department meeting.
424	
425	**Voided and deleted forms.** The written process guide says admissions whose
426	only form was voided or deleted should be **excluded** from the total. The
427	manually produced report **includes** them. The tool currently includes them, to
428	match the manual report. This affects 56 admissions out of about 6,600 -- roughly
429	0.85% on the headline rate. Someone should decide which is intended.
430	
431	**EDVW discharges.** Patients discharged from EDVW may be short-stay cases that
432	were never EDFC's responsibility. The tool labels them but still counts them as
433	missed FC. If they should be excluded instead, the rule needs changing.
434	
435	---
436	
437	## Where things live
438	
439	| Thing | Where |
440	|---|---|
441	| Your settings | **Config** sheet in the macro workbook |
442	| The code | `*.bas` files in the project folder |
443	| The code as one file to paste into Excel | `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` |
444	| The rules and why they are what they are | `docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md` |
445	| What has been built and what is outstanding | `docs/VBA_Code_Progress.md` |
446	| The original manual process | `Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx` |
447	
448	### Macros you can run (`Alt` + `F8`)
449	
450	| Name | What it does |
451	|---|---|
452	| `GenerateFCCompletionReport` | Produces the monthly report. This is the main one. |
453	| `CreateConfigSheet` | Sets up the Config sheet. Once only. |
454	| `SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare` | Suggests a team for every staff name in an export. |
455	| `ExportStaffRoster` | Saves the roster to a CSV. |
456	| `ImportStaffRoster` | Loads a roster from a CSV. |
