It also writes into the roster itself, in columns A and B. For anyone already
listed it fills the Team cell only if you left it blank -- it will never
overwrite something you typed. For anyone new, it **adds a row with the
suggested team already filled in**. So after one run, every name in the export
is in your roster with a team against it.

**Now do the important bit -- these are guesses, and they will look like
facts.** Once the roster is auto-populated, the tool's roster warning goes quiet
because every name now matches something. It checks whether names match, not
whether the teams are correct. Nothing will tell you a team is wrong.

So work down the table from the top and confirm it with the team leads:

- Anything marked **"LOW -- please confirm"** had under half their work in one
  place. Those guesses are close to worthless -- check every one.
- Anyone landing in **Others** who you know does Inflight ward work. The guess
  is based on where the *patient* was, not where the staff member works, and
  ordinary ward names all fall through to Others. Inflight staff doing ward
  follow-ups are systematically misclassified.
- ED/EDFC suggestions are the most reliable, since emergency admissions are
  unambiguous.

You do **not** need all the names. In a typical month the busiest 30 staff cover
over 90% of all rows. Start with those and add the rest as they come up.

### 2.6 Check the NCID ward list

Column D of the Config sheet, headed **NCID EL Point of Care**, comes prefilled
with the ten confirmed NCID ward values. Have a look and add any that are
missing. This list does not affect who is counted -- it only drives an extra
"of which NCID wards" breakdown on the elective figures.

---

## 3. Pulling the eFC exports each month

### File A -- FC Summary Report (required)

In eFC, use the **FC Summary Report** function. Before exporting, filter:

- **Admission date range:** the full month
- **Admission Type:** Emergency, plus Elective inpa

Save the file somewhere you can find it. This is the main input -- one row per FC
form created that month.

### File B -- Inflight Missed FC Report (optional)

In eFC, use the **Inflight FC Report** with the **Missed FC** indicator ticked.

This file lists admissions where nobody ever created an FC form. Those
admissions do not appear in File A at all -- they are invisible to it -- so
File B is the only way to include them in the total.

**File B is optional.** If you cannot produce it, or the numbers look
implausible, skip it and use the dashboard workaround instead.

### The dashboard workaround (if File B is unavailable)

1. In the eFC dashboard search, filter by admission type, admission date range,
   and Admission Status = Actualised.
2. Export to Excel.
3. Count the CSNs with no FC ID.
4. Type that single number into the macro's file picker (see step 4.2 below).

Note: the missed FC count should normally be a small number. If it comes out in
the hundreds, something is wrong with the export -- check it before using it.

---

## 4. Running the report

### 4.1 Start the macro

1. Press `Alt` + `F8`.
2. Select **GenerateFCCompletionReport** and click **Run**.

### 4.2 Select your files

A window opens titled *"FC Completion Report -- Select Input Files"*:

| Slot | What to do |
|---|---|
| **File A -- FC Summary Report** | Click Browse and pick it. Required. |
| **File B -- Inflight Missed FC Report (optional)** | Pick it, or leave empty. |
| **Missed FC count (dashboard workaround)** | Only used if File B is empty. Type the number, or leave at 0. |

Each slot shows a status next to it -- **Valid**, **Invalid**, or **O** for not
yet chosen. **Generate Report** becomes available once File A is valid.

**Cancel** closes any files it opened and stops safely.

### 4.3 Answer the roster question, if asked

A progress bar runs through the steps. Partway through, one of two messages may
appear.

**"Staff Roster Not Matched"** -- your Config roster is empty, or none of the
names in it appear in this export. It asks: *"Continue and produce completion
statistics only?"*

- **Yes** -- you get the completion figures, but the "who closed the CCF"
  section and the four team indicators are left out entirely. Fine if you only
  need the completion rate today.
- **No** -- stops so you can fill in the roster first. Choose this if the
  meeting needs team figures.

**"Low Roster Coverage"** -- some names matched but under 70%. The report is
produced anyway, and the unmatched names are listed on the Summary sheet with
the busiest first, so you can see exactly which ones to add.

### 4.4 Save the output

A Save As dialog appears with a suggested name like
`FCReportSummary_June2026.xlsx`. Pick where to save it. Your two input files are
closed without being changed.

A summary message tells you how many duplicates were resolved.

---

## 5. Reading the output

The workbook has six sheets.

| Sheet | What it is |
|---|---|
| **EM** | Emergency admissions, one row per admission, after cleaning |
| **EL** | Elective inpatient admissions, same |
| **Missed FC** | The follow-up list from File B (absent if you did not supply File B) |
| **Summary** | All the figures for the meeting |
| **Methodology** | Plain-English explanation of every rule, with this month's numbers |
| **Staff Roster Check** | Which staff names matched the roster and which did not |

### 5.1 The Summary sheet, top to bottom

**The reconciliation waterfall** comes first. It walks from the raw file down to
the final total, one line per filter, so every figure can be traced. It ends in a
balance check. **This is where you look first** -- see section 6.

**Completion status** is next, as counts and percentages:

| Row | Colour | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| FC completed with written acknowledgement | Green | Done properly, signed or acknowledged |
| CCF explained but not signed | Pink | Explained, e.g. by phone, no signature obtained |
| Attempted, no further follow-up | Light Green | Patient declined or was unable to sign |
| FC not completed | Orange | Staff did not reach the patient in time |
| Draft only | (none) | A form was started but nothing came of it |
| Voided/Deleted only | (none) | The only form for that admission was cancelled in eFC |
| Missed FC | Grey | No form was ever created (from File B or your manual count) |
| **Not completed (total)** | | The four rows above Missed FC, added together |

That last subtotal is your single headline "not completed" figure.

**Who closed the CCF** splits the work by team -- ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO,
ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others -- based on who last touched the CCF. If that
field was blank it falls back to whoever created the form, and those rows are
highlighted yellow so you can see it happened.

**FC Activity Detail** gives the four workload indicators: FC created by EDFC,
and CCF closed by EDFC, Inflight, and NCID AO.

Both of these sections are missing entirely if your roster did not match --
that is expected, not a fault.

Everything is calculated three times: Emergency, Elective, and combined. Within
the elective figures there is an extra **"of which NCID wards"** block.

### 5.2 Why some blocks show no percentages

If a block covers fewer than 30 admissions, percentages are hidden and you see
counts plus a note. Percentages on a handful of cases are misleading -- "25%"
out of twelve cases will be read as a real rate when it is three admissions.

---

## 6. Checking that it worked

Do this every month before circulating the report.

**Step 1 -- the balance check.** At the bottom of the waterfall on the Summary
sheet there is a check row. If it flags a mismatch, do not circulate the report.
Send it to whoever maintains the macro.

**Step 2 -- do the totals look plausible?** Compare against last month. A
completion rate that jumps by more than a few points, or a total admission count
that moves sharply, usually means an export problem rather than a real change.

**Step 3 -- is the missed FC count sensible?** It should be small. Hundreds means
the export is wrong.

**Step 4 -- read the warnings.** The Summary sheet flags unrecognised FC
statuses, NCID wards not in your list, and unmatched staff names. None of these
stop the report, but they tell you what to fix for next month.

### Reference figures -- June 2026

If you re-run the June 2026 export (`FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx`) with
an empty roster and no File B, you should get exactly:

| Stage | Count |
|---|---|
| Rows loaded | 7,434 |
| After FC Mode filter | 7,432 |
| After Cancelled filter | 7,432 |
| Unique admissions | 6,659 |
| Admissions with duplicate forms | 613 (773 rows removed) |
| Of which Voided/Deleted only | 56 (8 EM, 48 EL) |
| Of which unrecognised status | 0 |
| Excluded -- Shopper enquiry only | 1 |
| **Denominator** | **6,659** |
| EM | 6,033 |
| EL | 626 |
| EL, of which NCID wards | 12 |

The manually produced report for the same month gives EM 6,035 and EL 627. The
difference is fully explained and the tool is the more accurate of the two:

- **+1 EL** -- the manual report counts one admission whose only form was a
  Shopper price enquiry. A price enquiry is not a counselling, so the tool
  excludes it and says so on the Summary.
- **+2 EM** -- the file contains only 6,033 Emergency admissions in total, so
  6,035 is not possible. The manual sheet has two duplicate rows that survived
  the combing step. With 751 rows to check by hand, two survivors is a good hit
  rate -- it is exactly the kind of slip this tool removes.

Use this comparison when presenting the tool to the team. Showing that it
matches the accepted figures *and* explaining where it is more accurate is what
gets it adopted.

---

## 7. Troubleshooting

### 7.1 "No Financial Counselling rows found after the FC Mode filter"

The FC Mode column does not contain the expected text. Open File A and look at
the FC Mode column -- it should read `Financial Counselling - AH` or
`Financial Counselling - Downtime`. If eFC has changed the wording, the macro
needs updating.

### 7.2 "Error: File A is missing the ... column"

eFC has renamed or dropped a column in the export. Note which column the message
names and send it to whoever maintains the macro. Do not rename columns by hand
-- next month it will break again.

### 7.3 The team sections are missing from the Summary

Your roster did not match any names. Run **SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare** (section
2.5) and fill in the Config sheet, then re-run.

### 7.4 The EL sheet is empty or nearly empty

Check that File A was exported with **Elective inpa** included in the Admission
Type filter. If you only exported Emergency, there is nothing for EL to show.

### 7.5 The file name says the wrong month

The report period comes from the Admission Date column. If your export covers
more than one month, or the date range filter was wrong, the label follows the
majority. Re-export with the correct range.

### 7.6 My Config sheet has no column D

You created it before the NCID ward list existed. Either:

- If your roster is empty anyway: delete the whole Config sheet and run
  **CreateConfigSheet** again, or
- Type `NCID EL Point of Care` into cell **D1** exactly as written, then paste
  the ward values below it. The header text must match exactly.

### 7.7 A warning about unrecognised FC statuses

eFC has added a status the tool does not know. The affected admissions are still
counted -- as not completed -- so the report is safe to use, but tell whoever
maintains the macro so the new status can be ranked properly.

### 7.8 Something else went wrong

The macro shows an error message rather than failing silently. Copy the whole
message, note which step the progress bar was on, and pass both on.

---

## 8. Keeping the staff roster up to date

The Config sheet's roster is the only part of this you need to maintain.

**When someone joins or leaves,** add or remove them on the Config sheet. Names
must match how they appear in eFC.

**Watch out for drift between team leads.** The report rotates monthly. If each
lead keeps their own copy of the macro workbook, the rosters slowly diverge and
month-to-month figures stop being comparable for reasons nobody can see.

Two ways to avoid that -- pick one and stick to it:

- Keep **one** macro workbook on a shared drive that everyone uses, or
- Keep one roster file on a shared drive and sync it: **ExportStaffRoster**
  saves the roster to a CSV, **ImportStaffRoster** loads it back in. Both via
  `Alt` + `F8`.

**Warning about importing.** `ImportStaffRoster` does not merge -- it **wipes the
existing roster and replaces it** with the contents of the CSV. It asks you to
confirm first, but once you say yes the old roster is gone. Always run
`ExportStaffRoster` first as a backup, even if you think you do not need it.

**Check the Staff Roster Check sheet** each month. It lists names in the export
that are not in your roster, busiest first. Adding the top few each month keeps
coverage climbing with very little effort.

---

## 9. Open questions for the team

Two rules are genuinely unsettled. The tool currently follows existing practice
and flags the conflict rather than deciding for you. Both are worth a decision at
a department meeting.

**Voided and deleted forms.** The written process guide says admissions whose
only form was voided or deleted should be **excluded** from the total. The
manually produced report **includes** them. The tool currently includes them, to
match the manual report. This affects 56 admissions out of about 6,600 -- roughly
0.85% on the headline rate. Someone should decide which is intended.

**EDVW discharges.** Patients discharged from EDVW may be short-stay cases that
were never EDFC's responsibility. The tool labels them but still counts them as
missed FC. If they should be excluded instead, the rule needs changing.

---

## Where things live

| Thing | Where |
|---|---|
| Your settings | **Config** sheet in the macro workbook |
| The code | `*.bas` files in the project folder |
| The code as one file to paste into Excel | `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` |
| The rules and why they are what they are | `docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md` |
| What has been built and what is outstanding | `docs/VBA_Code_Progress.md` |
| The original manual process | `Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx` |

### Macros you can run (`Alt` + `F8`)

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| `GenerateFCCompletionReport` | Produces the monthly report. This is the main one. |
| `CreateConfigSheet` | Sets up the Config sheet. Once only. |
| `SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare` | Suggests a team for every staff name in an export. |
| `ExportStaffRoster` | Saves the roster to a CSV. |
| `ImportStaffRoster` | Loads a roster from a CSV. |

Public Const TEAM_ED_EDFC As String = "ED/EDFC"
Public Const TEAM_INFLIGHT As String = "Inflight"
Public Const TEAM_NCID_AO As String = "NCID AO"
Public Const TEAM_ICH_PSO As String = "ICH PSO"

Public Const TEAM_OTHERS As String = "Others"

' ---- Column lookup -----------------------------------------

' Searches row 1 of ws for a column whose header matches headerName.
' Matching is case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant: line breaks
' (Alt+Enter / wrapped headers), non-breaking spaces, and runs of spaces
' are all normalised to a single space before comparison.
' Returns the 1-based column index, or 0 if not found.
Public Function FindColByHeader(ws As Worksheet, headerName As String) As Long
    Dim lastCol As Long
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim target As String
    target = NormHeader(headerName)

    Dim c As Long
    For c = 1 To lastCol
        If NormHeader(CStr(ws.Cells(1, c).Value)) = target Then
            FindColByHeader = c
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next c

    FindColByHeader = 0

End Function

' Returns the keys of a Dictionary(String -> Long) sorted by value descending,
' as a String array. Used everywhere an unmatched-name or suggestion list
' needs to show the biggest-impact entries first. VBA has no built-in sort,
' hence the manual insertion sort -- fine at the scale of a few hundred names.
Public Function SortDictKeysDescending(d As Object) As Variant
    Dim n As Long
    n = d.Count
    If n = 0 Then
        SortDictKeysDescending = Array()
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim keys() As String, counts() As Long
    ReDim keys(1 To n)
    ReDim counts(1 To n)

    Dim k As Variant, idx As Long
    idx = 0
    For Each k In d.Keys
        idx = idx + 1
        keys(idx) = CStr(k)
        counts(idx) = CLng(d(k))
    Next k

    Dim a As Long, b As Long, tmpS As String, tmpL As Long
    For a = 2 To n
        tmpS = keys(a): tmpL = counts(a)
        b = a - 1
        ' VBA's And is NOT short-circuit: "b >= 1 And counts(b) < tmpL" still
        ' evaluates counts(0) once b reaches 0, which is out of bounds for a
        ' 1-based array -- run-time error 9. Test the bound separately.
        Do While b >= 1
            If counts(b) >= tmpL Then Exit Do
            keys(b + 1) = keys(b)
            counts(b + 1) = counts(b)
            b = b - 1
        Loop
        keys(b + 1) = tmpS
        counts(b + 1) = tmpL
    Next a

    SortDictKeysDescending = keys
End Function

# Summary Restructure + Native Charts Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Reorder the FC Completion Report's Summary sheet so the status breakdown leads, add a headline block, and add six native Excel charts (two on Summary, four on a new Analytics sheet) driven by a hidden ChartData sheet.

**Architecture:** All chart source data is written to a new very-hidden `ChartData` sheet as contiguous blocks, copied from the same variables that already populate the visible tables (never recomputed). A single reusable `ChartHelpers.AddChartFromBlock` helper (guarded with `On Error`) builds every chart so one chart failure never aborts report generation. Band fill colours are extracted into shared `ChartHelpers` constants so a table cell and its chart segment can never disagree. A new `Analytics.bas` module owns a new "Analytics" sheet (Point-of-Care ward gap, day-of-week, EM turnaround, EL lead-time blocks) and its four charts; `BuildOutput.bas` keeps owning the Summary sheet and its two charts.

**Tech Stack:** Excel VBA (no build system, no test runner -- verification is `grep` for structural integrity plus a user compile/run pass in Excel).

## Global Constraints

- Every change goes into BOTH the relevant `*.bas` file AND `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` (clean ASCII, `--` for dashes, no smart quotes).
- `Option Explicit` in every module; resolve columns via `FindColByHeader`/`FindEncounterCol`, never hardcoded letters.
- VBA has no short-circuit evaluation -- never `IIf()` an array index; use explicit `If` guards.
- No 3D charts, no gradients, no shadows -- flat fills only.
- Every chart-creation path is wrapped in `On Error` so a charting failure skips that chart (with a note left on the sheet) and never aborts report generation -- the tables are the deliverable, charts are presentation.
- Band colours (used by both the Summary table fills and every band-coloured chart) live in ONE place: `ChartHelpers.bas` constants.
  - Green `RGB(146,208,80)`, Pink `RGB(255,199,206)`, Light Green `RGB(198,239,206)`, Orange `RGB(255,192,0)`, Draft only `RGB(242,242,242)`, Voided only `RGB(217,217,217)`, Missed FC `RGB(166,166,166)`.

```vb
' Parses an eFC-format timestamp string "M/D/Y H:MM:SS AM/PM" into a Date
' value carrying both date and time-of-day (VBA Date is a Double: integer
' part = date, fractional part = time). Time part is optional -- if absent,
' the result carries a time of midnight. Returns False on blank/malformed
' text or an out-of-range month/day (same M/D/Y convention bug class as
' BuildOutput.TryParseMDYDate -- see that function's history comment).
Public Function TryParseMDYDateTime(dateText As String, ByRef result As Date) As Boolean
    Dim txt As String
    txt = Trim(dateText)
    If txt = "" Then
        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim spacePos As Long
    spacePos = InStr(txt, " ")
    Dim datePart As String, timePart As String
    If spacePos > 0 Then
        datePart = Left(txt, spacePos - 1)
        timePart = Trim(Mid(txt, spacePos + 1))
    Else
        datePart = txt
        timePart = ""
    End If

    Dim dparts() As String
    dparts = Split(datePart, "/")
    If UBound(dparts) <> 2 Then
        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    If Not IsNumeric(dparts(0)) Or Not IsNumeric(dparts(1)) Or Not IsNumeric(dparts(2)) Then
        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim m As Long, dd As Long, y As Long
    m = CLng(dparts(0)): dd = CLng(dparts(1)): y = CLng(dparts(2))
    If y < 100 Then y = y + 2000
    If m < 1 Or m > 12 Or dd < 1 Or dd > 31 Then
        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim baseDate As Date
    On Error GoTo Fail
    baseDate = DateSerial(y, m, dd)

    Dim timeFraction As Double
    timeFraction = 0
    If timePart <> "" Then
        Dim ampm As String
        Dim tparts() As String
        Dim hh As Long, mi As Long, ss As Long
        Dim ampmPos As Long
        Dim workingTime As String
        workingTime = timePart

        ampmPos = InStr(1, workingTime, "AM", vbTextCompare)
        If ampmPos = 0 Then ampmPos = InStr(1, workingTime, "PM", vbTextCompare)
        If ampmPos > 0 Then
            ampm = UCase(Mid(workingTime, ampmPos, 2))
            workingTime = Trim(Left(workingTime, ampmPos - 1))
        Else
            ampm = ""
        End If

        tparts = Split(workingTime, ":")
        If UBound(tparts) >= 1 Then
            If IsNumeric(tparts(0)) Then hh = CLng(tparts(0)) Else hh = 0
            If IsNumeric(tparts(1)) Then mi = CLng(tparts(1)) Else mi = 0
            If UBound(tparts) >= 2 Then
                If IsNumeric(tparts(2)) Then ss = CLng(tparts(2)) Else ss = 0
            Else
                ss = 0
            End If

            If ampm = "PM" And hh < 12 Then hh = hh + 12
            If ampm = "AM" And hh = 12 Then hh = 0

            timeFraction = (hh * 3600 + mi * 60 + ss) / 86400
        End If
    End If

    result = CDate(CDbl(baseDate) + timeFraction)
    TryParseMDYDateTime = True
    Exit Function
Fail:
    TryParseMDYDateTime = False
End Function
```

```vb
Attribute VB_Name = "ChartHelpers"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' ChartHelpers.bas
'
' Shared native-chart infrastructure for the FC Completion Report:
'   - Band colour constants (used by BOTH the Summary table fills and every
'     band-coloured chart, so a table cell and its chart segment can never
'     disagree)
'   - EnsureChartDataSheet -- the single very-hidden sheet every chart's
'     source range lives on (contiguous blocks only -- non-contiguous
'     SetSourceData ranges are the main source of VBA charting failures)
'   - AddChartFromBlock -- one reusable chart-creation helper, guarded with
'     On Error so a charting failure skips that chart (never aborts report
'     generation -- the tables are the deliverable, charts are presentation)
' ============================================================

Public Const SHEET_CHARTDATA As String = "ChartData"

' Seven completion-status band colours -- must match WriteSummaryBlock's
' table fills exactly (BuildOutput.bas) so a coloured table cell and its
' chart segment never disagree.
Public Const BAND_COLOR_GREEN As Long = 5287310      ' RGB(146,208,80)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_PINK As Long = 13556223       ' RGB(255,199,206)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_LTGREEN As Long = 13561542    ' RGB(198,239,206)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_ORANGE As Long = 49152        ' RGB(255,192,0)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_DRAFT As Long = 15921906      ' RGB(242,242,242)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_VOIDED As Long = 14277081     ' RGB(217,217,217)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_MISSED As Long = 10921638     ' RGB(166,166,166)

' Finds the very-hidden ChartData sheet, creating it (as the last sheet in
' the workbook) if it does not yet exist. Safe to call multiple times per
' report run -- every chart-writing routine calls this before writing its
' block.
Public Function EnsureChartDataSheet(wb As Workbook) As Worksheet
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = wb.Sheets(SHEET_CHARTDATA)
    On Error GoTo 0

    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set ws = wb.Sheets.Add(After:=wb.Sheets(wb.Sheets.Count))
        ws.Name = SHEET_CHARTDATA
    End If

    ws.Visible = xlSheetVeryHidden
    Set EnsureChartDataSheet = ws
End Function

' Creates one chart anchored at anchorCell's top-left corner, sized
' widthPts x heightPts, sourced from srcRange (expected to be a contiguous
' block on the ChartData sheet). seriesColours is a 0-based Variant array of
' RGB Longs (one per series, in SeriesCollection order); pass Empty entries
' to skip colouring a given series (e.g. when a chart type applies its own
' per-point colouring instead). Returns Nothing if anything fails -- callers
' MUST check for Nothing and skip gracefully; a charting failure must never
' abort report generation.
Public Function AddChartFromBlock(targetWs As Worksheet, anchorCell As Range, srcRange As Range, _
        chartType As XlChartType, titleText As String, _
        widthPts As Single, heightPts As Single, _
        seriesColours As Variant, chartName As String) As ChartObject

    On Error GoTo Fail

    Dim co As ChartObject
    Set co = targetWs.ChartObjects.Add(anchorCell.Left, anchorCell.Top, widthPts, heightPts)
    co.Name = chartName

    With co.Chart
        .SetSourceData Source:=srcRange, PlotBy:=xlColumns
        .ChartType = chartType
        .HasTitle = True
        .ChartTitle.Text = titleText

        If Not IsEmpty(seriesColours) Then
            Dim k As Long
            For k = LBound(seriesColours) To UBound(seriesColours)
                If Not IsEmpty(seriesColours(k)) Then
                    On Error Resume Next
                    .SeriesCollection(k - LBound(seriesColours) + 1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = CLng(seriesColours(k))
                    On Error GoTo Fail
                End If
            Next k
        End If

        If .SeriesCollection.Count > 1 Then
            .HasLegend = True
            .Legend.Position = xlLegendPositionBottom
        Else
            .HasLegend = False
        End If

        .ChartArea.Format.Line.Visible = msoFalse
    End With

    Set AddChartFromBlock = co
    Exit Function

Fail:
    Set AddChartFromBlock = Nothing
End Function
```

```vb
' ---- Headline block (new) -------------------------------------------------

' Three rows -- EM / EL / Combined -- each showing denominator, "completed"
' count, and "completed" %. "Completed" here mirrors the existing
' "Not completed (total)" complement already used throughout this sheet:
' Green + Pink + Light Green (i.e. denominator minus Orange/Draft/Voided/
' Missed). This is the single number the department meeting comes for, so
' it must be visible without scrolling -- bold, 14pt for the percentage.
Private Sub WriteHeadlineBlock(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, _
        emEnc As Long, missedEM As Long, emGreen As Long, emPink As Long, emLtGreen As Long, _
        elEnc As Long, missedEL As Long, elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "HEADLINE"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Category"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Denominator"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "Completed"
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "Completed %"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 4)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim emDenom As Long, elDenom As Long, combDenom As Long
    Dim emCompleted As Long, elCompleted As Long, combCompleted As Long
    emDenom = emEnc + missedEM
    elDenom = elEnc + missedEL
    combDenom = emDenom + elDenom
    emCompleted = emGreen + emPink + emLtGreen
    elCompleted = elGreen + elPink + elLtGreen
    combCompleted = emCompleted + elCompleted

    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Emergency (EM)", emDenom, emCompleted
    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Elective Inpatient (EL)", elDenom, elCompleted
    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Combined (EM + EL)", combDenom, combCompleted
    r = r + 1
End Sub

Private Sub WriteHeadlineRow(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, label As String, denom As Long, completed As Long)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = label
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = denom
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = completed
    If denom > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = completed / denom
        ws.Cells(r, 4).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = ""
    End If
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 1
End Sub
```

```vb
Attribute VB_Name = "Analytics"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' Analytics.bas
'
' Builds the FC Completion Report's "Analytics" sheet: four blocks, each
' with a native chart, each sourced from a contiguous block on the shared
' ChartData sheet (see ChartHelpers.bas) copied from the SAME variables
' used to write the visible table -- never recomputed, so a chart and its
' table can never drift apart.
'
'   1. Point of Care ward gap -- top 10 wards by NOT-DONE count (Chart 3)
'   2. Day of week -- EM completion rate, Mon-Sun (Chart 4)
'   3. EM turnaround -- Admission Date -> 1st CCF Creation Date-Time,
'      bucketed <=24h / 24-48h / 48-72h / >72h (Chart 5)
'   4. EL lead time -- Admission Date minus 1st CCF Creation Date-Time in
'      days, bucketed 14+/7-14/1-7/same-day-or-after/no-CCF-created,
'      vs. completion rate (Chart 6)
'
' All four charts are guarded with On Error inside
' ChartHelpers.AddChartFromBlock -- a charting failure skips that chart and
' leaves a note on the sheet; it never aborts report generation.
' ============================================================

Public Const SHEET_ANALYTICS As String = "Analytics"

' NOT-DONE = Orange (6) + Draft (98) + Voided (99) -- same three bands that
' make up "Not completed (total)" on the Summary sheet, minus Missed FC
' (which has no Point of Care value to attribute to a ward).
Private Function IsNotDonePriority(pri As Long) As Boolean
    IsNotDonePriority = (pri = 6 Or pri = 98 Or pri = 99)
End Function

' Green band = priority 1-2 ("completed"), same definition used by the
' Summary sheet's headline block (WriteHeadlineBlock, BuildOutput.bas).
Private Function IsGreenPriority(pri As Long) As Boolean
    IsGreenPriority = (pri <= 2)
End Function

' Sorts a Double array in place (ascending) via manual insertion sort --
' VBA has no built-in sort. Bounded by monthly encounter volume (a few
' thousand rows at most), same complexity trade-off already accepted by
' Helpers.SortDictKeysDescending for the same reason.
Private Sub SortDoubleArray(vals() As Double, n As Long)
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, tmp As Double
    For i = 2 To n
        tmp = vals(i)
        j = i - 1
        Do While j >= 1
            If vals(j) <= tmp Then Exit Do
            vals(j + 1) = vals(j)
            j = j - 1
        Loop
        vals(j + 1) = tmp
    Next i
End Sub

Private Function MedianOfArray(vals() As Double, n As Long) As Double
    If n = 0 Then
        MedianOfArray = 0
        Exit Function
    End If
    SortDoubleArray vals, n
    If n Mod 2 = 1 Then
        MedianOfArray = vals((n + 1) \ 2)
    Else
        MedianOfArray = (vals(n \ 2) + vals(n \ 2 + 1)) / 2
    End If
End Function

Private Function HoursBetween(startDt As Date, endDt As Date) As Double
    HoursBetween = (endDt - startDt) * 24
End Function

' 1 = <=24h, 2 = 24-48h, 3 = 48-72h, 4 = >72h
Private Function TurnaroundBucket(hrs As Double) As Long
    If hrs <= 24 Then
        TurnaroundBucket = 1
    ElseIf hrs <= 48 Then
        TurnaroundBucket = 2
    ElseIf hrs <= 72 Then
        TurnaroundBucket = 3
    Else
        TurnaroundBucket = 4
    End If
End Function

' 1 = 14+ days, 2 = 7-14 days, 3 = 1-7 days, 4 = same day or after.
' leadDays = whole days from 1st CCF Creation Date-Time to Admission Date
' (Admission Date's DateValue minus the CCF's DateValue) -- positive means
' the CCF was created ahead of admission.
Private Function LeadDayBucket(leadDays As Long) As Long
    If leadDays >= 14 Then
        LeadDayBucket = 1
    ElseIf leadDays >= 7 Then
        LeadDayBucket = 2
    ElseIf leadDays >= 1 Then
        LeadDayBucket = 3
    Else
        LeadDayBucket = 4
    End If
End Function
```

```vb
' ---- Block 1: Point of Care ward gap (Chart 3) ----------------------------

' EM+EL combined (secArr(i) > 0) grouped by Point of Care text. Returns the
' full set via wardTotal/wardNotDone dictionaries so the caller can both
' write the visible table and feed the same numbers into the chart.
Private Sub ComputeWardBreakdown(fullData As Variant, aLastRow As Long, secArr() As Long, priArr() As Long, _
        pocCol As Long, wardTotal As Object, wardNotDone As Object)
    wardTotal.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    wardNotDone.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    If pocCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim i As Long, ward As String
    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        If secArr(i) > 0 Then
            ward = Trim(CStr(fullData(i, pocCol)))
            If ward <> "" Then
                If Not wardTotal.Exists(ward) Then
                    wardTotal(ward) = 0
                    wardNotDone(ward) = 0
                End If
                wardTotal(ward) = wardTotal(ward) + 1
                If IsNotDonePriority(priArr(i)) Then
                    wardNotDone(ward) = wardNotDone(ward) + 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Private Sub WriteWardGapBlock(ws As Worksheet, outWb As Workbook, ByRef r As Long, _
        fullData As Variant, aLastRow As Long, secArr() As Long, priArr() As Long, pocCol As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "WHERE THE GAP IS -- POINT OF CARE (EM + EL COMBINED)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    If pocCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Point of Care column not found in File A -- this block is unavailable.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim wardTotal As Object, wardNotDone As Object
    Set wardTotal = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set wardNotDone = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    ComputeWardBreakdown fullData, aLastRow, secArr, priArr, pocCol, wardTotal, wardNotDone

    If wardTotal.Count = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(No Point of Care data found.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim sortedWards As Variant
    sortedWards = SortDictKeysDescending(wardNotDone)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Point of Care"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Not Done"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "Total"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim topN As Long
    topN = UBound(sortedWards) - LBound(sortedWards) + 1
    If topN > 10 Then topN = 10

    Dim chartWards(1 To 10) As String
    Dim chartNotDone(1 To 10) As Long
    Dim wi As Long, ward As String
    For wi = 1 To topN
        ward = CStr(sortedWards(LBound(sortedWards) + wi - 1))
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = ward
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = wardNotDone(ward)
        ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = wardTotal(ward)
        chartWards(wi) = ward
        chartNotDone(wi) = wardNotDone(ward)
        r = r + 1
    Next wi
    r = r + 1

    ' ---- ChartData block: rows 20-29, cols A:B (largest NOT-DONE last, so
    ' ReversePlotOrder puts it at the TOP of the horizontal bar chart) ----
    Dim cd As Worksheet
    Set cd = EnsureChartDataSheet(outWb)

    For ci = 1 To topN
        cd.Cells(19 + ci, 1).Value = chartWards(topN - ci + 1)

    cd.Cells(19, 1).Value = "Ward"

        On Error GoTo 0
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Chart 3 could not be created -- see table above.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If
    r = r + 20
End Sub
```

```vb
Private Sub WriteELLeadTimeBlock(ws As Worksheet, outWb As Workbook, ByRef r As Long, _
        fullData As Variant, aLastRow As Long, secArr() As Long, priArr() As Long, _
        admDateCol As Long, firstCCFDtCol As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "EL LEAD TIME VS. COMPLETION"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    If admDateCol = 0 Or firstCCFDtCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Admission Date or '1st CCF Creation Date-Time' column not found -- " & _
            "this block is unavailable.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' Bucket order fixed (do not sort): 14+ days, 7-14 days, 1-7 days,
    ' Same day or after, No CCF created. Bucket 5 ("No CCF created") is
    ' every EL encounter with a blank 1st CCF Creation Date-Time -- it MUST
    ' appear as its own bar at 0% completion, never excluded (excluding it
    ' would hide a large share of elective admissions).
    Dim bucketN(1 To 5) As Long, bucketGreen(1 To 5) As Long
    Dim bucketLabels(1 To 5) As String
    bucketLabels(1) = "14+ days": bucketLabels(2) = "7-14 days": bucketLabels(3) = "1-7 days"
    bucketLabels(4) = "Same day or after": bucketLabels(5) = "No CCF created"

    Dim i As Long, admDt As Date, firstDt As Date, leadDays As Long, bkt As Long
    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        If secArr(i) = 2 Then   ' SEC_EL
            If TryParseMDYDateTime(CStr(fullData(i, admDateCol)), admDt) Then
                If TryParseMDYDateTime(CStr(fullData(i, firstCCFDtCol)), firstDt) Then
                    leadDays = CLng(DateValue(admDt) - DateValue(firstDt))
                    bkt = LeadDayBucket(leadDays)
                Else
                    bkt = 5   ' No CCF created
                End If
                bucketN(bkt) = bucketN(bkt) + 1
                If bkt <> 5 Then
                    If IsGreenPriority(priArr(i)) Then bucketGreen(bkt) = bucketGreen(bkt) + 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Lead Time Bucket"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "n"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "Completed %"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim bPct(1 To 5) As Double
    Dim smallN As Boolean
    Dim bk As Long
    For bk = 1 To 5
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = bucketLabels(bk)
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = bucketN(bk)
        smallN = (bucketN(bk) < 30)
        If bk = 5 Then
            bPct(bk) = 0
            If Not smallN Then
                ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = 0
                ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
            End If
        ElseIf bucketN(bk) > 0 Then
            bPct(bk) = bucketGreen(bk) / bucketN(bk)
            If Not smallN Then
                ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = bPct(bk)
                ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
            End If
        End If
        If smallN Then
            ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = ""
            ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "n < 30 -- percentage suppressed"
            ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Italic = True
        End If
        r = r + 1
    Next bk
    r = r + 1

    ' ---- ChartData block: rows 57-63, cols A:B ----
    Dim cd As Worksheet
    Set cd = EnsureChartDataSheet(outWb)
    cd.Cells(57, 1).Value = ""
    cd.Cells(57, 2).Value = "Completed %"
    For bk = 1 To 5
        cd.Cells(57 + bk, 1).Value = bucketLabels(bk) & " (n=" & bucketN(bk) & ")"
        cd.Cells(57 + bk, 2).Value = bPct(bk)
    Next bk

    Dim co6 As ChartObject
    Set co6 = AddChartFromBlock(ws, ws.Cells(r, 1), _
        cd.Range(cd.Cells(57, 1), cd.Cells(62, 2)), xlColumnClustered, _
        "EL Lead Time vs. Completion", 420, 260, Array(BAND_COLOR_GREEN), "chtELLeadTime")

    If Not co6 Is Nothing Then
        r = r + 19
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Elective FCs completed further ahead of admission are markedly more " & _
            "likely to be closed. Lead time is measured to the FIRST CCF."
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Chart 6 could not be created -- see table above.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
    End If
End Sub
```

```
### 5.1 The Summary sheet, top to bottom

**The headline block** comes first -- three rows (Emergency, Elective, Combined),
each showing the denominator, the completed count, and the completed percentage
in large bold type. This is the number people came for; you should not need to
scroll to see it.

**Chart 1 (status mix)** follows immediately -- a single stacked bar per
category (EM / EL / Combined) showing the full seven-band breakdown at a
glance, with the green (completed) share labelled.

**Completion status** comes next, as counts and percentages, unchanged in
content from before:

| Row | Colour | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| FC completed with written acknowledgement | Green | Done properly, signed or acknowledged |
| CCF explained but not signed | Pink | Explained, e.g. by phone, no signature obtained |
| Attempted, no further follow-up | Light Green | Patient declined or was unable to sign |
| FC not completed | Orange | Staff did not reach the patient in time |
| Draft only | Light grey | A form was started but nothing came of it |
| Voided/Deleted only | Grey | The only form for that admission was cancelled in eFC |
| Missed FC | Dark grey | No form was ever created (from File B or your manual count) |
| **Not completed (total)** | | The four rows above Missed FC, added together |

That last subtotal is your single headline "not completed" figure. Everything is
calculated three times: Emergency, Elective, and combined, with an extra **"of
which NCID wards"** block within the elective figures.

**Who closed the CCF** splits the work by team -- ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO,
ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others -- based on who last touched the CCF. If that
field was blank it falls back to whoever created the form, and those rows are
highlighted yellow so you can see it happened.

**FC Activity Detail** gives the four workload indicators: FC created by EDFC,
and CCF closed by EDFC, Inflight, and NCID AO.

Both of these sections are missing entirely if your roster did not match --
that is expected, not a fault.

**Chart 2 (band counts, EM vs EL)** comes after the status tables -- the same
seven bands as Chart 1, but as absolute counts side by side rather than a
percentage mix, which is where the 100%-stacked chart above hides real volume
differences between EM and EL.

**The warnings block** follows: unrecognised FC statuses, NCID wards not in
your configured list, and unmatched staff names.

**The reconciliation waterfall** is last, under the heading "Reconciliation --
for checking, not for the meeting". It walks from the raw file down to the
final total, one line per filter, ending in a balance check. It is at the
bottom because it is a working-check for you, not a meeting figure -- see
section 6 for what to do with it.

### 5.2 Why some blocks show no percentages

If a block covers fewer than 30 admissions, percentages are hidden and you see
counts plus a note. Percentages on a handful of cases are misleading -- "25%"
out of twelve cases will be read as a real rate when it is three admissions.
The same n<30 rule applies to the Analytics sheet's lead-time buckets.

| Point of Care ward gap | Chart 3 | Top 10 wards by not-done count -- the most actionable view in the workbook |
| Day of week | Chart 4 | EM completion rate by admission weekday, against the overall EM rate |
| EM turnaround | Chart 5 | Admission to 1st CCF creation, bucketed <=24h / 24-48h / 48-72h / >72h, plus median hours to first and to latest CCF |
| EL lead time | Chart 6 | Elective lead time (days ahead of admission the FC was first created) vs. completion rate -- includes a "No CCF created" bucket at 0%, shown deliberately rather than hidden |
```

```vb
' Parses an eFC-format timestamp string "M/D/Y H:MM:SS AM/PM" into a Date
' value carrying both date and time-of-day (VBA Date is a Double: integer
' part = date, fractional part = time). Time part is optional -- if absent,
' the result carries a time of midnight. Returns False on blank/malformed
' text or an out-of-range month/day (same M/D/Y convention bug class as
' BuildOutput.TryParseMDYDate -- see that function's history comment).
Public Function TryParseMDYDateTime(dateText As String, ByRef result As Date) As Boolean
    Dim txt As String
    txt = Trim(dateText)
    If txt = "" Then
        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim spacePos As Long
    spacePos = InStr(txt, " ")
    Dim datePart As String, timePart As String
    If spacePos > 0 Then
        datePart = Left(txt, spacePos - 1)
        timePart = Trim(Mid(txt, spacePos + 1))
    Else
        datePart = txt
        timePart = ""
    End If

    Dim dparts() As String
    dparts = Split(datePart, "/")
    If UBound(dparts) <> 2 Then
        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    If Not IsNumeric(dparts(0)) Or Not IsNumeric(dparts(1)) Or Not IsNumeric(dparts(2)) Then
        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim m As Long, dd As Long, y As Long
    m = CLng(dparts(0)): dd = CLng(dparts(1)): y = CLng(dparts(2))
    If y < 100 Then y = y + 2000
    If m < 1 Or m > 12 Or dd < 1 Or dd > 31 Then
        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim baseDate As Date
    On Error GoTo Fail
    baseDate = DateSerial(y, m, dd)

    Dim timeFraction As Double
    timeFraction = 0
    If timePart <> "" Then
        Dim ampm As String
        Dim tparts() As String
        Dim hh As Long, mi As Long, ss As Long
        Dim ampmPos As Long
        Dim workingTime As String
        workingTime = timePart

        ampmPos = InStr(1, workingTime, "AM", vbTextCompare)
        If ampmPos = 0 Then ampmPos = InStr(1, workingTime, "PM", vbTextCompare)
        If ampmPos > 0 Then
            ampm = UCase(Mid(workingTime, ampmPos, 2))
            workingTime = Trim(Left(workingTime, ampmPos - 1))
        Else
            ampm = ""
        End If

        tparts = Split(workingTime, ":")
        If UBound(tparts) >= 1 Then
            If IsNumeric(tparts(0)) Then hh = CLng(tparts(0)) Else hh = 0
            If IsNumeric(tparts(1)) Then mi = CLng(tparts(1)) Else mi = 0
            If UBound(tparts) >= 2 Then
                If IsNumeric(tparts(2)) Then ss = CLng(tparts(2)) Else ss = 0
            Else
                ss = 0
            End If

            If ampm = "PM" And hh < 12 Then hh = hh + 12
            If ampm = "AM" And hh = 12 Then hh = 0

            timeFraction = (hh * 3600 + mi * 60 + ss) / 86400
        End If
    End If

    result = CDate(CDbl(baseDate) + timeFraction)
    TryParseMDYDateTime = True
    Exit Function
Fail:
    TryParseMDYDateTime = False
End Function
```

```vb
Attribute VB_Name = "ChartHelpers"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' ChartHelpers.bas
'
' Shared native-chart infrastructure for the FC Completion Report:
'   - Band colour constants (used by BOTH the Summary table fills and every
'     band-coloured chart, so a table cell and its chart segment can never
'     disagree)
'   - EnsureChartDataSheet -- the single very-hidden sheet every chart's
'     source range lives on (contiguous blocks only -- non-contiguous
'     SetSourceData ranges are the main source of VBA charting failures)
'   - AddChartFromBlock -- one reusable chart-creation helper, guarded with
'     On Error so a charting failure skips that chart (never aborts report
'     generation -- the tables are the deliverable, charts are presentation)
' ============================================================

Public Const SHEET_CHARTDATA As String = "ChartData"

' Seven completion-status band colours -- must match WriteSummaryBlock's
' table fills exactly (BuildOutput.bas) so a coloured table cell and its
' chart segment never disagree.
Public Const BAND_COLOR_GREEN As Long = 5287310      ' RGB(146,208,80)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_PINK As Long = 13556223       ' RGB(255,199,206)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_LTGREEN As Long = 13561542    ' RGB(198,239,206)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_ORANGE As Long = 49152        ' RGB(255,192,0)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_DRAFT As Long = 15921906      ' RGB(242,242,242)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_VOIDED As Long = 14277081     ' RGB(217,217,217)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_MISSED As Long = 10921638     ' RGB(166,166,166)

' Finds the very-hidden ChartData sheet, creating it (as the last sheet in
' the workbook) if it does not yet exist. Safe to call multiple times per
' report run -- every chart-writing routine calls this before writing its
' block.
Public Function EnsureChartDataSheet(wb As Workbook) As Worksheet
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = wb.Sheets(SHEET_CHARTDATA)
    On Error GoTo 0

    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set ws = wb.Sheets.Add(After:=wb.Sheets(wb.Sheets.Count))
        ws.Name = SHEET_CHARTDATA
    End If

    ws.Visible = xlSheetVeryHidden
    Set EnsureChartDataSheet = ws
End Function

' Creates one chart anchored at anchorCell's top-left corner, sized
' widthPts x heightPts, sourced from srcRange (expected to be a contiguous
' block on the ChartData sheet). seriesColours is a 0-based Variant array of
' RGB Longs (one per series, in SeriesCollection order); pass Empty entries
' to skip colouring a given series (e.g. when a chart type applies its own
' per-point colouring instead). Returns Nothing if anything fails -- callers
' MUST check for Nothing and skip gracefully; a charting failure must never
' abort report generation.
Public Function AddChartFromBlock(targetWs As Worksheet, anchorCell As Range, srcRange As Range, _
        chartType As XlChartType, titleText As String, _
        widthPts As Single, heightPts As Single, _
        seriesColours As Variant, chartName As String) As ChartObject

    On Error GoTo Fail

    Dim co As ChartObject
    Set co = targetWs.ChartObjects.Add(anchorCell.Left, anchorCell.Top, widthPts, heightPts)
    co.Name = chartName

    With co.Chart
        .SetSourceData Source:=srcRange, PlotBy:=xlColumns
        .ChartType = chartType
        .HasTitle = True
        .ChartTitle.Text = titleText

        If Not IsEmpty(seriesColours) Then
            Dim k As Long
            For k = LBound(seriesColours) To UBound(seriesColours)
                If Not IsEmpty(seriesColours(k)) Then
                    On Error Resume Next
                    .SeriesCollection(k - LBound(seriesColours) + 1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = CLng(seriesColours(k))
                    On Error GoTo Fail
                End If
            Next k
        End If

        If .SeriesCollection.Count > 1 Then
            .HasLegend = True
            .Legend.Position = xlLegendPositionBottom
        Else
            .HasLegend = False
        End If

        .ChartArea.Format.Line.Visible = msoFalse
    End With

    Set AddChartFromBlock = co
    Exit Function

Fail:
    Set AddChartFromBlock = Nothing
End Function
```

```vb
' ---- Headline block (new) -------------------------------------------------

' Three rows -- EM / EL / Combined -- each showing denominator, "completed"
' count, and "completed" %. "Completed" here mirrors the existing
' "Not completed (total)" complement already used throughout this sheet:
' Green + Pink + Light Green (i.e. denominator minus Orange/Draft/Voided/
' Missed). This is the single number the department meeting comes for, so
' it must be visible without scrolling -- bold, 14pt for the percentage.
Private Sub WriteHeadlineBlock(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, _
        emEnc As Long, missedEM As Long, emGreen As Long, emPink As Long, emLtGreen As Long, _
        elEnc As Long, missedEL As Long, elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "HEADLINE"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Category"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Denominator"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "Completed"
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "Completed %"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 4)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim emDenom As Long, elDenom As Long, combDenom As Long
    Dim emCompleted As Long, elCompleted As Long, combCompleted As Long
    emDenom = emEnc + missedEM
    elDenom = elEnc + missedEL
    combDenom = emDenom + elDenom
    emCompleted = emGreen + emPink + emLtGreen
    elCompleted = elGreen + elPink + elLtGreen
    combCompleted = emCompleted + elCompleted

    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Emergency (EM)", emDenom, emCompleted
    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Elective Inpatient (EL)", elDenom, elCompleted
    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Combined (EM + EL)", combDenom, combCompleted
    r = r + 1
End Sub

Private Sub WriteHeadlineRow(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, label As String, denom As Long, completed As Long)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = label
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = denom
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = completed
    If denom > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = completed / denom
        ws.Cells(r, 4).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = ""
    End If
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 1
End Sub
```

```vb
Attribute VB_Name = "Analytics"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' Analytics.bas
'
' Builds the FC Completion Report's "Analytics" sheet: four blocks, each
' with a native chart, each sourced from a contiguous block on the shared
' ChartData sheet (see ChartHelpers.bas) copied from the SAME variables
' used to write the visible table -- never recomputed, so a chart and its
' table can never drift apart.
'
'   1. Point of Care ward gap -- top 10 wards by NOT-DONE count (Chart 3)
'   2. Day of week -- EM completion rate, Mon-Sun (Chart 4)
'   3. EM turnaround -- Admission Date -> 1st CCF Creation Date-Time,
'      bucketed <=24h / 24-48h / 48-72h / >72h (Chart 5)
'   4. EL lead time -- Admission Date minus 1st CCF Creation Date-Time in
'      days, bucketed 14+/7-14/1-7/same-day-or-after/no-CCF-created,
'      vs. completion rate (Chart 6)
'
' All four charts are guarded with On Error inside
' ChartHelpers.AddChartFromBlock -- a charting failure skips that chart and
' leaves a note on the sheet; it never aborts report generation.
' ============================================================

Public Const SHEET_ANALYTICS As String = "Analytics"

' NOT-DONE = Orange (6) + Draft (98) + Voided (99) -- same three bands that
' make up "Not completed (total)" on the Summary sheet, minus Missed FC
' (which has no Point of Care value to attribute to a ward).
Private Function IsNotDonePriority(pri As Long) As Boolean
    IsNotDonePriority = (pri = 6 Or pri = 98 Or pri = 99)
End Function

' Green band = priority 1-2 ("completed"), same definition used by the
' Summary sheet's headline block (WriteHeadlineBlock, BuildOutput.bas).
Private Function IsGreenPriority(pri As Long) As Boolean
    IsGreenPriority = (pri <= 2)
End Function

' Sorts a Double array in place (ascending) via manual insertion sort --
' VBA has no built-in sort. Bounded by monthly encounter volume (a few
' thousand rows at most), same complexity trade-off already accepted by
' Helpers.SortDictKeysDescending for the same reason.
Private Sub SortDoubleArray(vals() As Double, n As Long)
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, tmp As Double
    For i = 2 To n
        tmp = vals(i)
        j = i - 1
        Do While j >= 1
            If vals(j) <= tmp Then Exit Do
            vals(j + 1) = vals(j)
            j = j - 1
        Loop
        vals(j + 1) = tmp
    Next i
End Sub

Private Function MedianOfArray(vals() As Double, n As Long) As Double
    If n = 0 Then
        MedianOfArray = 0
        Exit Function
    End If
    SortDoubleArray vals, n
    If n Mod 2 = 1 Then
        MedianOfArray = vals((n + 1) \ 2)
    Else
        MedianOfArray = (vals(n \ 2) + vals(n \ 2 + 1)) / 2
    End If
End Function

Private Function HoursBetween(startDt As Date, endDt As Date) As Double
    HoursBetween = (endDt - startDt) * 24
End Function

' 1 = <=24h, 2 = 24-48h, 3 = 48-72h, 4 = >72h
Private Function TurnaroundBucket(hrs As Double) As Long
    If hrs <= 24 Then
        TurnaroundBucket = 1
    ElseIf hrs <= 48 Then
        TurnaroundBucket = 2
    ElseIf hrs <= 72 Then
        TurnaroundBucket = 3
    Else
        TurnaroundBucket = 4
    End If
End Function

' 1 = 14+ days, 2 = 7-14 days, 3 = 1-7 days, 4 = same day or after.
' leadDays = whole days from 1st CCF Creation Date-Time to Admission Date
' (Admission Date's DateValue minus the CCF's DateValue) -- positive means
' the CCF was created ahead of admission.
Private Function LeadDayBucket(leadDays As Long) As Long
    If leadDays >= 14 Then
        LeadDayBucket = 1
    ElseIf leadDays >= 7 Then
        LeadDayBucket = 2
    ElseIf leadDays >= 1 Then
        LeadDayBucket = 3
    Else
        LeadDayBucket = 4
    End If
End Function
```

```vb
' ---- Block 1: Point of Care ward gap (Chart 3) ----------------------------

' EM+EL combined (secArr(i) > 0) grouped by Point of Care text. Returns the
' full set via wardTotal/wardNotDone dictionaries so the caller can both
' write the visible table and feed the same numbers into the chart.
Private Sub ComputeWardBreakdown(fullData As Variant, aLastRow As Long, secArr() As Long, priArr() As Long, _
        pocCol As Long, wardTotal As Object, wardNotDone As Object)
    wardTotal.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    wardNotDone.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    If pocCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim i As Long, ward As String
    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        If secArr(i) > 0 Then
            ward = Trim(CStr(fullData(i, pocCol)))
            If ward <> "" Then
                If Not wardTotal.Exists(ward) Then
                    wardTotal(ward) = 0
                    wardNotDone(ward) = 0
                End If
                wardTotal(ward) = wardTotal(ward) + 1
                If IsNotDonePriority(priArr(i)) Then
                    wardNotDone(ward) = wardNotDone(ward) + 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Private Sub WriteWardGapBlock(ws As Worksheet, outWb As Workbook, ByRef r As Long, _
        fullData As Variant, aLastRow As Long, secArr() As Long, priArr() As Long, pocCol As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "WHERE THE GAP IS -- POINT OF CARE (EM + EL COMBINED)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    If pocCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Point of Care column not found in File A -- this block is unavailable.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim wardTotal As Object, wardNotDone As Object
    Set wardTotal = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set wardNotDone = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    ComputeWardBreakdown fullData, aLastRow, secArr, priArr, pocCol, wardTotal, wardNotDone

    If wardTotal.Count = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(No Point of Care data found.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim sortedWards As Variant
    sortedWards = SortDictKeysDescending(wardNotDone)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Point of Care"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Not Done"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "Total"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim topN As Long
    topN = UBound(sortedWards) - LBound(sortedWards) + 1
    If topN > 10 Then topN = 10

    Dim chartWards(1 To 10) As String
    Dim chartNotDone(1 To 10) As Long
    Dim wi As Long, ward As String
    For wi = 1 To topN
        ward = CStr(sortedWards(LBound(sortedWards) + wi - 1))
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = ward
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = wardNotDone(ward)
        ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = wardTotal(ward)
        chartWards(wi) = ward
        chartNotDone(wi) = wardNotDone(ward)
        r = r + 1
    Next wi
    r = r + 1

    ' ---- ChartData block: rows 20-29, cols A:B (largest NOT-DONE last, so
    ' ReversePlotOrder puts it at the TOP of the horizontal bar chart) ----
    Dim cd As Worksheet
    Set cd = EnsureChartDataSheet(outWb)
    Dim ci As Long
    For ci = 1 To topN
        cd.Cells(19 + ci, 1).Value = chartWards(topN - ci + 1)
        cd.Cells(19 + ci, 2).Value = chartNotDone(topN - ci + 1)
    Next ci
    cd.Cells(19, 1).Value = "Ward"
    cd.Cells(19, 2).Value = "Not Done"

    Dim co3 As ChartObject
    Set co3 = AddChartFromBlock(ws, ws.Cells(r, 1), _
        cd.Range(cd.Cells(19, 1), cd.Cells(19 + topN, 2)), xlBarClustered, _
        "Where the Gap Is -- Top " & topN & " Wards by Not-Done Count", 420, 260, _
        Array(BAND_COLOR_ORANGE), "chtWardGap")

    If Not co3 Is Nothing Then
        On Error Resume Next
        co3.Chart.Axes(xlCategory).ReversePlotOrder = True
        co3.Chart.HasLegend = False
        On Error GoTo 0
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Chart 3 could not be created -- see table above.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If
    r = r + 20
End Sub

' ---- Block 2: Day of week -- EM completion rate (Chart 4) -----------------

Private Sub WriteDayOfWeekBlock(ws As Worksheet, outWb As Workbook, ByRef r As Long, _
        fullData As Variant, aLastRow As Long, secArr() As Long, priArr() As Long, admDateCol As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "EM COMPLETION RATE BY DAY OF WEEK (ADMISSION DATE)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12

        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim dayTotal(1 To 7) As Long, dayGreen(1 To 7) As Long
    Dim overallGreen As Long, overallTotal As Long

    Dim i As Long, admText As String, admDt As Date, wd As Long
    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        If secArr(i) = 1 Then   ' SEC_EM
            admText = CStr(fullData(i, admDateCol))
            If TryParseMDYDateTime(admText, admDt) Then
                wd = Weekday(admDt, vbMonday)   ' 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday
                dayTotal(wd) = dayTotal(wd) + 1
                overallTotal = overallTotal + 1
                If IsGreenPriority(priArr(i)) Then
                    dayGreen(wd) = dayGreen(wd) + 1
                    overallGreen = overallGreen + 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    Dim dayNames(1 To 7) As String
    dayNames(1) = "Monday": dayNames(2) = "Tuesday": dayNames(3) = "Wednesday"
    dayNames(4) = "Thursday": dayNames(5) = "Friday": dayNames(6) = "Saturday": dayNames(7) = "Sunday"

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Day"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "EM Encounters"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "Completed %"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True

    Dim dPct(1 To 7) As Double
    Dim d As Long
    For d = 1 To 7
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = dayNames(d)
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = dayTotal(d)
        If dayTotal(d) > 0 Then
            dPct(d) = dayGreen(d) / dayTotal(d)
            ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = dPct(d)
            ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
        Else
            dPct(d) = 0
        End If
        r = r + 1
    Next d

    Dim overallPct As Double
    If overallTotal > 0 Then overallPct = overallGreen / overallTotal Else overallPct = 0
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Overall EM completion rate (reference line on chart)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = overallPct
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Font.Italic = True
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- ChartData block: rows 33-41, cols A:C ----
    Dim cd As Worksheet
    Set cd = EnsureChartDataSheet(outWb)
    cd.Cells(33, 1).Value = "": cd.Cells(33, 2).Value = "Completed %": cd.Cells(33, 3).Value = "Overall"
    For d = 1 To 7
        cd.Cells(33 + d, 1).Value = dayNames(d)
        cd.Cells(33 + d, 2).Value = dPct(d)
        cd.Cells(33 + d, 3).Value = overallPct
    Next d

    Dim co4 As ChartObject
    Set co4 = AddChartFromBlock(ws, ws.Cells(r, 1), _
        cd.Range(cd.Cells(33, 1), cd.Cells(40, 3)), xlColumnClustered, _
        "EM Completion Rate by Day of Week", 420, 260, _
        Array(RGB(0, 128, 0), Empty), "chtDayOfWeek")

    If Not co4 Is Nothing Then
        On Error Resume Next
        co4.Chart.SeriesCollection(2).ChartType = xlLine
        co4.Chart.SeriesCollection(2).Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(180, 0, 0)
        co4.Chart.Axes(xlValue).TickLabels.NumberFormat = "0%"
        On Error GoTo 0
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Chart 4 could not be created -- see table above.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If
    r = r + 20
End Sub
```

```vb
' ---- Block 3: EM turnaround distribution (Chart 5) -------------------------

Private Sub WriteEMTurnaroundBlock(ws As Worksheet, outWb As Workbook, ByRef r As Long, _
        fullData As Variant, aLastRow As Long, secArr() As Long, admDateCol As Long, _
        firstCCFDtCol As Long, latestCCFDtCol As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "EM TURNAROUND -- ADMISSION TO 1ST CCF CREATION"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    If admDateCol = 0 Or firstCCFDtCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Admission Date or '1st CCF Creation Date-Time' column not found -- " & _
            "this block is unavailable.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim bucketCt(1 To 4) As Long
    Dim excludedCt As Long, includedCt As Long
    Dim firstHours() As Double, latestHours() As Double
    ReDim firstHours(1 To aLastRow)
    ReDim latestHours(1 To aLastRow)
    Dim firstN As Long, latestN As Long

    Dim i As Long, admDt As Date, firstDt As Date, latestDt As Date, hrs As Double
    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        If secArr(i) = 1 Then   ' SEC_EM
            If TryParseMDYDateTime(CStr(fullData(i, admDateCol)), admDt) Then
                If firstCCFDtCol > 0 And TryParseMDYDateTime(CStr(fullData(i, firstCCFDtCol)), firstDt) Then
                    hrs = HoursBetween(admDt, firstDt)
                    If hrs < 0 Then hrs = 0
                    bucketCt(TurnaroundBucket(hrs)) = bucketCt(TurnaroundBucket(hrs)) + 1
                    includedCt = includedCt + 1
                    firstN = firstN + 1
                    firstHours(firstN) = hrs

                    If latestCCFDtCol > 0 And TryParseMDYDateTime(CStr(fullData(i, latestCCFDtCol)), latestDt) Then
                        Dim latestHrs As Double
                        latestHrs = HoursBetween(admDt, latestDt)
                        If latestHrs < 0 Then latestHrs = 0
                        latestN = latestN + 1
                        latestHours(latestN) = latestHrs
                    End If
                Else
                    excludedCt = excludedCt + 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    Dim medianFirst As Double, medianLatest As Double
    medianFirst = MedianOfArray(firstHours, firstN)
    medianLatest = MedianOfArray(latestHours, latestN)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Median hours, admission -> 1st CCF (responsiveness)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = Round(medianFirst, 1)
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Median hours, admission -> latest CCF (closure)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = Round(medianLatest, 1)
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Excluded -- no CCF ever generated (1st CCF Creation Date-Time blank)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = excludedCt
    r = r + 2

    Dim bucketLabels(1 To 4) As String
    bucketLabels(1) = "<=24h": bucketLabels(2) = "24-48h": bucketLabels(3) = "48-72h": bucketLabels(4) = ">72h"

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Turnaround"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim bPct(1 To 4) As Double
    Dim b As Long
    For b = 1 To 4
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = bucketLabels(b)
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = bucketCt(b)
        If includedCt > 0 Then
            bPct(b) = bucketCt(b) / includedCt
            ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = bPct(b)
            ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
        End If
        r = r + 1
    Next b
    r = r + 1

    ' ---- ChartData block: rows 48-53, cols A:B ----
    Dim cd As Worksheet
    Set cd = EnsureChartDataSheet(outWb)
    cd.Cells(48, 1).Value = ""
    cd.Cells(48, 2).Value = "% of encounters with a CCF"
    For b = 1 To 4
        cd.Cells(48 + b, 1).Value = bucketLabels(b)
        cd.Cells(48 + b, 2).Value = bPct(b)
    Next b

    Dim chartTitle As String
    chartTitle = "EM Turnaround Distribution (excludes " & excludedCt & " with no CCF created)"

    Dim co5 As ChartObject
    Set co5 = AddChartFromBlock(ws, ws.Cells(r, 1), _
        cd.Range(cd.Cells(48, 1), cd.Cells(52, 2)), xlColumnClustered, _
        chartTitle, 420, 260, Array(RGB(31, 73, 125)), "chtEMTurnaround")

    If co5 Is Nothing Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Chart 5 could not be created -- see table above.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If
    r = r + 20
End Sub

        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' Bucket order fixed (do not sort): 14+ days, 7-14 days, 1-7 days,
    ' Same day or after, No CCF created. Bucket 5 ("No CCF created") is
    ' every EL encounter with a blank 1st CCF Creation Date-Time -- it MUST
    ' appear as its own bar at 0% completion, never excluded (excluding it
    ' would hide a large share of elective admissions).
    Dim bucketN(1 To 5) As Long, bucketGreen(1 To 5) As Long
    Dim bucketLabels(1 To 5) As String
    bucketLabels(1) = "14+ days": bucketLabels(2) = "7-14 days": bucketLabels(3) = "1-7 days"
    bucketLabels(4) = "Same day or after": bucketLabels(5) = "No CCF created"

    Dim i As Long, admDt As Date, firstDt As Date, leadDays As Long, bkt As Long
    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        If secArr(i) = 2 Then   ' SEC_EL
            If TryParseMDYDateTime(CStr(fullData(i, admDateCol)), admDt) Then
                If TryParseMDYDateTime(CStr(fullData(i, firstCCFDtCol)), firstDt) Then
                    leadDays = CLng(DateValue(admDt) - DateValue(firstDt))
                    bkt = LeadDayBucket(leadDays)
                Else
                    bkt = 5   ' No CCF created
                End If
                bucketN(bkt) = bucketN(bkt) + 1
                If bkt <> 5 Then
                    If IsGreenPriority(priArr(i)) Then bucketGreen(bkt) = bucketGreen(bkt) + 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Lead Time Bucket"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "n"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "Completed %"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim bPct(1 To 5) As Double
    Dim smallN As Boolean
    Dim bk As Long
    For bk = 1 To 5
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = bucketLabels(bk)
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = bucketN(bk)
        smallN = (bucketN(bk) < 30)
        If bk = 5 Then
            bPct(bk) = 0
            If Not smallN Then
                ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = 0
                ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
            End If
        ElseIf bucketN(bk) > 0 Then
            bPct(bk) = bucketGreen(bk) / bucketN(bk)
            If Not smallN Then
                ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = bPct(bk)
                ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
            End If
        End If
        If smallN Then
            ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = ""
            ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "n < 30 -- percentage suppressed"
            ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Italic = True
        End If
        r = r + 1
    Next bk
    r = r + 1

    ' ---- ChartData block: rows 57-63, cols A:B ----
    Dim cd As Worksheet
    Set cd = EnsureChartDataSheet(outWb)
    cd.Cells(57, 1).Value = ""
    cd.Cells(57, 2).Value = "Completed %"
    For bk = 1 To 5
        cd.Cells(57 + bk, 1).Value = bucketLabels(bk) & " (n=" & bucketN(bk) & ")"
        cd.Cells(57 + bk, 2).Value = bPct(bk)
    Next bk

    Dim co6 As ChartObject
    Set co6 = AddChartFromBlock(ws, ws.Cells(r, 1), _
        cd.Range(cd.Cells(57, 1), cd.Cells(62, 2)), xlColumnClustered, _
        "EL Lead Time vs. Completion", 420, 260, Array(BAND_COLOR_GREEN), "chtELLeadTime")

    If Not co6 Is Nothing Then
        r = r + 19
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Elective FCs completed further ahead of admission are markedly more " & _
            "likely to be closed. Lead time is measured to the FIRST CCF."
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Chart 6 could not be created -- see table above.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
    End If
End Sub
```

```
### 5.1 The Summary sheet, top to bottom

**The headline block** comes first -- three rows (Emergency, Elective, Combined),
each showing the denominator, the completed count, and the completed percentage
in large bold type. This is the number people came for; you should not need to
scroll to see it.

**Chart 1 (status mix)** follows immediately -- a single stacked bar per
category (EM / EL / Combined) showing the full seven-band breakdown at a
glance, with the green (completed) share labelled.

**Completion status** comes next, as counts and percentages, unchanged in
content from before:

| Row | Colour | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| FC completed with written acknowledgement | Green | Done properly, signed or acknowledged |
| CCF explained but not signed | Pink | Explained, e.g. by phone, no signature obtained |
| Attempted, no further follow-up | Light Green | Patient declined or was unable to sign |
| FC not completed | Orange | Staff did not reach the patient in time |
| Draft only | Light grey | A form was started but nothing came of it |
| Voided/Deleted only | Grey | The only form for that admission was cancelled in eFC |
| Missed FC | Dark grey | No form was ever created (from File B or your manual count) |
| **Not completed (total)** | | The four rows above Missed FC, added together |

That last subtotal is your single headline "not completed" figure. Everything is
calculated three times: Emergency, Elective, and combined, with an extra **"of
which NCID wards"** block within the elective figures.

**Who closed the CCF** splits the work by team -- ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO,
ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others -- based on who last touched the CCF. If that
field was blank it falls back to whoever created the form, and those rows are
highlighted yellow so you can see it happened.

**FC Activity Detail** gives the four workload indicators: FC created by EDFC,
and CCF closed by EDFC, Inflight, and NCID AO.

Both of these sections are missing entirely if your roster did not match --
that is expected, not a fault.

**Chart 2 (band counts, EM vs EL)** comes after the status tables -- the same
seven bands as Chart 1, but as absolute counts side by side rather than a
percentage mix, which is where the 100%-stacked chart above hides real volume
differences between EM and EL.

**The warnings block** follows: unrecognised FC statuses, NCID wards not in
your configured list, and unmatched staff names.

**The reconciliation waterfall** is last, under the heading "Reconciliation --
for checking, not for the meeting". It walks from the raw file down to the
final total, one line per filter, ending in a balance check. It is at the
bottom because it is a working-check for you, not a meeting figure -- see
section 6 for what to do with it.

### 5.2 Why some blocks show no percentages

If a block covers fewer than 30 admissions, percentages are hidden and you see
counts plus a note. Percentages on a handful of cases are misleading -- "25%"
out of twelve cases will be read as a real rate when it is three admissions.
The same n<30 rule applies to the Analytics sheet's lead-time buckets.

| EL lead time | Chart 6 | Elective lead time (days ahead of admission the FC was first created) vs. completion rate -- includes a "No CCF created" bucket at 0%, shown deliberately rather than hidden |
```

```markdown
## 2026-07-30 Summary restructure + native charts

Restructured the Summary sheet so the status breakdown leads, and added six
native Excel charts (two on Summary, four on a new Analytics sheet).

- `ChartHelpers.bas` -- band colour constants (shared with `BuildOutput.bas`'s

  `EnsureChartDataSheet` (the single very-hidden `ChartData` sheet every

  (Chart 5, admission -> 1st CCF Creation Date-Time), EL lead-time vs.
  completion (Chart 6, admission minus 1st CCF Creation Date-Time in days,
  including a deliberately-not-hidden "No CCF created" bucket at 0%).

### `BuildOutput.bas` changes
- `WriteSummaryBlock`'s six band fill colours now reference `ChartHelpers`
  constants instead of literal `RGB(...)` calls -- this **changed** three
  colours to match the chart segments exactly: Pink from `RGB(255,192,203)`
  to `RGB(255,199,206)`, Draft only from white/no-fill to `RGB(242,242,242)`,
  Voided only from no-fill to `RGB(217,217,217)`, Missed FC from
  `RGB(217,217,217)` to `RGB(166,166,166)`.
- `WriteSummarySheet` reordered: title -> new headline block (EM/EL/Combined
  denominator + completed count + completed %, "completed" = Green + Pink +
  Light Green, the existing complement of "Not completed (total)") -> Chart 1
  anchor -> status tables (unchanged content) -> Chart 2 anchor -> warnings
  block -> reconciliation waterfall (moved from the top; heading "Reconciliation
  -- for checking, not for the meeting"). Gained two `ByRef Long` out-params,
  `chart1AnchorRow`/`chart2AnchorRow`.
- `BuildOutputWorkbook`'s main per-row pass now captures `priArr()` (the FC
  status priority already computed per row) so `Analytics.bas` reuses the
  exact same numbers the Summary tables were built from, instead of
  recomputing -- a chart and its table can never drift apart. Also resolves
  three new columns (`Admission Date` was already resolved elsewhere; new:
  `1st CCF Creation Date-Time`, `Latest CCF Creation Date-Time`), and creates
  the new Analytics sheet after Staff Roster Check.

### Column reference fix (CLAUDE.md)
`1st CCF ETBS`/`Latest CCF ETBS` are currency (dollar amounts), not
timestamps -- an earlier version of CLAUDE.md's column reference conflated
"AY: Latest CCF ETBS" with the real timestamp column. Corrected: `AT` = 1st
CCF Creation Date-Time, `AX` = Latest CCF Creation Date-Time, `AY` = Latest
CCF LOS, `AZ` = Latest CCF ETBS (dollars). Turnaround/lead-time calculations
use AT/AX exclusively, resolved by header text as always.

Every chart is created via `ChartHelpers.AddChartFromBlock`, which is
guarded with `On Error` and returns `Nothing` on any failure. Every call
site checks for `Nothing` and writes a one-line note on the sheet instead --
a charting failure never aborts report generation. The tables remain the
deliverable; charts are presentation.
```
